APPLY NOW

5 benefits of using a Fuel Credit Card on your next road trip!

Are you planning a nice long road trip with friends and family, but find yourself a little fretful when it comes to fuel costs? If you are wondering how to save money on fuel costs, a quick and convenient solution is getting a Fuel Credit Card. Not only do these cards help you save money when you spend on fuel, but they also come with a range of benefits that can enhance your travel experience.

In this blog, we will take you through five key benefits of getting a 
Fuel Credit Card
 and how these cards can help you gain clarity about the best 
Credit Card
 for your next road trip.

Benefits of using Fuel Credit Cards

1. Fuel Savings -
 One of the biggest benefits of using a Fuel Credit Card is the consistent fuel savings it can bring you. Most Fuel Credit Card available in the market should offer a fuel surcharge waiver, which means you can save up to 1-2.5% on each fuel payment. Additionally, some Fuel Credit Card offer cashback, which can further reduce expenses.

With the steep prices of fuel in India today, you can save a significant amount of money by using a Fuel Credit Card. This can be especially beneficial for long road trips. It is always a good idea for you to consider the fuel surcharge waiver and available cashback offers. Compare the benefits different cards offer and choose the one that offers the maximum fuel savings.

2. Reward Points  -
 Another good reason to use a Fuel Credit Card is the Reward Points that you can earn on fuel purchases. These cards typically offer Reward Points for every fuel purchase, which can be redeemed for a range of rewards such as free fuel, cashback, gift vouchers and even travel rewards. By using your Fuel Credit Card for fueling your next road trip, you can earn great Reward Points that can be used to offset your travel expenses or even cover the cost of your next road trip.

If you are thinking of the 
best Credit Cards
 for fuel, you are bound to find a card that offers high Reward Points. Some cards offer bonus Reward Points for fuel purchases at specific fuel stations, so make sure you go for a card that provides Reward Points for fuel purchases at the fuel stations you prefer visiting.

3. Easy to Manage Expenses  -
 Using a Fuel Credit Card can also make it easier to manage expenses on your next road trip. Instead of carrying wads of cash or multiple cards, you can use one Fuel Credit Card to pay for your fuel purchases. This can also help you keep track of your fuel expenses and ensure that you don’t end up overspending on fuel. Look for a card that offers easy account management and a user-friendly mobile app. This can make it much easier to track your expenses and manage your card payments.

4. Complimentary Benefits -
 In addition to fuel savings and Reward Points, Fuel Credit Cards also offer a range of complimentary benefits that can take your travel experience to the next level. For instance, some Fuel Credit Cards may have roadside assistance, travel insurance and discounts on dining and hotel stays to offer. If you are eligible, you can leverage these complimentary benefits and change the way you travel. Consider the benefits that are relevant to your travel itinerary and choose a card that offers the maximum value.

5. Secure Transactions -
 Finally, using a Fuel Credit Card for your road trip will keep your financial transactions secure. These cards offer secure transactions that are protected by advanced security features such as chip technology, two-factor authentication and fraud protection. Most cards offered by ICICI Bank are backed by advanced security features that protect sensitive financial information. This is surely going to give you peace of mind and let you enjoy your trip to the fullest.

ICICI BANK FUEL CREDIT CARDS

We have some truly worthwhile Fuel Credit Cards for you to consider. They come with 2000 ICICI Bank Rewards Points as soon as you activate them, you can get up to 4% cashback on your transactions, save further with a 1% surcharge waiver and save bigger with 5% cash back on select departmental stores plus mobile phone purchases and even electricity bills. We also offer 24x7/365 days roadside assistance to our Fuel Credit Card users.

 Apply for a Credit Card that best suits your needs:

The ICICI Bank HPCL Coral American Express Credit Card  with this card, customers can earn 6 ICICI Bank Rewards Points per Rs 100 spent on fuel at HPCL, redeem 2,000 Reward Points, that can be used to buy fuel worth Rs 500 and enjoy 2.5% cash back along with 1% fuel surcharge waiver on purchases at HPCL outlets.

The ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Visa/MasterCard Credit Cards with this card, you can earn 2 ICICI Bank Rewards on every Rs 100 you spend on retail purchases, except fuel. You can also redeem 2000 ICICI Bank Rewards for buying fuel worth Rs 500, get a 2.5% cashback and savings of 1% on fuel surcharge at HPCL pumps.

The 
ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card
 this card offers a joining benefit of 2,000 ICICI Rewards Points upon activation and payment along with Rs 100 cash back on the HP Pay app. There is 24x7 complimentary roadside assistance and a 5% cashback in Reward Points on utility, grocery and departmental store spending. Furthermore, there is a 5% cashback on all your fuel spent at HPCL pumps at any Bank POS machine and another 1.5% additional cashback in the form of Reward Points on the HP Pay app.

To apply for an Adani One Credit Card, you can visit the ICICI Bank website and choose the Card you want to apply for, follow the steps and complete your application (with personal, salary and residential details). After submitting your application, complete your Know Your Customer (KYC) verification.

T&Cs.

What are the different types of Adani One Credit Cards?

There are two types of Adani One ICICI Bank Credit Cards, Platinum and Signature. To learn more about the benefits for travel, lifestyle, shopping and more.

What is the Adani One ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card?

The Adani One ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card is offered to frequent travellers to provide them with multiple benefits in the Adani ecosystem.

What is the joining fee for an Adani One Credit Card?

The joining fee for Adani One ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card is ₹5,000 + GST and for Adani One ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card is ₹750 + GST.

What benefits are offered with the Adani One ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?

The benefits offered with the Adani One ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card include joining benefits worth ₹3,000, Adani managed airport benefits (premium car parking, premium domestic lounge), valet services and porter services.

What benefits are offered with the Adani One ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card?

There are multiple benefits available with the Adani One ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card like flight and hotel vouchers worth ₹5,000 and ₹2,000, 16 domestic lounge access per year, Pranaam services, premium lounge upgrades, porter services, reward points for spending in the Adani Ecosystem and many more.

How can I activate the Adani One ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can activate your Adani One ICICI Bank Credit Card using the following options:

ICICI Bank iMobile App:

Log in to the app.

Tap on ‘Cards & Forex’.

Select your Adani One Credit Card.

Go to ‘Manage Card’ and enable card usage.

Net Banking:

Log in to ICICI Bank Net Banking.

Navigate to ‘Cards’ > ‘Credit Cards’ > ‘Manage’.

Select ‘Manage Credit Card Usage’ and enable transactions such as tap-and-pay.

How do I redeem Adani One ICICI Bank Credit Card reward points?

Adani One ICICI Bank Credit Card reward points can be redeemed exclusively through the Adani One app or website. Points may be used for bookings such as flights, hotels, duty-free shopping and other services within the Adani ecosystem, subject to applicable redemption terms.

Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card FAQs

What are the benefits of using this Credit Card?

Following are the key benefits of using Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card:

No joining and annual fees

Unlimited and never-expiring reward points

Earn 5% reward points on purchases on Amazon.in for prime members and 3% for non-prime members. Earn 2% reward points at 100+ Amazon Pay partner merchants by using this card on Amazon Pay

1% reward points for all other payments*

Low International Forex mark-up fee of 1.99%*

Enjoy 3 months no-cost EMI on eligible Amazon.in transactions

1% surcharge waiver on all fuel purchases

Earnings in the form of Amazon Pay balance, redeemable for all Amazon and Amazon Pay purchases

Automatic conversion of earnings into Amazon Pay balance on the completion of every billing cycle*.

How can I apply for an Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card?

This is an invite-only programme. Please 
click here
 to apply for the Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card.

Can I apply for an add-on card?

Yes. You can apply for an add-on card.

Steps to apply for an add-on card:

ICICI Bank's iMobile app: Log in to ICICI Bank's iMobile app > Go to Cards & Forex > Credit Cards > Get Plus Card (Add-on card) > Select the card for which you wish to apply for an add-on card > Enter the details of the applicant > Submit.

After this, the add-on card applicant will receive the consent form > Applicant to fill the application details > Complete the V-KYC and submit.

Net Banking: Log in to Net Banking > Cards > Credit Cards > Get Plus Card (Add-on card) > Enter the details of the applicant > Proceed.

After this, the add-on card applicant will receive the consent form > Applicant to fill the application details > Complete the V-KYC and submit.

I have not received my Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card till now. What should I do? 

You will receive the physical card within 7 working days from the date of approval of your application. An SMS will be sent once the Card is dispatched. Please use your virtual card details to transact online. In case you do not receive the Card within 7 working days, please call our Customer Care on 1800 1080.

How do I generate or change the PIN for my credit card?

You can generate/change your PIN through any of the following ways:

ICICI Bank's iMobile app: Log in to ICICI Bank's iMobile app > Go to Services > Card PIN Services > Generate Credit Card PIN

Net Banking: Log in to Net Banking > Generate Card PIN > Credit Card PIN > Select Card and enter CVV > Submit > Enter OTP > Enter PIN > Generate Now

Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system: Call on the toll-free number 1800 1080 and follow the instructions.

How do I activate my Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can activate your card using:

ICICI Bank's iMobile app: Log in to ICICI Bank's iMobile app > Cards & Forex > Choose your Credit Card > Manage Card > Enable International/Online/Tap & Pay transactions.

Net Banking: Log in to Net Banking > Cards & Loans > Credit Cards > Manage your Card > Select Card > Enable/Disable Transaction Type/Set Transaction Limit > Generate OTP > Enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile number and complete the process.

How do I add my Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card to my Amazon Account?

Go to your Amazon Account and click on 
Manage Payment Methods
. Add your Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card to your Amazon.in account as a new payment method.

Where do I find the CVV of my Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Flip your Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card, the 3-digit security code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging into the ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking

How can I know the bill due date for my Card?

You can find the bill due date for your Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card in your monthly statement, on the ICICI Bank's iMobile app, through Net Banking or by contacting Customer Care on 1800 1080.

How can I pay outstanding bill for Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card?

ICICI Bank Account: Log in to ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking and go to Credit Cards > Select Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card > Pay Now > Select the amount and proceed to payment.

Amazon.in app – You can pay your outstanding amount from the Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card dashboard.

How can I earn 2% cashback on Amazon Pay partner sites?

You need to use the payment method ‘Login and Pay with Amazon’ to carry out purchases on Amazon Pay partner websites.

I did not receive the correct Amazon Pay balance based on my earnings for the last billing cycle. What should I do and where should I check whether my earnings have been correctly transferred to my Amazon account?

Please call our Customer Care on 1800 1080 from your registered mobile number or e-mail us at 
customer.care@icicibank.com
.

You can check your reward points on the ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking. Also, the aggregate reward points are mentioned in the monthly statement shared by the Bank.

Additionally, you can check your Amazon Pay transaction history under 'Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card: Earnings for last billing cycle and the applicable gift card issued for earnings on this Credit Card’ section.

These earnings will be credited to your Amazon Account as Amazon Pay balance within 2 working days from the completion of your last billing cycle.

How can I use my Amazon Pay earnings?

The Amazon Pay balance can be used for partial or full payment of all Amazon and Amazon Pay purchases.

If I borrow an Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card from someone else and use it for my own purchases, will I earn in the form of Amazon Pay balance?

Please note that these earnings will only be transferred to the card owner’s Amazon Account. If you have borrowed an Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card from another person and are using it for your transactions, applicable Amazon Pay balance will not be added to your Amazon Account.

APR Credit Card - What is APR on Credit Card & How it Work

2 mins Read

               | 2 Years 5 Months Ago

APPLY NOW

KNOW MORE

Understanding APR: Full Form and Meaning

While reviewing your monthly 
Credit Card Statement
, you will come across a term called APR. The full form of APR is Annual Percentage Rate. It refers to the annualised % rate of interest that is to be paid by customers on unpaid dues on their Credit Card. Understanding APR and its impact can help you manage your finances better and ensure responsible Credit Card usage.

What is a good APR for a Credit Card?

A good APR is one that is lower than the average market rate, which can vary depending on overall market conditions and your creditworthiness. An APR between 40% and 50% is considered good. 
Credit Card
 companies assess your credit score to determine your APR; hence, maintaining a high credit score can help secure a lower APR. Since many Cards have variable APR linked to the Prime Rate, your interest rate may fluctuate based on how the Prime Rate changes.

Different Types of Annual Percentage Rate

1. Purchase APR

This is the standard APR, which is the interest rate applicable on all purchases made using your Credit Card, whether online or in-store.

2. Introductory APR

This constitutes a promotional interest rate offered for a limited duration, which is lower than the Card's standard APR, sometimes in the form of a zero percent introductory APR. It may apply to purchases, balance transfers or both. Once the introductory period ends, the standard APR becomes effective.

3. Cash Advance APR

The rate for borrowing cash from your Credit Card typically surpasses your Purchase APR. It does not come with a grace period.

4. Penalty APR

This is enforced for returned (declined) or missed payments. You may need to make several consecutive on-time payments before your Credit Card provider removes the penalty APR. Payments made over 60 days late may also result in a penalty APR being applied on your current balance.

The Function of the APR

After determining your APR, you can use it to compute the interest on your Credit Card balance. Use the following formula to determine the interest accrued during a given billing cycle:

Credit Card interest = [daily rate] x [average daily balance] x [days in billing cycle]

Daily Rate

You can ascertain this by dividing your Credit Card’s Purchase APR by the number of days in a year (365).

Average Daily Balance

Sum up your daily balances throughout the billing cycle and then divide this total by the number of days in the billing cycle. This figure represents your average daily balance.

To calculate your Credit Card interest, multiply your daily rate by your average daily balance, then multiply this by the number of days in the billing cycle. Keep in mind that interest compounds daily with most Card issuers.

How Does APR Work?

The APR of Credit Cards is the annual cost of borrowing money through your Card. You will pay interest based on your APR when you carry a balance (i.e., unpaid dues). Credit Card issuers determine your APR based on your credit score; a higher score typically leads to a lower APR. Most Cards offer a grace period, allowing you to pay off your full balance without incurring interest. However, cash advances and late payments usually attract a higher APR, making it crucial to understand how these charges can impact your finances.

The actual calculation of APR might vary depending on the Credit Card and the issuer bank's policies. ICICI Bank gives Credit Cards with APR starting from 45%. The APR is disclosed in the terms and conditions of the Credit Card, and it can change at any time, totally at the Bank's discretion.

To calculate the interest on your ICICI Bank Credit Card, you need to understand the relevant interest rate and your outstanding balance. The interest is charged on the unpaid amount. If you decide to pay less than the full amount, the remaining balance will incur interest.

Managing Credit Card APR to Save Money

Know about your Card’s APR before spending

Avoid making cash withdrawals using your Credit Card since they can carry high APR

Choose to apply for Credit Cards with lower APRs 

You can also convert big purchases into EMIs with lower interest. 

FAQs

How can I manage and minimise APR charges on my Credit Card?

To minimise APR charges, consider paying your 
Credit Card bill
 in full each month. If that is not possible, aim to make more than the minimum payment to reduce the outstanding balance. Additionally, explore balance transfer options to help consolidate debt at a lower interest rate. At ICICI Bank, we offer specialised Credit Cards with favourable terms for balance transfers.

Understanding APR: Full Form and Meaning

While reviewing your monthly 
Credit Card Statement
, you will come across a term called APR. The full form of APR is Annual Percentage Rate. It refers to the annualised % rate of interest that is to be paid by customers on unpaid dues on their Credit Card. Understanding APR and its impact can help you manage your finances better and ensure responsible Credit Card usage.

What is a good APR for a Credit Card?

A good APR is one that is lower than the average market rate, which can vary depending on overall market conditions and your creditworthiness. An APR between 40% and 50% is considered good. 
Credit Card
 companies assess your credit score to determine your APR; hence, maintaining a high credit score can help secure a lower APR. Since many Cards have variable APR linked to the Prime Rate, your interest rate may fluctuate based on how the Prime Rate changes.

Different Types of Annual Percentage Rate

1. Purchase APR

This is the standard APR, which is the interest rate applicable on all purchases made using your Credit Card, whether online or in-store.

2. Introductory APR

This constitutes a promotional interest rate offered for a limited duration, which is lower than the Card's standard APR, sometimes in the form of a zero percent introductory APR. It may apply to purchases, balance transfers or both. Once the introductory period ends, the standard APR becomes effective.

3. Cash Advance APR

The rate for borrowing cash from your Credit Card typically surpasses your Purchase APR. It does not come with a grace period.

4. Penalty APR

This is enforced for returned (declined) or missed payments. You may need to make several consecutive on-time payments before your Credit Card provider removes the penalty APR. Payments made over 60 days late may also result in a penalty APR being applied on your current balance.

The Function of the APR

After determining your APR, you can use it to compute the interest on your Credit Card balance. Use the following formula to determine the interest accrued during a given billing cycle:

Credit Card interest = [daily rate] x [average daily balance] x [days in billing cycle]

Daily Rate

You can ascertain this by dividing your Credit Card’s Purchase APR by the number of days in a year (365).

Average Daily Balance

Sum up your daily balances throughout the billing cycle and then divide this total by the number of days in the billing cycle. This figure represents your average daily balance.

To calculate your Credit Card interest, multiply your daily rate by your average daily balance, then multiply this by the number of days in the billing cycle. Keep in mind that interest compounds daily with most Card issuers.

How Does APR Work?

The APR of Credit Cards is the annual cost of borrowing money through your Card. You will pay interest based on your APR when you carry a balance (i.e., unpaid dues). Credit Card issuers determine your APR based on your credit score; a higher score typically leads to a lower APR. Most Cards offer a grace period, allowing you to pay off your full balance without incurring interest. However, cash advances and late payments usually attract a higher APR, making it crucial to understand how these charges can impact your finances.

The actual calculation of APR might vary depending on the Credit Card and the issuer bank's policies. ICICI Bank gives Credit Cards with APR starting from 45%. The APR is disclosed in the terms and conditions of the Credit Card, and it can change at any time, totally at the Bank's discretion.

To calculate the interest on your ICICI Bank Credit Card, you need to understand the relevant interest rate and your outstanding balance. The interest is charged on the unpaid amount. If you decide to pay less than the full amount, the remaining balance will incur interest.

Avoid making cash withdrawals using your Credit Card since they can carry high APR

Choose to apply for Credit Cards with lower APRs 

You can also convert big purchases into EMIs with lower interest.

Credit Card Balance Transfer - Ease Your Credit Burden

What are the Benefits of Credit Card Balance Transfer?

Save more on interest

Transfer your Credit Card balance and reduce your high-interest payment burden.

Transfer up to ₹3 lakh

Move outstanding from other bank credit cards to ICICI Bank Credit Card, up to ₹3 lakh.

Easy 3 and 6 Month EMIs

Repay your transferred balance in simple and affordable EMI options.

Zero documentation process

Enjoy seamless balance transfer without lengthy paperwork or extra formalities.

Important Things to Know

Eligibility

Balance Transfer is offered to ICICI Bank Credit Cardholders based on their credit history, transaction pattern and payment track record. The minimum outstanding on the other bank’s Credit Card must be ₹15,000

Transfer Limit

You can transfer balances from other bank Credit Cards up to ₹3 lakh, subject to eligibility and ICICI Bank’s internal policy checks

Fund Transfer Modes

Credit Card Balance Transfer FAQs

What is Credit Card Balance Transfer?

Balance Transfer is a facility that allows ICICI Bank Credit Cardholders to transfer outstanding balances from other bank Credit Cards to the ICICI Bank Credit Card, helping reduce interest payments.

How much can I transfer through Balance Transfer?

You can transfer up to ₹3 lakh from other bank Credit Cards, provided you meet the eligibility criteria.

What are the repayment options for Credit Card Balance Transfer?

You can repay your transferred balance in easy EMIs of 3 or 6 months, ensuring flexibility in managing payments.

What is the eligibility to avail of the Balance Transfer?

To be eligible, you must have a good track record with ICICI Bank, a minimum outstanding of ₹15,000 on your other bank Credit Card, and meet the bank's internal policy checks.

How do I apply for a Credit Card Balance Transfer?

Simply SMS BT to 5676766 or call ICICI Bank Customer Care. An executive will contact you to process your request.

Are there any charges for a Credit Card balance transfer?

ICICI Bank may levy processing fees or interest for Credit Card balance transfer, depending on the card and offer. Always check Credit Card balance transfer offers before initiating.

How to monitor my Credit Card balance transfer status?

You can track the status of your Credit Card balance transfer request through the following channels:

Using the ICICI Bank iMobile App

1. Log in to the app

2. Navigate to Services

3. Select My Request to view the status of your balance transfer request

Using Net Banking

1. Log in to your Net Banking account

2. Go to Customer Service

3. Select Service Request to check the status of your request

You may also contact ICICI Bank customer care at 1800 1080 for assistance.

Credit Card Benefits

Did you know that your 
ICICI Bank Credit Card
 comes packed with exclusive benefits like complimentary airport lounge access, reward points, fuel surcharge waivers, discount coupons and other such credit card benefits? You can also track your spending, set transaction limits and convert your purchases into EMIs - with a few clicks. Here, we will walk you through how to unlock and make the most of these powerful features.

ICICI Bank Credit Cards Features

Pay Without PIN

You can pay instantly by tapping your card on the cashier's Point of Sale (POS) terminal. This terminal should support contactless payment. This is one of those Credit Card features that makes it easy and convenient to pay for your purchases.

Scan and Pay

Another popular credit card benefit is that you can link it with your Unified Payments Interface (UPI)-enabled app. To make payments, all that you will need to do is scan its QR code.

Easy Bill Payments

One of the main Credit Card advantages is that you can set up auto-pay after registering your credit card and enabling this feature via ICICI Bank Net Banking or ICICI Bank's iMobile app. This will help ensure that you never miss any of your credit card payments, saving you from penalties.

Convenience of ICICI Bank's iMobile app

By registering your credit card on the iMobile app, you will be able to keep track of your card status and ensure timely payment of bills.

Things You Should Know

How to Maximize Your Credit Card Benefits?

For example,

Mr. Rajiv spends ₹30,000 on flight tickets and earns accelerated reward points on such travel bookings.
They then convert this amount to a 3-month EMI via mobile banking, which will help you in managing your cash flow.
They use their Card to fill fuel worth ₹5,000 in their car and enjoys a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on this purchase.

All these Credit Card features are available through digital platforms, making it easy to track and control your credit card spending.

Customizing Your Credit Card Usage

To avoid overspending, Mr. Rajiv sets a monthly transaction limit of ₹50,000.
When traveling abroad, they temporarily enable international transactions for added convenience.
They regularly redeem reward points for gift vouchers and cashback.
This level of customization ensures your credit card adapts to your lifestyle, offering both flexibility and control, all with enhanced security.

Credit Card Benefits FAQs

Can I convert large purchases into EMIs?

Yes, ICICI Bank credit cards allow EMI conversion of purchases above a certain value, offering flexible payment options.

Is there any advantage to using a credit card over a debit card?

Yes, credit card advantages include building a credit history, earning rewards and access to short-term credit.

What are the advantages of a contactless credit card?

Contactless cards offer faster, more secure transactions while reducing the need to touch payment terminals.

Can I get lounge access through my credit card?

Yes, you can. Premium lounge access credit cards provide complimentary domestic lounge access, while international lounge access credit cards offer access to select international airport lounges as part of their top credit card benefits.

What are the milestone benefits of credit cards?

Milestone benefits reward you with vouchers, bonus points, or fee waivers when you reach a certain annual spend.

What are the security features of a credit card?

Security features include OTP verification, card lock or unlock and zero-liability fraud protection.

Is there a benefit to having multiple credit cards?

Yes, using multiple cards can optimise rewards and benefits across different spending categories.

Do credit cards have features to prevent overspending?

Yes, you can set daily or monthly limits and enable alerts to avoid crossing your budget. This is one of the most important Credit Card advantages.

5 benefits of using a Fuel Credit Card on your next road trip!

Are you planning a nice long road trip with friends and family, but find yourself a little fretful when it comes to fuel costs? If you are wondering how to save money on fuel costs, a quick and convenient solution is getting a Fuel Credit Card. Not only do these cards help you save money when you spend on fuel, but they also come with a range of benefits that can enhance your travel experience.

In this blog, we will take you through five key benefits of getting a 
Fuel Credit Card
 and how these cards can help you gain clarity about the best 
Credit Card
 for your next road trip.

Benefits of using Fuel Credit Cards

1. Fuel Savings -
 One of the biggest benefits of using a Fuel Credit Card is the consistent fuel savings it can bring you. Most Fuel Credit Card available in the market should offer a fuel surcharge waiver, which means you can save up to 1-2.5% on each fuel payment. Additionally, some Fuel Credit Card offer cashback, which can further reduce expenses.

With the steep prices of fuel in India today, you can save a significant amount of money by using a Fuel Credit Card. This can be especially beneficial for long road trips. It is always a good idea for you to consider the fuel surcharge waiver and available cashback offers. Compare the benefits different cards offer and choose the one that offers the maximum fuel savings.

2. Reward Points  -
 Another good reason to use a Fuel Credit Card is the Reward Points that you can earn on fuel purchases. These cards typically offer Reward Points for every fuel purchase, which can be redeemed for a range of rewards such as free fuel, cashback, gift vouchers and even travel rewards. By using your Fuel Credit Card for fueling your next road trip, you can earn great Reward Points that can be used to offset your travel expenses or even cover the cost of your next road trip.

If you are thinking of the 
best Credit Cards
 for fuel, you are bound to find a card that offers high Reward Points. Some cards offer bonus Reward Points for fuel purchases at specific fuel stations, so make sure you go for a card that provides Reward Points for fuel purchases at the fuel stations you prefer visiting.

3. Easy to Manage Expenses  -
 Using a Fuel Credit Card can also make it easier to manage expenses on your next road trip. Instead of carrying wads of cash or multiple cards, you can use one Fuel Credit Card to pay for your fuel purchases. This can also help you keep track of your fuel expenses and ensure that you don’t end up overspending on fuel. Look for a card that offers easy account management and a user-friendly mobile app. This can make it much easier to track your expenses and manage your card payments.

4. Complimentary Benefits -
 In addition to fuel savings and Reward Points, Fuel Credit Cards also offer a range of complimentary benefits that can take your travel experience to the next level. For instance, some Fuel Credit Cards may have roadside assistance, travel insurance and discounts on dining and hotel stays to offer. If you are eligible, you can leverage these complimentary benefits and change the way you travel. Consider the benefits that are relevant to your travel itinerary and choose a card that offers the maximum value.

5. Secure Transactions -
 Finally, using a Fuel Credit Card for your road trip will keep your financial transactions secure. These cards offer secure transactions that are protected by advanced security features such as chip technology, two-factor authentication and fraud protection. Most cards offered by ICICI Bank are backed by advanced security features that protect sensitive financial information. This is surely going to give you peace of mind and let you enjoy your trip to the fullest.

They come with 2000 ICICI Bank Rewards Points as soon as you activate them, you can get up to 4% cashback on your transactions, save further with a 1% surcharge waiver and save bigger with 5% cash back on select departmental stores plus mobile phone purchases and even electricity bills. Selecting the best credit card in India is an important decision that involves a thoughtful analysis of your financial habits and personal preferences. The following will guide you through the selection process

1. Evaluate your spending habits

credit card benefits

3. Check fees and charges

When choosing an ICICI Bank Credit Card, you must be mindful of the joining and annual fee. Opting for Cards with zero joining or annual fee can help with savings.

The points earned on your Credit Cards can easily be converted into excellent rewards. However, to maximise the rewards and make the redemption process even smoother, it is important to understand its process.

7. Credit Score

Keep a close eye on your credit score to ensure it meets the approval criteria for your desired ICICI Bank Credit Card. Maintaining a positive credit history can unlock various financial opportunities and access a broader range of Credit Card options suited for your needs and preferences.

8. Interest Rate

ICICI Bank’s Customer Support services, quality and reliability, ensure access to prompt and effective assistance whenever needed, to enjoy a seamless and hassle-free cardholder experience.

How To Block Your Credit Card

ICICI Bank emphasises the importance of immediate reporting to limit your liability for unauthorised transactions. One of the fundamental rules in case of a lost or stolen Credit Card is to report it promptly.

Here are some points to remember in case you want to block your Credit Card:

Blocking process

Once reported, the bank will initiate the process to block or hotlist your Credit Card. It means the Card cannot be used for any further transactions. Blocking is a security measure to prevent any misuse.

Zero liability

According to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines, customers have zero liability in case of unauthorised electronic banking transactions if reported within a specific time frame. Banks are responsible for ensuring the security of such transactions.

Replacement Card

Once your Card is blocked, banks generally initiate issuing a replacement Card. Ensure you provide accurate and up-to-date contact information to receive the new Card without delay.

Monitoring transactions

Regularly monitor your Credit Card transactions to identify any unauthorised activity. It is a recommended practice to enhance your financial security.

Customer support

ICICI Bank provides customer support to assist you in the event of Card loss or theft. Be aware of the helpline number to inform the Bank immediately.

BookMyShow

                EXPAND ALL

                            How do I avail BookMyShow offer?

Please visit www.bookmyshow.com.
Go through the regular ticketing flow for selecting the city, movie, date, cinema and show of your choice.
Confirm your details by providing your email address & mobile number as this information will be used for confirming your transaction.
Proceed to the secure payment page, enter your 16-digit ICICI bank Credit Card number in the box, name on the card, expiry and CVV card details.Please check yes to accept terms, conditions & booking policy.
To avail offer, check 'Avail Discounts & Offers' at the bottom left side of the page. Select 'Offers', select ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer from the list.
Click on the 'Apply Offer' button to successfully avail your offer.

                            How many free tickets am I entitled to every month?

A maximum of four free tickets per month are available to ICICI Bank Diamant Credit card members and a maximum of two free tickets per month are available to the other eligible card members. The number of free tickets available monthly are limited and card members can avail of this offer on a first come, first serve basis subject to daily stock availability.

                            I have a supplementary/ add-on card. Can I avail of the privileges too?

Yes, as a supplementary/ add-on card member, the privileges are also available to you.

                            Is there a limit on the price of the free movie ticket on BookMyShow?

ICICI Bank Buy 1 Get 1 offer - The free ticket price cannot exceed Rs 500 per ticket under this offer for below cards:
ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Cards
ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card
InterMiles ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Cards.
Maximum discount of 25% per ticket up to INR 150 on purchase of minimum two tickets, up to two times in a month for below cards:
ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Cards
ICICI Bank MakeMyTrip Signature Credit Cards
ICICI Bank Ferrari Signature Credit Cards
InterMiles ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Cards
ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Cards
Maximum discount of 25% per ticket up to INR 100 on purchase of minimum two tickets, up to two times in a month for below cards:
ICICI Bank Coral Credit Cards
InterMiles ICICI Bank Coral Credit Cards
ICICI Bank Ferrari Platinum Credit Cards
ICICI Bank MakeMyTrip Platinum Credit Cards
ICICI Bank Manchester United Platinum Credit Cards
There is no cap on the free ticket price for ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card.

                            Can I cancel bookings on BookMyShow?

This is subject to BookmyShow terms and conditions, tickets once bought online are considered sold and cannot be cancelled, refunded or exchanged.

                            Do I have to carry my credit card while collecting the tickets?

Yes, you have to carry your credit card while collecting the tickets. Also, once the booking is completed, the confirmation mail/ SMS received from www.bookmyshow.com needs to be displayed at the ticket counter at the movie hall.

                            Can I use the offer on individual movie hall websites also?

No. This offer is valid only for bookings via www.bookmyshow.com. BookmyShow offers bookings at a number of movie halls for your convenience.

                            I applied for the offer but my transaction did not get through. Now I am unable to avail the offer.

In case you get an error message 'Transaction failed' kindly wait for 20 minutes before trying to avail of the offer again. However, if you get an error message 'Stock for the day is exhausted', then it is likely that the stocks have been depleted.

                            My booking has been rejected, but my credit card has been charged. What do I do?

This is a very rare situation, and can occur in case of a network fluctuation at the time of confirming the transaction. In this case, a reverse request for the charge on your credit card will be sent by www.bookmyshow.com to ICICI Bank on the same day. Please be assured that if the ticket has not been successfully booked, your card payment will be reversed.

FAQs on Business Credit Card

Why Business Credit Card?

Business Credit Cards are specifically designed for entrepreneurs, proprietors and MSMEs to manage business finances more efficiently. proprietors and MSMEs to manage business finances more efficiently. Unlinke personal credit cards, they help you manage company expenses separately, build your business credit profile and access higher credit limits to support growth.

Who is the card best suited for Business Cards?

Business Credit cards are specifically designed for entrepreneurs, proprietors and MSMEs to manage business finances more efficiently .

Where can I use my Business credit card ?

You can use your Business Card to make purchases on categories such as utility payments, tax, fuel, digital marketing expenses, CSR costs, Advertising, software and license purchases, insurance, travel and entertainment etc.

Are international transactions allowed?

Yes, many ICICI Bank Business Credit Cards support international usage. Foreign currency mark-up charges may apply as per the card’s terms and conditions.

Credit Card Cancellation FAQs

Can I re-activate my Credit Card after cancellation?

Once a Credit Card is cancelled, it cannot be re-activated. You can, however, apply for a new ICICI Bank Credit Card anytime to continue enjoying benefits and offers.

Are there any outstanding dues I need to clear before requesting cancellation?

Yes, please ensure that all bills, EMIs and charges linked to your Credit Card are cleared before initiating a cancellation request.

Will I lose my reward points after cancelling my card?

Yes, any unredeemed reward points will lapse once your card is cancelled. We recommend redeeming points before submitting the cancellation request.

In the event of the cardholder’s death, how can one request for card cancellation?

The nominee of the primary cardholder can request any ICICI Bank branch for card cancellation. A copy of the death certificate of the primary Cardholder should be presented and attached with the Credit Card cancellation request form.

Will cancelling my Credit Card affect my credit score?

Yes. Closing a Credit Card reduces your total available credit limit, which may increase your credit utilisation ratio and could negatively impact your CIBIL score. When closing a Credit Card with ICICI Bank, it is advisable to consider your existing credit limits and outstanding balances.

What are the disadvantages of closing a Credit Card?

When you cancel Credit Card with ICICI Bank, you may lose reward points, reduce available credit and affect your credit history length. Plan closure carefully to avoid negatives.

Can I re-activate my Credit Card after cancellation?

Once you cancel a Credit Card, it cannot be reactivated. You will need to apply for a new card if you wish to use ICICI Bank services again.

Chip and PIN credit cards

                EXPAND ALL

                            When will I receive my Credit Card PIN? 

Your 4-digit PIN will be sent to you separately at your mailing address and should reach you within 7 working days of receiving your Credit Card.
For Ferrari Platinum Cardholders, your 4 digit PIN is sent through SMS on registered mobile number. In case your mobile number is not registered, the PIN is sent separately at your mailing address.
Alternatively, to generate PIN number for your ICICI Bank Credit Card please follow the below steps.
Net Banking:
Login to Net Banking with your user ID and Password > My Accounts > Credit Cards > Generate Credit Card PIN Online
(to be used only for Primary card Apin generation, for Addon card same is not applicable)
PIN generation through iMobile:
Login to ICICI Bank I-Mobile app > Click on Smartkeys & Services > Click on Card Services > Generate Credit card Pin. Enter the required details and Submit.
Customer Care:
Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.
To know the local Customer Care numbers, please click here.
Please note:
1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.
2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.

                            Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals? 

Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through ATMs. Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.

                            Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?

Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the Point Of Sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.

                            Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions? 

Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA/ MasterCard SecureCode/American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icic.ibank.in

                            How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card ?

Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.

                            What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card? 

ICICI Bank 
Chip Credit Cards
 come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting / duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.

                            Will I receive a separate PIN for my Add-on cards? 

Yes, you will receive a separate PIN at your mailing address for each Add-on card that has been issued to you.

                            Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN? 

All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.

Domestic Lounge Programme

Every journey now feels exceptional with a premium Domestic Airport Lounge Programme that provides access to an exclusive network of 80+ exquisite domestic airport lounges across India. Step into an environment designed for comfort, where you can relax, rejuvenate and enhance your travel experience.

Enjoy curated amenities including refined ambience, gourmet refreshments, comfortable seating and a perfect escape from the airport crowd. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Access to domestic lounges is available through your eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card, ensuring a seamless and elevated travel experience.

Note: We have updated the eligibility criteria for our domestic lounge access to enhance your travel experience. To avail this benefit, you must spend a minimum of ₹75,000 or more on your eligible Credit Card within a calendar quarter. The eligible spend entitles you to access lounge benefits in the subsequent calendar quarter.

Domestic airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders.

Emeralde Private Metal Credit Cards, Diamant Credit Cards and Times Black Credit Cards provide complimentary unlimited domestic lounge access.

For the customers with dual Credit Card variants of Rubyx and Sapphiro (Mastercard & Amex / Visa & RuPay), the benefit will be equally distributed amongst both the variants.

International Lounge Programme

Get access to a global network of 1,800+ international airport lounges across 146 countries with your Priority Pass Membership Card. Designed for comfort and convenience, these lounges provide premium seating, curated dining options and an elegant space to unwind before your flight.

With seamless worldwide access, your Priority Pass Membership Card delivers a reliable and elevated standard of service across leading international airports. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Note: The Priority Pass Membership Card is eligible for complimentary airport lounge access outside India. Customers are required to present their valid Priority Pass Membership Card at the lounge to avail the complimentary international (global) lounge access benefit. The Priority Pass Membership Card remains valid until the expiry date of the associated Credit Card. Any lounge visit exceeding the complimentary access entitlement will be chargeable. The international (global) airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders except Emeralde Private Metal, Diamant and Times Black Credit Cards.

The applicable charges for additional international lounge access will be billed to the Credit Card within 60 days from the month of usage and will appear in the subsequent statement.

The Priority Pass Membership Card is included in the Welcome Kit provided along with the eligible Credit Card.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?

The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.

Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card? 

To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.

How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?

You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.

How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?

To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:

1. Select the movie you want to watch

2. Click on ‘Book tickets’ 

3. Select the location and venue

4. Select the number of seats and proceed 

5. Click on ‘Pay’

6. Accept the T&Cs 

7. Click on the ‘Unlock Offers’ or ‘Promo Code’ button

8. Click on the ICICI Bank Credit Card option 

9. Choose the offer applicable to your Credit Card. (For example: Up to ₹ 500 off on the second ticket or 25% off up to ₹ 100 on the second ticket)

10. Enter the entire Credit Card number 

11. Make the payment when you see the ‘offer applied’ message. 

What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?

You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.

What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.

Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?

You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.

Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?

The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.

How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?

ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver. 

Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?

Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.

Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?

Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.

Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?

Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icicibank.com

How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?

Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.

What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?

ICICI Bank 
Chip Credit Cards
 come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.

Will I receive a separate PIN for my Add-on cards?

Yes, you will receive a separate PIN at your mailing address for each Add-on card that has been issued to you.

Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?

All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.

When will I receive my Credit Card PIN?

Your 4-digit PIN will be sent to you separately at your mailing address and should reach you within 7 working days of receiving your Credit Card.

For Ferrari Platinum Cardholders, your 4 digit PIN is sent through SMS on registered mobile number. In case your mobile number is not registered, the PIN is sent separately at your mailing address.

Alternatively, to generate a PIN number for your ICICI Bank Credit Card please follow the below steps.

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to Net Banking with your user ID and Password > My Accounts > Credit Cards > Generate Credit Card PIN Online

(to be used only for Primary card PIN generation, for add-on card same is not applicable)

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to ICICI Bank's iMobile app > Click on Smartkeys & Services > Click on Card Services > Generate credit card PIN. Enter the required details and Submit.

Customer Care:

Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.

To know the local Customer Care numbers, please 
click here
.

Please note:

1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.

2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.

How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:

Visit the BookMyShow website

Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets

Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”

Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”

Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction

How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.

Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Domestic Lounge Programme

Every journey now feels exceptional with a premium Domestic Airport Lounge Programme that provides access to an exclusive network of 80+ exquisite domestic airport lounges across India. Step into an environment designed for comfort, where you can relax, rejuvenate and enhance your travel experience.

Enjoy curated amenities including refined ambience, gourmet refreshments, comfortable seating and a perfect escape from the airport crowd. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Access to domestic lounges is available through your eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card, ensuring a seamless and elevated travel experience.

Note: We have updated the eligibility criteria for our domestic lounge access to enhance your travel experience. To avail this benefit, you must spend a minimum of ₹75,000 or more on your eligible Credit Card within a calendar quarter. The eligible spend entitles you to access lounge benefits in the subsequent calendar quarter.

Domestic airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders.

Emeralde Private Metal Credit Cards, Diamant Credit Cards and Times Black Credit Cards provide complimentary unlimited domestic lounge access.

For the customers with dual Credit Card variants of Rubyx and Sapphiro (Mastercard & Amex / Visa & RuPay), the benefit will be equally distributed amongst both the variants.

International Lounge Programme

Get access to a global network of 1,800+ international airport lounges across 146 countries with your Priority Pass Membership Card. Designed for comfort and convenience, these lounges provide premium seating, curated dining options and an elegant space to unwind before your flight.

With seamless worldwide access, your Priority Pass Membership Card delivers a reliable and elevated standard of service across leading international airports. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Note: The Priority Pass Membership Card is eligible for complimentary airport lounge access outside India. Customers are required to present their valid Priority Pass Membership Card at the lounge to avail the complimentary international (global) lounge access benefit. The Priority Pass Membership Card remains valid until the expiry date of the associated Credit Card. Any lounge visit exceeding the complimentary access entitlement will be chargeable. The international (global) airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders except Emeralde Private Metal, Diamant and Times Black Credit Cards.

The applicable charges for additional international lounge access will be billed to the Credit Card within 60 days from the month of usage and will appear in the subsequent statement.

The Priority Pass Membership Card is included in the Welcome Kit provided along with the eligible Credit Card.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?

The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.

Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card? 

To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.

How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?

You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.

How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?

To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:

1. Select the movie you want to watch

2. Click on ‘Book tickets’ 

3. Select the location and venue

4. Select the number of seats and proceed 

5. Click on ‘Pay’

6. Accept the T&Cs 

7. Click on the ‘Unlock Offers’ or ‘Promo Code’ button

8. Click on the ICICI Bank Credit Card option 

9. Choose the offer applicable to your Credit Card. (For example: Up to ₹ 500 off on the second ticket or 25% off up to ₹ 100 on the second ticket)

10. Enter the entire Credit Card number 

11. Make the payment when you see the ‘offer applied’ message. 

What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?

You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.

What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.

Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?

You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.

Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?

The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.

How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?

ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver. 

Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?

Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.

Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?

Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.

Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?

Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icicibank.com

How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?

Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.

What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?

ICICI Bank 
Chip Credit Cards
 come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.

Will I receive a separate PIN for my Add-on cards?

Yes, you will receive a separate PIN at your mailing address for each Add-on card that has been issued to you.

Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?

All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.

When will I receive my Credit Card PIN?

Your 4-digit PIN will be sent to you separately at your mailing address and should reach you within 7 working days of receiving your Credit Card.

For Ferrari Platinum Cardholders, your 4 digit PIN is sent through SMS on registered mobile number. In case your mobile number is not registered, the PIN is sent separately at your mailing address.

Alternatively, to generate a PIN number for your ICICI Bank Credit Card please follow the below steps.

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to Net Banking with your user ID and Password > My Accounts > Credit Cards > Generate Credit Card PIN Online

(to be used only for Primary card PIN generation, for add-on card same is not applicable)

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to ICICI Bank's iMobile app > Click on Smartkeys & Services > Click on Card Services > Generate credit card PIN. Enter the required details and Submit.

Customer Care:

Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.

To know the local Customer Care numbers, please 
click here
.

Please note:

1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.

2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.

How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:

Visit the BookMyShow website

Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets

Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”

Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”

Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction

How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.

Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Chip and PIN Credit Cards FAQs

          Search FAQs

Chip and PIN credit cards

                EXPAND ALL

                            When will I receive my Credit Card PIN? 

Your 4-digit PIN will be sent to you separately at your mailing address and should reach you within 7 working days of receiving your Credit Card.
For Ferrari Platinum Cardholders, your 4 digit PIN is sent through SMS on registered mobile number. In case your mobile number is not registered, the PIN is sent separately at your mailing address.
Alternatively, to generate PIN number for your ICICI Bank Credit Card please follow the below steps.
Net Banking:
Login to Net Banking with your user ID and Password > My Accounts > Credit Cards > Generate Credit Card PIN Online
(to be used only for Primary card Apin generation, for Addon card same is not applicable)
PIN generation through iMobile:
Login to ICICI Bank I-Mobile app > Click on Smartkeys & Services > Click on Card Services > Generate Credit card Pin. Enter the required details and Submit.
Customer Care:
Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.
To know the local Customer Care numbers, please click here.
Please note:
1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.
2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.

                            Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals? 

Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through ATMs. Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.

                            Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?

Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the Point Of Sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.

                            Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions? 

Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA/ MasterCard SecureCode/American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icic.ibank.in

                            How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card ?

Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.

                            What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card? 

ICICI Bank 
Chip Credit Cards
 come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting / duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.

                            Will I receive a separate PIN for my Add-on cards? 

Yes, you will receive a separate PIN at your mailing address for each Add-on card that has been issued to you.

                            Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN? 

All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.

The concierge service is provided by a third party and is bound by such third party terms and conditions.

ICICI Bank does not offer the services and is not representative of the delivery, quality and sustainability of products or services availed from the concierge service provider.

Any disputes as regards delivery, quality and sustainability of products or services availed of under this offer must be addressed in writing to the concierge service provider directly and the bank will not entertain any communication in this regard.

The concierge service provider reserves the right to decline fulfillment of any card member request that is outside of the scope of services as agreed with ICICI Bank.

Card members will be required to pay for any purchase or booking that they have agreed to accept, once that request has been fulfilled by our concierge provider. Payments should be made with your valid ICICI Bank Credit Card. ICICI Bank or the concierge provider will not be responsible for any third party expenses incurred. Such expenses shall be borne by the Card member.

In case of any medical concierge services, the concierge service provider shall not be responsible for determining the appropriate medical specialist for your particular problem nor for providing medical diagnosis or treatment. The concierge service provider shall not be liable for any consequences arising out of or howsoever caused by the services provided by the Medical Service Providers referred by us. The final selection of the Medical Service Provider will be the card member's responsibility. The listed Services are purely on referral or arrangement basis International medical services are available to a card member when they travel outside India for periods not exceeding 90 consecutive days per trip.

Additional terms and conditions may apply to a particular service or benefit or as may be specified from time to time.

ICICI Bank reserves the right to disqualify any Card Member or Members from the benefits of the Program. In case of any fraudulent activity, prosecution will be carried out according to the purpose of availing the benefits under the Program.

ICICI Bank reserves the right to modify or change all or any of the terms applicable to the Program without assigning any reasons or without any prior intimation whatsoever.

ICICI Bank also reserves the right to discontinue the Program without assigning any reasons or without any prior intimation whatsoever.
