ICICI Bank Rupay Credit Card FAQs

Does the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card provide discounts on movie tickets?

Yes, the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card does provide discounts on movie tickets.

What is the benefit of using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card offers seamless savings and convenience. Easily link it to UPI for quick and secure payments to merchants, with wide acceptance nationwide and hassle-free transactions.

Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

Yes. You can easily make online purchases across India and in select overseas stores using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card.

What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it in my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

Flip your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card. The 3-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging in to your iMobile app or Net Banking.

What is the age limit to apply for a RuPay Credit Card?

You must be between the age of 21 and 65 years to be eligible to apply for the RuPay Credit Card.

How do I know the payment due date of the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

You can find the payment due date of your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card either through the monthly statement, iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling Customer Care on 1800 1080.

How do I link the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with iMobile for UPI payments?

Please follow the steps below to link your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with iMobile:

Step 1: Download and log into the iMobile app

Step 2: Select ‘UPI Payments’

Step 3: Click on ‘UPI Settings

Step 4: Select ‘RuPay Credit Card’

Step 5: Click on ‘Enter Last 6 digits of Credit Card’ and enter the corresponding digits of the Credit Card Number

Step 6: Enter your 4-digit PIN

Step 7: Click on ‘Confirm’.

Will I need a separate UPI PIN for my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card for payments?

Please find the details below:

iMobile: No separate UPI PIN needs to be created, existing UPI PIN will suffice. Third-Party Apps: A separate UPI PIN needs to be created for ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card when linking it to carry out UPI payments on other UPI apps

What are the pre-requisites for linking the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card on iMobile?

The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card can be linked on the iMobile app post 1 hour of the RuPay Credit Card creation. For non-QR code UPI transactions (e.g. online payments), online transactions must be enabled for your Credit Card. QR code-based iMobile UPI transactions can be initiated after the RuPay Credit Card is successfully linked to UPI.

How can I pay a merchant using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card on UPI?

You can make payments using the iMobile app by following the path below: Open iMobile > Scan any QR > Select ‘Pay with RuPay Credit Card > Enter UPI PIN > Confirm 

Payments can also be made using your UPI ID payments by entering your UPI OD at merchant apps/ websites and then approving the request on iMobile at the path below: Log into iMobile > UPI Payments > Payment Requests > Accept.

Do I need to have the same mobile number linked to my UPI app as well as my RuPay Credit Card?

Yes, the mobile number used on UPI apps should be same as the mobile number linked to your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card. If you have changed your mobile number, please update the same for your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card as well. After updating, you will need to re-register the Credit Card on the UPI app.

What are the pre-requisites for linking the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with third-party UPI payment apps, i.e. UPI apps other than iMobile?

ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card expiry details need to be entered for the Card to be linked to third-party UPI apps.

Can I make a UPI payment to any person or other Credit Card using my linked ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

No, only Person to Merchant (P2M) (e.g. payments at stores, websites etc.) are allowed from the linked Credit Card. Other types of payments are not allowed.

Can I link my Visa/ MasterCard/ Diners Credit Card on UPI?

Currently, as per RBI guidelines, only RuPay Credit Cards can be linked on UPI.

What are the limits on transactions allowed from a linked Credit Card on UPI?

There is no limit for the number of transactions carried out from a linked Credit Card on UPI. However, the limit on the transaction amount allowed from linked Credit Cards on UPI is governed by the UPI transaction limits set by the National Payments corporation of India (NPCI) and the Credit Limit provided to you on your Credit Card (whichever is lower).

What are the restricted merchant categories on which customers are not allowed to make UPI payments, using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

Customers are not allowed to make the following UPI payments using the linked Credit Card:

P2P: Person-to-Person, e.g. paying an individual 

P2PM: Person-to-Person Merchant, i.e. paying an individual who is acting like a business

Digital account opening

Online lending platforms

Cash withdrawal at ATMs and merchants

Electronic Rupee Unified Payments Interface (ERUPI)

Payments for IPO investments

Foreign Inward Remittances

Payments for investments in Mutual Funds

and any other categories, as restricted by ICICI Bank from time to time.

Can I make my linked Credit Card as a default account to receive funds?

No, funds cannot be received on a linked Credit Card through UPI.

Do I need to enable Card controls on the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card for online transactions?

Yes, you need to enable online transactions on your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card using iMobile/ Net Banking to use Credit Cards for regular online purchases as well as online UPI transactions.

If my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card is renewed, do I need to link it again to UPI?

Yes, in case the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card is renewed or replaced, you have to re-register the Credit Card in the UPI apps you use.

Where can I see the UPI transactions on my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

ICICI Bank Credit Card transactions through UPI will be available in your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card statement every month. The statement can be checked on iMobile at Credit Cards > View Statement and on Net Banking at Cards > Credit Cards > Statement.

Will I earn any reward points for UPI spends using ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

Yes, UPI spends using Credit Card will earn reward points as per the reward point structure of the respective Credit Card.

Will I get any surcharge waiver on fuel purchases made using RuPay Credit Card via UPI mode?

Fuel surcharge waiver will be applicable as per the respective Credit Card features. For more details about UPI transactions using the RuPay Credit Card, 
click here
 .

How do I see my Credit Card Number online?

To view your ICICI Bank Credit Card Number online, log into iMobile or Net Banking and view your Credit Card details.

How do I link my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with UPI to make payments?

You can link your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with UPI using the iMobile app. Please follow the steps below:

Log into iMobile

Click on the 'UPI Payments' tab

Click on 'UPI Settings'

Click on the button at the bottom-right side of the screen

Select 'RuPay Credit Card'

Select the desired bank whose Credit Card you want to link

Verify the Card details, set the UPI PIN and you are ready to go!

You can now use your RuPay Credit Card for UPI payments at merchant outlets which support the same.

How to maintain credit score

If you manage credit responsibly, your scores will be maintained.

We have put together major factors that affect your credit score and what you can do about them -

Use your Instant Credit Card regularly.

Make payments on time. Late payments or defaults indicate that you are unable to manage the expense. If you have to make partial payments, try to pay back at least 50–75% of the outstanding.

Stay within your credit limit. A high utilization of credit limit may indicate that your income is not sufficient to manage expenses.

Apply for new credit in moderation – only as much as you need. Make an informed decision to apply for loans or cards at multiple lenders.

Responsible use of 
Credit Cards
 indicates that you are financially secure and in control of your expenses. This may make lenders view future loan applications favorably.

How to track credit score

Your credit rating and scores are held in a report accessible through a credit agency or bureau. Banks and other financial institutions from whom you may have taken a card or loan report your credit behavior to these independent credit bureaus.

Your ICICI Bank Instant Credit Card scores will be reported to CIBIL or the Credit and Information Bureau of India Limited.

Make sure that you review your credit scores frequently by ordering your Credit Information Report or CIR from the credit bureau.

.

You may have already taken credit or will need to, at some time – in the form of education, auto or home loans or Credit Cards.

FAQs

Credit

When you buy something today and pay for it later, you have just taken Credit.

Simply put, credit can help you get the things you want when you don't have enough cash.

Credit Card

Your credit card is a form of credit - a substitute for money in the form of a plastic card enabling you to buy now but pay later.

You can use them to make purchases in millions of places, both in store or online.

You can also use Credit Cards for Balance Transfers and taking out cash from an ATM.

And if you need money for an emergency or unforeseen expenditure, you don't have to apply for loans at the eleventh hour – you already carry one in the form of a credit card.

Secured Credit Card

The ICICI Bank Instant Credit Card is a secured credit card, i.e., it is issued against the security of a Fixed Deposit. It is an excellent choice to help you begin building a good credit score.

Credit Score

Your credit score is a number that indicates to lenders how "credit worthy" you are.

It is calculated using records of how well you are repaying or have repaid any credit.

Most lenders provide repayment information to credit reference agencies or credit bureaus (CIBIL in India) which calculate and maintain your credit score.

This score is used for decisions on whether to lend further to you, without which, it is difficult for lenders to know whether you will repay your borrowing on time.

How to maintain credit score

If you manage credit responsibly, your scores will be maintained.

We have put together major factors that affect your credit score and what you can do about them -

Use your Instant Credit Card regularly.

Make payments on time. Late payments or defaults indicate that you are unable to manage the expense. If you have to make partial payments, try to pay back at least 50–75% of the outstanding.

Stay within your credit limit. A high utilization of credit limit may indicate that your income is not sufficient to manage expenses.

Apply for new credit in moderation – only as much as you need. Make an informed decision to apply for loans or cards at multiple lenders.

Responsible use of 
Credit Cards
 indicates that you are financially secure and in control of your expenses. This may make lenders view future loan applications favorably.

How to track credit score

Your credit rating and scores are held in a report accessible through a credit agency or bureau. Banks and other financial institutions from whom you may have taken a card or loan report your credit behavior to these independent credit bureaus.

Your ICICI Bank Instant Credit Card scores will be reported to CIBIL or the Credit and Information Bureau of India Limited.

Make sure that you review your credit scores frequently by ordering your Credit Information Report or CIR from the credit bureau.

.

FAQs

Credit

When you buy something today and pay for it later, you have just taken Credit.

Simply put, credit can help you get the things you want when you don't have enough cash.

Credit Card

Your credit card is a form of credit - a substitute for money in the form of a plastic card enabling you to buy now but pay later.

You can use them to make purchases in millions of places, both in store or online.

You can also use Credit Cards for Balance Transfers and taking out cash from an ATM.

And if you need money for an emergency or unforeseen expenditure, you don't have to apply for loans at the eleventh hour – you already carry one in the form of a credit card.

Secured Credit Card

The ICICI Bank Instant Credit Card is a secured credit card, i.e., it is issued against the security of a Fixed Deposit. It is an excellent choice to help you begin building a good credit score.

Credit Score

Your credit score is a number that indicates to lenders how "credit worthy" you are.

It is calculated using records of how well you are repaying or have repaid any credit.

Most lenders provide repayment information to credit reference agencies or credit bureaus (CIBIL in India) which calculate and maintain your credit score.

This score is used for decisions on whether to lend further to you, without which, it is difficult for lenders to know whether you will repay your borrowing on time.

Credit Card fees and interest rates

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Joining Fee and Annual Fee

The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.

Interest Charge

Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.

Late Payment Fee

If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.

Over-the-Limit Fee

You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.

GST

Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

Tips for secure Credit Card usage

Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants

Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity

Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies

Never save your Card information on any websites

Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone

In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.

FAQs on Credit Card

What is a Credit Card?

A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history. 

What is Credit Card balance? 

Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.

Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?

Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?

To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, 
click here
.

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.

How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card. 

What is a RuPay Credit Card?

A 
RuPay Credit Card
 is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, you can easily apply for a

About NRI Credit Cards

Eligibility criteria for NRI Credit Card

NRI Credit Card eligibility and assessment criteria can differ from bank to bank, considering factors like income, employment and financial history.

NRIs qualify for ICICI Bank Credit Cards with:

A valid NRE or NRO Account with sufficient funds

A stable income

Good credit history

Contact your ICICI Bank Relationship Manager for a specific Card assessment.

Document checklist for NRI Credit Cards

Submit these documents to apply for an ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card:

Copy of valid passport

Work permit, employment visa or admission letter

proof of Indian address, such as a passport, utility bill or bank statement

proof of foreign address, including recent utility bills, residence permit or property tax receipt

PAN Card or Form 60 if PAN is unavailable

FATCA or CRS declaration, as applicable

Exclusive travel benefits

ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards deliver premium travel perks for seamless journeys. Key features include airport lounge access via select Cards and airline partnerships. Additional benefits might include priority check-in and bonus miles on flights.

Benefits of choosing ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card

ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards provide convenience to Non-Resident Indians managing expenses in India and abroad. These Cards are linked to NRE or NRO Accounts and offer rewards alongside practical usage benefits.

Access hassle-free online payments in Indian rupees and international currencies. International transactions attract foreign exchange charges

Withdraw cash from international ATMs in local currency, subject to applicable fees and conversion costs

Earn reward points and cashback on domestic transactions within India on everyday spends

Enjoy perks of exclusive airline partnerships like lounge access, priority check-in and bonus miles.

Add family members as supplementary Cardholders to share benefits conveniently

Reward and cashback offers

Earn cashback on fuel, shopping, and dining. Get discounts on BookMyShow, Inox, and major retail brands. Some cards offer annual fee waivers based on spending thresholds.

FAQ for NRI Credit Card

Who is eligible for an ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card?

Non-Resident Indians (NRE / NRO Account holders) with valid proof of overseas address, passport, visa and a satisfactory credit score are eligible. Income criteria might vary for different Credit Card types.

What documents are required to apply for an NRI Credit Card?

You need a passport, visa, overseas address proof, Indian bank account details and income proof. Some Cards might require additional documentation based on the eligibility criteria.

What are the benefits of an ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card?

ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards offer exclusive benefits such as cashback on fuel and shopping, reduced forex markup, complimentary airport lounge access and special travel privileges with partner airlines.

Can I use my ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card for international transactions?

Yes, ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards are designed for global use, with lower forex markup. Some Cards come with additional privileges like Skyward Miles, making them ideal for frequent international travellers.

How can I apply for an ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card?

You can apply by visiting any ICICI Bank Branch or by contacting NRI Customer Care. Ensure you have all the required documents before you apply, in order to expedite the process.

Do ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards come with complimentary lounge access?

Certain ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards offer complimentary lounge access at domestic and international airports through airline partnerships. Some of the NRI Credit Cards that offer lounge access include premium variants like Sapphiro, Emeralde, Rubyx and Coral. These Cards offer complimentary domestic and international airport lounge visits based on quarterly spending thresholds being met.

Can I get a Credit Card against my NRE Account?

Yes, ICICI Bank issues NRE Account Credit Cards supporting both domestic and international transactions in Indian rupees and foreign currencies. These suit NRIs who need global usability, unlike NRO Cards limited to India. You must maintain adequate funds to qualify for an NRE Credit Card.

What is an NRO Credit Card and who can apply?

An NRO Credit Card from ICICI Bank is linked to a Non-Resident Ordinary (NRO) Account for domestic transactions only in Indian rupees, making it ideal for India-based expenses. NRIs holding valid NRO Accounts can qualify for this Card. It differs from NRE Credit Cards in the form of restrictions on international use.

About Credit Cards offers

With ICICI Bank 
Credit Card
 offers, you have another reason to live it up! Save up on cars, electronics, watches, apparels, jewellery, movie tickets, food outlets and even get great deals on your travel plans with these online 
Credit Card offers
.

Explore various Credit card offers from ICICI Bank

Making transactions completely effortless, ICICI Bank Credit Cards are the easiest way to spend on whatever you like, wherever you like! To avail credit card offers online, simply put in the required credentials while you shop on your favourite e-stores and get your cash back/discounts right away.

Credit Card offers by categories

Explore a world of exclusive Credit Card offers tailored to your lifestyle and interests. 

Credit Card issuers have revolutionised how we shop, dine, travel and entertain ourselves. These Cards cater to various categories, ensuring you make the most of your purchases and experiences. 

Shopping:

Credit Cards offer attractive discounts at top merchant outlets, brands and online stores. From daily essentials to special purchases, you will find many discounts while using your Credit Card for transactions.   

Lifestyle:

Elevate your lifestyle with Credit Cards that offer exclusive discounts on products from top brands. Whether you are upgrading your wardrobe or investing in quality items, there is a Credit Card designed to make it more affordable.   

Entertainment:

Enjoy your favourite movies, concerts and events while saving money. Credit Cards provide discounts and special offers for various recreational activities, ensuring you can indulge in them without overspending. 

Travel:

Travel enthusiasts can unlock a treasure chest of benefits with specific Credit Cards. These Cards offer advantages like international travel perks, flight and hotel booking discounts, complimentary access to airport lounges, air miles and more. Your Credit Card is your ticket to a world of travel privileges.

Reward Points:

You can earn valuable reward points with every purchase you make using your Credit Card. As these points accumulate, you can redeem them for exciting gifts, convert them into cashback or benefit from various other redemption options. The more you spend, the more you earn – it is a rewarding experience. Credit Cards have evolved to offer a wide array of advantages, ensuring that every transaction you make and every experience you enjoy contributes to a more rewarding and fulfilling lifestyle. So, choose the Credit Card that aligns with your preferences and start availing the best offers.

Credit Card fees and interest rates

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Joining Fee and Annual Fee

The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.

Interest Charge

Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.

Late Payment Fee

If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.

Over-the-Limit Fee

You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.

GST

Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

Tips for secure Credit Card usage

Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants

Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity

Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies

Never save your Card information on any websites

Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone

Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions

In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.

Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts

Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.

Do's

Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges

Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities

Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.

Don’ts

Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone

Don't exceed your credit limit

Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card

What is a Credit Card?

A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history. 

What is Credit Card balance? 

Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.

Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?

Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?

To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, 
click here
.

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.

How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card. 

What is a RuPay Credit Card?

A 
RuPay Credit Card
 is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, you can easily apply for a 
Loan on your Credit Card
 if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Joining Fee and Annual Fee

The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.

Interest Charge

Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.

Late Payment Fee

If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.

Over-the-Limit Fee

You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.

GST

Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

Benefits of ICICI Bank Credit Cards

Below are some of the benefits that you can enjoy with an ICICI Bank Credit Card:

Convenient Transactions

Online shopping, bill payments and in-store purchases are all made simple and rewarding with ICICI Bank Credit Cards.

Establish a Credit Profile

Regular use and timely payments of your ICICI Bank Credit Card will increase your credit score over time and contribute to the development of a robust credit profile.

Perks on Purchases

Make your purchases more fulfilling with discounts and reward points on almost every transaction.

Secure Transactions

Your purchases are secured with features like contactless payments and scan-and-pay alternatives.

Tips for secure Credit Card usage

Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants

Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity

Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies

Never save your Card information on any websites

Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone

Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions

In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.

Credit Cards: Do's and don’ts

Credit Cards are very convenient to make purchases but there are always some Do's & Don’ts you need to look out for.

Do's

Always pay your bills on time and in full to have a robust credit history and to avoid paying interest charges

Always check your Credit Card statements regularly so that you can check for and report any fraudulent activities

Always use your Credit Card wisely to avoid falling into a debt trap.

Don’ts

Don't share your Credit Card information with anyone

Don't exceed your credit limit

Don't make late payments.

FAQs on Credit Card

What is a Credit Card?

A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history. 

What is Credit Card balance? 

Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.

Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?

Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?

To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, 
click here
.

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.

How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card. 

What is a RuPay Credit Card?

A 
RuPay Credit Card
 is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, you can easily apply for a 
Loan on your Credit Card
 if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

About NRI Credit Cards

Eligibility criteria for NRI Credit Card

NRI Credit Card eligibility and assessment criteria can differ from bank to bank, considering factors like income, employment and financial history.

NRIs qualify for ICICI Bank Credit Cards with:

A valid NRE or NRO Account with sufficient funds

A stable income

Good credit history

Contact your ICICI Bank Relationship Manager for a specific Card assessment.

Document checklist for NRI Credit Cards

Submit these documents to apply for an ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card:

Copy of valid passport

Work permit, employment visa or admission letter

proof of Indian address, such as a passport, utility bill or bank statement

proof of foreign address, including recent utility bills, residence permit or property tax receipt

PAN Card or Form 60 if PAN is unavailable

FATCA or CRS declaration, as applicable

Exclusive travel benefits

ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards deliver premium travel perks for seamless journeys. Key features include airport lounge access via select Cards and airline partnerships. Additional benefits might include priority check-in and bonus miles on flights.

Benefits of choosing ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card

ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards provide convenience to Non-Resident Indians managing expenses in India and abroad. These Cards are linked to NRE or NRO Accounts and offer rewards alongside practical usage benefits.

Access hassle-free online payments in Indian rupees and international currencies. International transactions attract foreign exchange charges

Withdraw cash from international ATMs in local currency, subject to applicable fees and conversion costs

Earn reward points and cashback on domestic transactions within India on everyday spends

Enjoy perks of exclusive airline partnerships like lounge access, priority check-in and bonus miles.

Add family members as supplementary Cardholders to share benefits conveniently

Reward and cashback offers

Earn cashback on fuel, shopping, and dining. Get discounts on BookMyShow, Inox, and major retail brands. Some cards offer annual fee waivers based on spending thresholds.

FAQ for NRI Credit Card

Who is eligible for an ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card?

Non-Resident Indians (NRE / NRO Account holders) with valid proof of overseas address, passport, visa and a satisfactory credit score are eligible. Income criteria might vary for different Credit Card types.

What documents are required to apply for an NRI Credit Card?

You need a passport, visa, overseas address proof, Indian bank account details and income proof. Some Cards might require additional documentation based on the eligibility criteria.

What are the benefits of an ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card?

ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards offer exclusive benefits such as cashback on fuel and shopping, reduced forex markup, complimentary airport lounge access and special travel privileges with partner airlines.

Can I use my ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card for international transactions?

Yes, ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards are designed for global use, with lower forex markup. Some Cards come with additional privileges like Skyward Miles, making them ideal for frequent international travellers.

How can I apply for an ICICI Bank NRI Credit Card?

You can apply by visiting any ICICI Bank Branch or by contacting NRI Customer Care. Ensure you have all the required documents before you apply, in order to expedite the process.

Do ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards come with complimentary lounge access?

Certain ICICI Bank NRI Credit Cards offer complimentary lounge access at domestic and international airports through airline partnerships. Some of the NRI Credit Cards that offer lounge access include premium variants like Sapphiro, Emeralde, Rubyx and Coral. These Cards offer complimentary domestic and international airport lounge visits based on quarterly spending thresholds being met.

Can I get a Credit Card against my NRE Account?

Yes, ICICI Bank issues NRE Account Credit Cards supporting both domestic and international transactions in Indian rupees and foreign currencies. These suit NRIs who need global usability, unlike NRO Cards limited to India. You must maintain adequate funds to qualify for an NRE Credit Card.

What is an NRO Credit Card and who can apply?

An NRO Credit Card from ICICI Bank is linked to a Non-Resident Ordinary (NRO) Account for domestic transactions only in Indian rupees, making it ideal for India-based expenses. NRIs holding valid NRO Accounts can qualify for this Card. It differs from NRE Credit Cards in the form of restrictions on international use.

Credit Card fees and interest rates

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Joining Fee and Annual Fee

The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.

Interest Charge

Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.

Late Payment Fee

If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.

Over-the-Limit Fee

You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.

GST

Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

Tips for secure Credit Card usage

Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants

Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity

Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies

Never save your Card information on any websites

Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone

Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions

In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.

FAQs on Credit Card

What is a Credit Card?

A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history. 

What is Credit Card balance? 

Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.

Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?

Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?

To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, 
click here
.

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.

How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card. 

What is a RuPay Credit Card?

A 
RuPay Credit Card
 is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, you can easily apply for a 
Loan on your Credit Card
 if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Cards Against Fixed Deposit or FD Card

An ICICI Bank Fixed Deposit (FD) Credit Card is an instant Credit Card that is issued to you against your Fixed Deposit (FD) with ICICI Bank. Get up to 90% of your Fixed Deposit amount as your credit limit and enjoy the flexibility of choosing from two Credit Card variants tailored to meet your life-stage requirements. 

APPLY NOW

Benefits of Fixed Deposit Credit Cards

Choice of variants    

Choose from two Credit Card variants based on your needs

ICICI Bank Instant Platinum Credit Card

ICICI Bank Coral Credit Card

Generous credit limit

Get up to 90% of your Fixed Deposit amount as your credit limit.

Liquidity on-the-go

Your Fixed Deposit Credit Card ensures that you always have access to funds. Thus, you can use it for all your requirements.

Earn interest on your Fixed Deposit

Your Fixed Deposit continues to earn interest even as it is used as collateral for your Fixed Deposit Credit Card.

How to Apply for an ICICI Bank Fixed Deposit Credit Card

ICICI Bank's iMobile app

Net Banking 

Log into ICICI Bank's iMobile app

Open an Fixed Deposit with ICICI Bank

Choose your preferred Fixed Deposit Credit Card variant - ICICI Bank Instant Platinum Credit Card or ICICI Bank Coral Credit Card

Activate your Fixed Deposit Credit Card through ICICI Bank's iMobile app

Start using your Fixed Deposit Credit Card for all your transactions and enjoy the benefits

Log in to Net Banking

Open a Fixed Deposit with ICICI Bank

Things you should know

The minimum Fixed Deposit value required to get a Fixed Deposit Credit Card is ₹50,000
Fixed Deposit Credit Cards will be available against Fixed Deposits opened with a minimum tenure of 180 days
Fixed Deposit should be in auto renewal mode
Your Fixed Deposit will earn interest as per the prevailing fixed interest rate applicable for the tenure for which the Fixed Deposit was opened 
Interest earned on your Fixed Deposit is subject to Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)
A maximum of one secured card is allowed

Credit Card Against Fixed Deposit FAQs

What is a Fixed Deposit Credit Card?

A fixed deposit credit card, also known as a credit card against fixed deposit, is a unique product that gives you a complimentary instant Credit Card against your Fixed Deposit. This Credit Card offers twin benefits: liquidity and safety.

How can I apply for an Fixed Deposit Credit Card?

Applying for an ICICI Bank Fixed Deposit Credit Card is very simple and convenient. Just use any of the following methods: 

Visit a branch: 

If you prefer face-to-face assistance, simply visit any ICICI Bank branch. Our team there will guide you through the application process, ensuring that you have all the necessary documents and information

Apply Online: 

If you prefer the convenience of online banking, simply log into your ICICI Bank Net Banking account or the ICICI Bank's iMobile app, navigate to the Fixed Deposits section, click on ‘Open Fixed Deposit Card’ and follow the steps to complete your application.

What are the benefits of using a Credit Card against Fixed Deposit?

Using a Credit Card against Fixed Deposit provides immediate access to funds while ensuring that your savings remain secure. This allows you to enjoy liquidity without compromising your capital. In addition, it helps you build or improve your credit history, making it easier for you to take larger loans or get a larger credit limit in future.

What is the minimum Fixed Deposit amount required to get an Fixed Deposit Credit Card? 

You have to open a Fixed Deposit of minimum ₹50,000 to get a Fixed Deposit Credit Card. This ensures that you have sufficient funds as collateral against which a Credit Card can be issued.

Can I use my Fixed Deposit to get a Credit Card?

Yes, you can use your Fixed Deposit to get a Credit Card. The Fixed Deposit serves as collateral, allowing you to get a credit limit of up to 90% of your Fixed Deposit amount.

What are the eligibility criteria for an Fixed Deposit Credit Card?

To be eligible for a Fixed Deposit Credit Card, your Fixed Deposit amount must be ₹50,000 or more and it should be opened in auto-renewal mode. 

What interest rate is offered on the Fixed Deposit in a Fixed Deposit Credit Card?

The interest rate offered on the Fixed Deposit in an Fixed Deposit Credit Card is the same as that offered on standard Fixed Deposits. This means your investment continues to earn interest while also being used as collateral for your Credit Card.

What are the benefits of a Fixed Deposit Credit Card?

There are multiple benefits of an Fixed Deposit Credit Card like instant approval, low interest rates on Credit Card repayments, improvement of your credit score and minimal documentation.

What happens if I need to close my Fixed Deposit while having a Fixed Deposit Credit Card?

If you need to close your Fixed Deposit, you will have to first pay any outstanding dues on your Fixed Deposit Credit Card. After clearing the dues, you can close your Fixed Deposit.

ICICI Bank Credit Card bill FAQs

How can I pay my ICICI Bank Credit Card bill?

You can pay using the following authorised modes:

ICICI Bank Internet Banking

iMobile app

Scan to Pay (UPI)

ATMs

Auto Debit

NEFT (for other bank accounts)

Click to Pay (for non-ICICI Bank customers)

Cash Deposit at ICICI Bank branches (₹100 + GST applicable)

Ensure you use only authorised payment modes to avoid delays.

Can I pay my Credit Card bill using another bank account?

Yes, you can pay from any other bank using the NEFT facility or platforms like Click to Pay and Scan to Pay (UPI-based). Ensure correct card number and IFSC (ICIC0000004) for NEFT transactions.

When should I pay my Credit Card bill?

Ideally, pay before the due date to avoid interest and late payment charges. Bills are typically due 15–20 days after the statement generation date

What is the ideal time to pay the Credit Card bill?

The best time to pay is well before the due date. Early payment helps avoid charges and boosts credit health. Paying in full is always recommended.

Should I pay my Credit Card bill in full?

Yes, paying the total outstanding amount helps avoid interest charges and keeps your credit score strong. If unable to pay in full, pay at least the ‘Minimum Due’.

What is the ‘Minimum Due’ on a Credit Card?

It’s the minimum amount payable by the due date to avoid late fees. It typically includes interest, fees and a small part of the outstanding principal.

Can I pay my bill immediately after a purchase?

Yes, you can pay anytime. However, the charge will reflect in the next billing cycle. Early payments can help with better spend management and avoid overspending.

How is a Credit Card payment processed?

Here’s the simplified journey:

Initiate the transaction using your card.

Card details are shared with the recipient’s bank.

The bank routes the request via a payment network.

Card issuer verifies and approves/declines the transaction.

Once approved, the transaction is completed.

How long does it take for my Credit Card bill payment to reflect?

Credit Card bill payment usually reflects instantly or within a few hours after a  successful transaction. In some cases, it may take up to one working day depending on the payment mode used.

Are there any convenience fees for Credit Card bill payments?

ICICI Bank does not levy convenience charges for Credit Card bill payment made through its digital platforms. However, third-party payment channels may have separate fee structures.

How can I resolve payment failures or disputes?

If your Credit Card payment fails or there is a discrepancy, check transaction status through the ICICI Bank Net Banking or iMobile app. For unresolved issues, contact ICICI Bank customer care with transaction details.

How do I get a payment receipt or invoice for my Credit Card bill?

After successful Credit Card bill payment, you can download the payment receipt from the confirmation screen or access it later through transaction history in ICICI Bank Net Banking or iMobile app.

Are there any convenience fees for Credit Card bill payments?

ICICI Bank does not levy convenience charges for Credit Card bill payment made through its digital platforms. However, third-party payment channels may have separate fee structures.

How can I resolve payment failures or disputes?

If your Credit Card payment fails or there is a discrepancy, check transaction status through the ICICI Bank Net Banking or iMobile app. For unresolved issues, contact ICICI Bank customer care with transaction details.

How do I get a payment receipt or invoice for my Credit Card bill?

After successful Credit Card bill payment, you can download the payment receipt from the confirmation screen or access it later through transaction history in ICICI Bank Net Banking or iMobile app.

Credit Card Eligibility - Check Criteria & Documents Required

2 mins Read

               | 5 Years 8 Months Ago

APPLY NOW

KNOW MORE

Over the years, with higher disposable income, consumption patterns have undergone a drastic change. People are seeking different methods of paying for their purchases, especially those that offer benefits like short-term credit, reward points or discounts. This has led to a rising preference for Credit Cards. Credit Cards also make shopping safer and provide a range of benefits to customers. While India is still primarily a Debit Card market, the use of Credit Cards is rising rapidly.

Understanding Credit Card eligibility, including age , salary, nationality and credit score, is essential before applying for an ICICI Bank Credit Card.

Credit Card issuers (e.g., banks) have strict eligibility criteria for approving a Credit Card and conduct a thorough background check before issuing one. Understanding credit card eligibility, including age, salary, nationality, and more, is essential before applying ICICI Bank Credit Card While specific eligibility criteria may differ, most banks have similar conditions, as detailed in this blog post.

Credit Card Eligibility Requirements

Age:
 To 
apply for a Credit Card
, one needs to be at least 18 years old. However, since a large majority of the adult population does not start earning by 18, most banks issue a Credit Card only after the applicant has attained the age of 21. Just like the minimum age, the maximum age differs for every bank, with most banks issuing Credit Cards till the age of 60.
Annual Income: 
Credit Cards offer credit for a short period of time. One has to pay one’s pending dues at the end of every month. Banks take into account the repayment ability of the applicant before issuing a Credit Card. The annual income of the applicant is one of the most important factors in the issuance of a Credit Card. Typically, banks demand a net annual income of ₹ 2.5 lakh for Credit Cards. However, some banks have stricter eligibility criteria.         
Nationality: 
Citizens, residents and non-residents can apply for a Credit Card, but some banks issue Credit Cards only to Indian nationals. It is important to check the exact Credit Card eligibility with the specific bank before applying for a Credit Card.

Other Factors Affecting Credit Card Eligibility

Credit Score: 
With the emergence of digital payments and tools, it has become easier to track the spending patterns of customers. Specialised credit agencies ascertain an applicant’s level of financial discipline through their spending pattern and repayment of dues. These agencies give a 
credit score
 to every customer depending on his/her past financial behaviour. Banks use the credit score to determine whether a Credit Card should be issued or not. A high credit score helps in getting a Credit Card easily. Banks require a credit score between 750 and 900 to issue a Credit Card.
Existing Debt:
 When you use a Credit Card, you essentially take on debt, i.e. avail a short-term loan. If you already have a lot of debt, it doesn’t make sense for banks to provide you with a tool for additional debt. Having existing debt that exceeds your permissible credit limit can affect your chances of getting a Credit Card.
Employment:
 Banks generally wouldn’t like to trust an applicant who doesn’t have a stable source of income, since that has a direct impact on their ability to repay their dues. Accordingly, the employment status of an applicant has a significant impact on his/her chances of getting a Credit Card. Being employed for over a year increases your chances substantially as it signals that you have a stable job and you will be able to pay your Credit Card dues on time.
Residence:
 While you can apply for a Credit Card online, certain banks take your place of residence into consideration. Some Credit Cards are only available to people residing in a particular city or region.

Documents Required to Apply for a Credit Card with ICICI Bank:

KYC: 
Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence

Address Verification: 
Utility bills (electricity, water, gas), Passport or Aadhaar Card

Income Proof: 
Salary slips or latest bank statement

PAN Card or Form 60

Recent passport-sized photographs.

Complete and accurate information is needed to process your Credit Card application efficiently.

Additional Documents

To apply for a Credit Card, you might be asked to submit extra documents like business registration certificate or financial statements, depending on the Card type.

Credit Card Eligibility FAQs

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies according to the issuer and Card type but typically ranges from ₹ 2.5 lakh to ₹ 3 lakh annually.

What is the age eligibility requirement for an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

To apply for an ICICI Bank Credit Card, you should be between 21 years and 100 years of age.

Do Credit Card issuers require income proof?

Yes, Credit Card issuers require income proof to assess your ability to repay your Credit Card dues. Lenders might ask for salary slips, bank statements or tax returns. Income verification helps determine your credit limit and eligibility.

What should one do to qualify for a Credit Card?

To qualify for a Credit Card, maintain a good credit score, provide proof of stable income, meet age requirements (usually 18+ years) and submit necessary documents like photo ID and address proof. Banks may have specific criteria, so check individual requirements before applying.

What is the age eligibility requirement for an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

The eligibility to get a Credit Card depends on factors such as age, income stability, employment type, repayment capacity and overall credit profile.

What are the common reasons for Credit Card application rejection?

Credit Card applications may be rejected due to a low credit score, insufficient income, high existing debt, incomplete documents or multiple recent applications.

What is the minimum CIBIL score for Credit Card approval?

A CIBIL score above 750 is preferred for smoother Credit Card approval.

One should opt for a Credit Card only if he/she is confident of repaying the Card dues without delays. Credit Card Eligibility - Check Criteria & Documents Required

2 mins Read

               | 5 Years 8 Months Ago

APPLY NOW

KNOW MORE

Over the years, with higher disposable income, consumption patterns have undergone a drastic change. People are seeking different methods of paying for their purchases, especially those that offer benefits like short-term credit, reward points or discounts. This has led to a rising preference for Credit Cards. Credit Cards also make shopping safer and provide a range of benefits to customers. While India is still primarily a Debit Card market, the use of Credit Cards is rising rapidly.

Understanding Credit Card eligibility, including age , salary, nationality and credit score, is essential before applying for an ICICI Bank Credit Card.

Credit Card issuers (e.g., banks) have strict eligibility criteria for approving a Credit Card and conduct a thorough background check before issuing one. Understanding credit card eligibility, including age, salary, nationality, and more, is essential before applying ICICI Bank Credit Card While specific eligibility criteria may differ, most banks have similar conditions, as detailed in this blog post.

Credit Card Eligibility Requirements

Age:
 To 
apply for a Credit Card
, one needs to be at least 18 years old. However, since a large majority of the adult population does not start earning by 18, most banks issue a Credit Card only after the applicant has attained the age of 21. Just like the minimum age, the maximum age differs for every bank, with most banks issuing Credit Cards till the age of 60.
Annual Income: 
Credit Cards offer credit for a short period of time. One has to pay one’s pending dues at the end of every month. Banks take into account the repayment ability of the applicant before issuing a Credit Card. The annual income of the applicant is one of the most important factors in the issuance of a Credit Card. Typically, banks demand a net annual income of ₹ 2.5 lakh for Credit Cards. However, some banks have stricter eligibility criteria.         
Nationality: 
Citizens, residents and non-residents can apply for a Credit Card, but some banks issue Credit Cards only to Indian nationals. It is important to check the exact Credit Card eligibility with the specific bank before applying for a Credit Card.

Other Factors Affecting Credit Card Eligibility

Credit Score: 
With the emergence of digital payments and tools, it has become easier to track the spending patterns of customers. Specialised credit agencies ascertain an applicant’s level of financial discipline through their spending pattern and repayment of dues. These agencies give a 
credit score
 to every customer depending on his/her past financial behaviour. Banks use the credit score to determine whether a Credit Card should be issued or not. A high credit score helps in getting a Credit Card easily. Banks require a credit score between 750 and 900 to issue a Credit Card.
Existing Debt:
 When you use a Credit Card, you essentially take on debt, i.e. avail a short-term loan. If you already have a lot of debt, it doesn’t make sense for banks to provide you with a tool for additional debt. Having existing debt that exceeds your permissible credit limit can affect your chances of getting a Credit Card.
Employment:
 Banks generally wouldn’t like to trust an applicant who doesn’t have a stable source of income, since that has a direct impact on their ability to repay their dues. Accordingly, the employment status of an applicant has a significant impact on his/her chances of getting a Credit Card. Being employed for over a year increases your chances substantially as it signals that you have a stable job and you will be able to pay your Credit Card dues on time.
Residence:
 While you can apply for a Credit Card online, certain banks take your place of residence into consideration. Some Credit Cards are only available to people residing in a particular city or region.

Documents Required to Apply for a Credit Card with ICICI Bank:

KYC: 
Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence

Address Verification: 
Utility bills (electricity, water, gas), Passport or Aadhaar Card

Income Proof: 
Salary slips or latest bank statement

PAN Card or Form 60

Recent passport-sized photographs.

Complete and accurate information is needed to process your Credit Card application efficiently.

Additional Documents

To apply for a Credit Card, you might be asked to submit extra documents like business registration certificate or financial statements, depending on the Card type.

Credit Card Eligibility FAQs

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies according to the issuer and Card type but typically ranges from ₹ 2.5 lakh to ₹ 3 lakh annually.

What is the age eligibility requirement for an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

To apply for an ICICI Bank Credit Card, you should be between 21 years and 100 years of age.

Do Credit Card issuers require income proof?

Yes, Credit Card issuers require income proof to assess your ability to repay your Credit Card dues. Lenders might ask for salary slips, bank statements or tax returns. Income verification helps determine your credit limit and eligibility.

What should one do to qualify for a Credit Card?

To qualify for a Credit Card, maintain a good credit score, provide proof of stable income, meet age requirements (usually 18+ years) and submit necessary documents like photo ID and address proof. Banks may have specific criteria, so check individual requirements before applying.

What is the age eligibility requirement for an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

The eligibility to get a Credit Card depends on factors such as age, income stability, employment type, repayment capacity and overall credit profile.

What are the common reasons for Credit Card application rejection?

Credit Card applications may be rejected due to a low credit score, insufficient income, high existing debt, incomplete documents or multiple recent applications.

What is the minimum CIBIL score for Credit Card approval?

A CIBIL score above 750 is preferred for smoother Credit Card approval.

Credit Card fees and interest rates

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Joining Fee and Annual Fee

The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.

Interest Charge

Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.

Late Payment Fee

If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.

Over-the-Limit Fee

You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.

GST

Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

FAQs on Credit Card

What is a Credit Card?

A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history. 

What is Credit Card balance? 

Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.

Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?

Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.

How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card. 

What is a RuPay Credit Card?

A 
RuPay Credit Card
 is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, you can easily apply for a 
Loan on your Credit Card
 if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Joining Fee and Annual Fee

The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.

Interest Charge

Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.

Late Payment Fee

If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.

Over-the-Limit Fee

You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.

GST

Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

FAQs on Credit Card

What is a Credit Card?

A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history. 

What is Credit Card balance? 

Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.

Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?

Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?

To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, 
click here
.

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.

How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card. 

What is a RuPay Credit Card?

A 
RuPay Credit Card
 is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, you can easily apply for a 
Loan on your Credit Card
 if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Card fees and interest rates

Are you familiar with the charges applicable on your Credit Card transactions? Given below are the six common types of Credit Card charges.

Joining Fee and Annual Fee

The Joining Fee is the initial cost of owning the Credit Card. It varies from bank to bank and also depends on the type of card. It is usually followed by an Annual Fee.

Interest Charge

Interest charges are levied on all new transactions and on outstanding dues, due to non-payment of the same by the due date. The maximum charge is 3.75% per month.

Late Payment Fee

If you are unable to pay the outstanding amount, the Bank will notify you to pay the minimum amount. In case you fail to pay the minimum amount, a late payment fee is charged.

Over-the-Limit Fee

You are assigned a credit limit based on the type of Credit Card you hold. If you spend beyond this limit, the bank will charge an over-the-limit fee which is ~2.50% on the amount spent beyond the credit limit.

GST

Goods and Service Tax (GST) is applicable on certain Credit Card transactions. Presently, the GST rate for banking and financial services is 18%.

To know more about fees and charges please refer to the MITC - PDF (Most Important Terms and Conditions).

Benefits of ICICI Bank Credit Cards

Below are some of the benefits that you can enjoy with an ICICI Bank Credit Card:

Convenient Transactions

Online shopping, bill payments and in-store purchases are all made simple and rewarding with ICICI Bank Credit Cards.

Establish a Credit Profile

Regular use and timely payments of your ICICI Bank Credit Card will increase your credit score over time and contribute to the development of a robust credit profile.

Perks on Purchases

Make your purchases more fulfilling with discounts and reward points on almost every transaction.

Secure Transactions

Your purchases are secured with features like contactless payments and scan-and-pay alternatives.

Tips for secure Credit Card usage

Use your Credit Card at reliable and trusted merchants

Set up SMS alerts for transactions to detect any fraudulent activity

Always check your Credit Card statement for any discrepancies

Never save your Card information on any websites

Use strong, unique passwords and never share your Credit Card information with anyone

Never use your Credit Card on public WiFi networks or for unsecured transactions

In case of fraud or theft, report the same at the earliest to make use of the Card Protection Plan.

What is a Credit Card?

A Credit Card is a payment tool that allows you to make purchases without paying for them immediately. It is widely accepted and you do not need to always carry cash with you. The Bank issues this Card based on your income and other eligibility criteria. The bank sets a limit on how much you can spend on the card. However, you must repay the amount you have spent on the Card within a specified time. If you are late in making the payment, you will have to pay interest along with additional charges.

What is the limit of a Credit Card?

A Credit Card limit is the maximum amount that you can spend in a month on that Credit Card. It is decided by the bank that has issued the Card and depends on factors like your income, credit score and credit history. 

What is Credit Card balance? 

Credit Card balance is the balance available to be spent from the sanctioned credit limit of the card. You can use this balance to pay for goods or services online as well as in-store (Point of Sale, i.e. POS) and also for cash withdrawal.

Can I use my ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions?

Yes, you can use an ICICI Bank Credit Card for international transactions. Please activate your card for international transactions using ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

How do I check the application status of ICICI Bank Credit Card?

To check the status of your ICICI Bank Credit Card application, 
click here
.

What is the minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card?

The minimum salary required to apply for a Credit Card varies from bank to bank and depends on the type of Credit Card. Generally, a minimum monthly salary of ₹20,000 is required for basic Credit Cards in India. Check the specific requirements on the issuer bank’s website before you proceed with the online application process.

How do I apply for a Credit Card without a salary?

Applying for a Credit Card without salary is possible. However, the issuer bank might ask you to open a Fixed Deposit as collateral to issue the Credit Card. 

What is a RuPay Credit Card?

A 
RuPay Credit Card
 is an innovative Credit Card integrated with the RuPay payment network. The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card enhances your payment experience, offering an array of rewards, discounts and leisure benefits, making it an optimal choice for your everyday expenses.

Can I get a Loan on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, you can easily apply for a 
Loan on your Credit Card
 if you hold any ICICI Bank Credit Card and have a good history of transactions and repayment on the same. However final approval depends on the bank’s internal policy.

Credit Dictionary - A to Z of Credit

Credit Terms – A To Z Of Credit

Empower yourself with this easy to follow dictionary – a compilation of terms to help you understand credit cards better.

GET INSTANT CREDIT CARD
