Account or Card Number

This number (on the front of your credit card) represents your Credit card account.

Annual Fee

A fee you pay once a year for the use of a 
credit card
. This fee is not based on your balance and has no impact on your interest or credit limit. It's usually a single, flat fee charged once a year.

Annual Percentage Rate (APR)

The yearly percentage rate of interest charged when a balance outstanding is held (i.e not re-paid) on a credit card.

Auto Debit

An instruction given by you for automatically transferring payments from your savings account to your Credit Card account.

Bad Credit

This usually means a poor credit score or credit rating. Many things can damage your credit score, like missed payments, late payments or default on payments.

Cash Advance

The amount of cash your withdraw using your credit card at a bank or ATM. This cash is withdrawn from your Card account and draws interest from the day of withdrawal itself – there is no grace period or interest holiday on this amount.

Cash Limit

The maximum amount of cash that you can withdraw on your credit card account. Cash-Limit forms a subset of your overall Credit Limit.

Card member

The person that the credit card was issued to, or another person who is authorized to use the card.

Card Verification Value or CVV

A three digit security code, usually found on the back of your credit card, above the signature. This code is unique to each card and is sometimes used to identify you for secure Internet, mail or phone purchases.

Card Verification Value or CVV

A three digit security code, usually found on the back of your credit card, above the signature. This code is unique to each card and is sometimes used to identify you for secure Internet, mail or phone purchases.

Chargeback

If you find a fraudulent or unauthorized transaction on your card account, you need to report the same to the card issuing company. They may temporarily reverse the transaction in your account till the investigation into fraud charges are completed. This reversal is often referred to as a "chargeback".

Chargeslip

A paper slip generated when your transaction is authorized using a swipe machine at a shop or store. You will be asked to sign the chargeslip as proof of your acceptance and authorization of such transaction on your card account. Also see swipe machines.

Collateral

Money or assets (such as property) that you put down as security to prove to a lender that you're able to pay back what you owe. In case of default on payments, lenders are likely to take possession of the collateral to make good their dues.

Credit

Credit means buying something now and paying for it at a later date with or without interest.

Credit Bureau

An organization that collects details of credit behaviour from various sources to create your credit score or credit rating. These credit scores and ratings create your credit history overtime.

Credit Card Number

The number stamped or embossed on your credit card. Also see Account number.

Credit History

The history of your credit use. It lists whether or not you've made your payments on time, stayed within your limit and practiced good credit habits.

Credit Limit

The highest amount of money you are authorized to spend on your credit card account. Going over your credit limit often can affect your credit score and you may be charged a fee.

Credit Report

A report showing a "snapshot" of your credit history in Canada that you can request from the credit bureaus. Detailed reports can be purchased for a reasonable fee, but simpler versions can often be ordered by mail for free.

Credit Score

This is a number that reflects your general "credit worthiness". Created by credit bureaus, it's one of the factors lenders use when deciding to give you credit. Also see Credit Bureau.

Default

Generally, the failure to make your payments. When you don't make your payments on time, you're said to have "defaulted".

Delinquent account

When you don't make your payments against loans or credit cards on time, your loan or card account is termed as "Delinquent account"

EMI

EMI refers to Equated Monthly Installments. When you make a large purchase or take a large loan, you can choose to pay back over a fixed period of time. The amount to be paid back (principal + interest) is divided into equal parts that you need to pay every month. This is termed as an "Equated Monthly Installment".

Fraudulent Transaction

An unauthorized use of your account or credit card without your knowledge or consent.

Fraudulent User

Someone other than you who uses your card or account without your consent.

Grace Period

A length of time in which a lender will allow you to pay your credit balance without paying interest and/or late fees. This is a feature of most credit cards except in case of Cash advances.

Interest Rate

The percentage rate of interest charged when a balance outstanding is held (i.e not re-paid) on a credit card. This is usually stated as a monthly or yearly rate.

Lender

In reference to the world of credit, "Lender" usually means any financial institution or company that gives you access to credit, such as credit cards, lines of credit, or mortgages.

Late Payment Charges or LPC

Most Credit cards allow a fixed time or grace period towards credit card outstanding. A failure to make the payment on time often attracts a penalty in the form of Late Payment Charges. This is usually a fixed amount and not related to the amount of outstanding payment due. Also see Grace period.

Merchant Establishment

The shop or company or establishment where you use your credit card, including for online purchases. Merchant establishments may ask you to authenticate your card transactions and are custodians of the card swiping machines

Minimum Amount Due or MAD

The absolute minimum amount you need to pay on your credit card balance every month to keep your account in good standing and to avoid LPC. This is usually a percentage of the total amount outstanding on your card account.

Network

VISA, MasterCard and American Express are key "network" companies that allow information exchange between merchant establishments and credit card issuing companies to authorize and track transactions all over the world.

Overlimit

Any credit used on a credit account that has gone over the credit limit. Most credit card companies will allow, rather than decline such transactions to avoid inconvenience of a declined transaction. You may be charged extra fees for this.

Overlimit Charges / Fee

A fee you may be charged for allowing your balance to go above your credit limit.

Payment Due Date

This refers to the date every month, on which the payment towards your card or loan account is due. If payments are missed on this date, your account will attract penalty or interest charges or both.

Phishing

E-mail fraud, or "phishing", is an Internet scam in the form of an e-mail. The e-mails link to sites that look like well-known legitimate businesses and ask you to provide or confirm personal, financial, or password information. Always check the url displayed before filling up information online – the urls will not be those of your financial institution in case of a phishing scam.

Principal

Principal or principal amount refers to the base amount of money that has been lent to you. Any charges or interest are calculated on this base amount and together principal, interest and charges form the total amount you may need to pay back to the lenders.

PIN

The Personal Identification Number allocated to you by the Bank or chosen by you which is used for authenticating the Card member.

Revolving Credit

Payment towards your credit card account is normally due on a set date or payment due date. If you make partial or no payments on this date, you access "revolving credit" as the outstanding on your card account has now exceeded the grace period and has "revolved" into a new payment cycle. Revolving credit will attract interest charges.

Secured Credit Cards

Unlike unsecured credit cards, these are cards that require you to offer collateral or security. At ICICI Bank, such security is required in the form of a Fixed Deposit. Secured credit cards are recommended for newcomers with no credit history or those who are trying to improve their credit rating.

Supplementary Card member

Another person who shares your credit account – usually a family member. As the main card member, you will still be responsible for all transactions, usage and payments.

Security Deposit

A sum of money, paid up front, as security in case a borrower defaults on their credit. In case of Secured Credit Cards, this is usually in the form of a Fixed Deposit with the issuing Bank.

Statement

A document from your lender that lists all the transactions you have made on your account or your payment schedules. This is usually sent once a month.

Swiping machine

Electronic data capturing machines that you see at stores and shops which are used to swipe your card in order to access information to authorize your transaction

Terms & Conditions

The terms and conditions applicable to the product or service or line of credit that you have taken from a bank or lender. The most updated Terms & Conditions are mostly available on the lender's website.

Total Amount Due or TAD

The total amount you need to pay on your credit card. This amount should match all the transactions or purchases that you have made on your card account.

Unsecured Credit Cards

Unlike secured credit cards, these are cards that don't require collateral or security. To qualify for unsecured credit, you'll need to have a good credit history as well as sufficient income that show you can repay your debts.

How to increase your Credit Card limit

Understanding the how and why of increasing your 
Credit Card
 limit is an important part of managing your finances. In this article, let us explore the world of credit limits, understand why they matter and learn how to increase them.

APPLY NOW

Benefits of increasing your Credit Card limit

Improved credit score

Your credit score is calculated based on several factors, including your credit utilisation ratio. By increasing your credit limit, you can increase your available credit which can lower your credit utilisation ratio and improve your credit score.

Greater purchasing power

Another significant benefit of greater your Credit Card limit is increased purchasing power. This can be especially beneficial in emergencies or for large purchases that may be difficult to pay for all at once.

Enhanced rewards

With an increase in your Credit Card limit, you can spend and thus earn more reward points. Be it accumulating points for travel or taking advantage of special promotions, a higher credit limit allows you to leverage reward point programmes more effectively.

Better financial flexibility

With a higher credit limit you have more options when it comes to making purchases and managing your finances. This can help you to feel more in control of your finances.

How the Credit Card limit works

Let us try to understand how credit limit works for users who hold multiple Credit Cards Rohan has 3 Credit Cards instead of just one. Let’s call these cards as Card A, Card B and Card C, each with a credit limit of ₹ 5 lakh, i.e.

1. Credit limit of Card A: ₹ 5 lakh

2. Credit limit of Card B: ₹ 5 lakh

3. Credit limit of Card C: ₹ 5 lakh

The maximum amount that Rohan can spend is taken collectively across all his Cards. So, the maximum amount that can be spent on Card A + Card B + Card C is ₹ 5 lakh.

ICICI Bank Credit Card Limit Increase FAQs

What are the main Credit Card types?

The main types of Credit Cards offered by ICICI Bank are Platinum, Coral, Rubyx, Sapphiro and Emeralde. You can learn more about several other Credit Cards for travel, lifestyle, shopping and more, like 
Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card,

MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card
, 
Adani One ICICI Bank Credit Cards
 and 
Emirates Skywards Credit Card
 by exploring our website. 

What is the lowest Credit Card limit?

The Credit Card limit varies depending on the Card issuer. Please call our Customer Care on 1800 1080 to get more information.

How do I apply for a Credit Card online?

You can apply for a Credit Card on the ICICI Bank website. Select a Card that best suits your needs, check the eligibility criteria and fill out the application form. You can also visit any ICICI Bank Branch where a representative will help you through the process. Don't forget to have your documents like ID proof, address proof and income statements ready.

What are the ways to increase my ICICI Bank Credit Card limit?

You may request a Credit Card limit increase through ICICI Bank’s iMobile app or Net Banking. Eligibility depends on repayment history, income profile and internal assessment.

Is it good to increase my Credit Card limit?

A higher limit may improve spending flexibility. However, responsible usage and timely repayment remain important to maintain financial discipline and account regularity.

Why was my credit limit increase request denied?

A request may be declined due to internal assessment, repayment history or eligibility criteria. Customers may review account performance before submitting a fresh request.

Benefits of increasing your Credit Card limit

Improved credit score

Your credit score is calculated based on several factors, including your credit utilisation ratio. By increasing your credit limit, you can increase your available credit which can lower your credit utilisation ratio and improve your credit score.

Greater purchasing power

Another significant benefit of greater your Credit Card limit is increased purchasing power. This can be especially beneficial in emergencies or for large purchases that may be difficult to pay for all at once.

Enhanced rewards

With an increase in your Credit Card limit, you can spend and thus earn more reward points. Be it accumulating points for travel or taking advantage of special promotions, a higher credit limit allows you to leverage reward point programmes more effectively.

Better financial flexibility

With a higher credit limit you have more options when it comes to making purchases and managing your finances. This can help you to feel more in control of your finances.

How the Credit Card limit works

Let us try to understand how credit limit works for users who hold multiple Credit Cards Rohan has 3 Credit Cards instead of just one. Let’s call these cards as Card A, Card B and Card C, each with a credit limit of ₹ 5 lakh, i.e.

1. Credit limit of Card A: ₹ 5 lakh

2. Credit limit of Card B: ₹ 5 lakh

3. Credit limit of Card C: ₹ 5 lakh

The maximum amount that Rohan can spend is taken collectively across all his Cards. So, the maximum amount that can be spent on Card A + Card B + Card C is ₹ 5 lakh.

Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card: FAQs

What is the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card?

The Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card is designed for cricket enthusiasts. You will get benefits like complimentary match tickets, Meet and Greet sessions with players and a chance to attend a training session.

What are the benefits of the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card?

It offers benefits such as fuel surcharge waiver, complimentary match tickets, ICICI Bank Reward Points and Meet and Greet sessions with top players.

How to apply for the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card online?

You can visit the ICICI Bank website and choose the Card you want to apply for, follow the steps and complete your application. The Card will be issued in a few working days.

What is the joining fee for the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card? 

The joining fee for the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card is ₹500 + GST.

What are the joining benefits of the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card? 

You will receive 2,000 ICICI Bank Reward Points as a joining and renewal gift. 

What are the annual benefits of the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You will receive an annual fee waiver on spending more than ₹1,50,000 in the previous year.

What exclusive benefits can I get with this Card?

A chance to meet your favourite cricket players, attend a training session of the CSK team and receive autographed merchandise from a marquee player. 

How can I earn Reward Points on this card?

You can easily earn 10 Reward Points on every ₹100 spent (except fuel) on CSK match days. You can redeem these points for gifts and rewards.

What exclusive benefits can a top spender enjoy with the Chennai Super Kings Credit Card?

The top spender gets the following exclusive benefits:

An exclusive meet-and-greet session with select players

An opportunity to attend a practice session with the Chennai Super Kings team

Complimentary tickets to a Chennai Super Kings home match, during the playing season.

To enjoy domestic lounge access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.

Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card: FAQs

What is the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card?

The Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card is designed for cricket enthusiasts. You will get benefits like complimentary match tickets, Meet and Greet sessions with players and a chance to attend a training session.

What are the benefits of the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card?

It offers benefits such as fuel surcharge waiver, complimentary match tickets, ICICI Bank Reward Points and Meet and Greet sessions with top players.

How to apply for the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card online?

You can visit the ICICI Bank website and choose the Card you want to apply for, follow the steps and complete your application. The Card will be issued in a few working days.

What is the joining fee for the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card? 

The joining fee for the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card is ₹500 + GST.

What are the joining benefits of the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card? 

You will receive 2,000 ICICI Bank Reward Points as a joining and renewal gift. 

What are the annual benefits of the Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You will receive an annual fee waiver on spending more than ₹1,50,000 in the previous year.

What exclusive benefits can I get with this Card?

A chance to meet your favourite cricket players, attend a training session of the CSK team and receive autographed merchandise from a marquee player. 

How can I earn Reward Points on this card?

You can easily earn 10 Reward Points on every ₹100 spent (except fuel) on CSK match days. You can redeem these points for gifts and rewards.

What exclusive benefits can a top spender enjoy with the Chennai Super Kings Credit Card?

The top spender gets the following exclusive benefits:

An exclusive meet-and-greet session with select players

An opportunity to attend a practice session with the Chennai Super Kings team

Complimentary tickets to a Chennai Super Kings home match, during the playing season.

To know more about the Top Spender campaign, 
click here
 .

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

To enjoy domestic lounge access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.

Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria, click here. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here
.

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your Chennai Super Kings ICICI Bank Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period. 

Please go through the below illustration to understand the spends period along with the lounge eligibility period:

Spends period offer -  eligibility period

Spend ₹25,000 between Dec 26, 2025 and Mar 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between Apr 01, 2026 and June 30, 2026. 

 Spend ₹25,000 between Mar 26, 2026 and June 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between July 01, 2026 and Sep 30, 2026.

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here 
.

Add-on/Plus card members need to individually spend ₹25,000 in the preceding spends quarter, to be eligible for the offer in the subsequent calendar quarter

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section 

 Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking 

 Choose ICICI Bank Credit Card 25% Discount Offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards 

 Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’ 

 Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page. 

What are the movie ticket benefits available?

Cardholders are eligible for a 25% off on movie ticket offer worth up to ₹100 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here
.

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please click here

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplemental) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

Culinary Treats

Flavourful Savings with Every Bite

Enjoy great dining deals with ICICI Bank. Use your ICICI Bank Card on Swiggy, Eazydiner to get special offers. Find partner restaurants, book easily, and save on every meal.

Apply now

Swiggy

Enjoy delivery from top-rated restaurants with quality meals at great value

Eazydiner

Hassle-free table booking. Reserve tables at over 15,000 restaurants and explore authentic cuisines with ease.

 How to avail Culinary Treat Offer

Use your ICICI Bank Credit Card to access Culinary Treats

Visit Swiggy, Eazydiner platforms

Choose your favourite restaurant or meal

Pay with your ICICI Bank Credit Card to unlock offers

Enjoy exclusive discounts and a premium dining experience

Important Things to Know

Offers are applicable only on

ICICI Bank Credit Cards
. Debit Cardholders may not be eligible for all listed discounts.
Platform-specific T&Cs apply (Swiggy, Eazydiner). Offers may vary based on partner, location and availability.
Discounts are valid only on eligible spends and categories. Alcohol, taxes and delivery fees may be excluded.
Advance booking or promo code usage may be required. For Eazydiner, use applicable codes during checkout.
No additional fee for availing Culinary Treats offers. Standard credit card usage fees apply.
ICICI Bank reserves the right to modify or withdraw offers. Changes can occur without prior notice as per bank's policy.

FAQs

Who can avail the Culinary Treats offers?

ICICI Bank Credit Card holders are eligible to avail exclusive dining offers through partners like Swiggy and Eazydiner.

Do I need a promo code to access the offers?

Yes, certain offers, especially on Eazydiner, may require entering a promo code during checkout. Please check the specific platform’s terms and conditions before booking or ordering.

Can I use these offers in any city?

Offers are available across multiple cities in India, but availability may vary by partner platform and restaurant location. Always check for eligible outlets near you on the respective partner apps or websites.

1. Fees and Charges

A. Fees payable on the Credit Card by the Card Member

Annual fee: The annual fee for each card member may vary and is communicated when applying for the Credit Card. These fees are billed to the card account and stated in the card statement. 
Renewal fees: Similar to annual fees, renewal fees may apply.

B. Cash Advance Fee

When using the Credit Card to access cash from ATMs in India or abroad, a transaction fee is levied on the amount withdrawn, billed in the following statement.

The transaction fee is subject to change at ICICI Bank's discretion.
All cash advances also carry a finance charge until full payment, which is subject to change.

C. Charges

Certain charges and fees apply to card members for specific services or defaults regarding their card account.
ICICI Bank retains the right to alter or introduce new charges or fees with customer notification.

D. Interest-Free Period

The interest-free credit period ranges from a certain number of days, depending on the specific Credit Card scheme and merchant claim submission.
Not applicable if the previous month's balance remains unpaid or if the card member availed cash from an ATM.

2. Limits

ICICI Bank determines the card member's credit and cash withdrawal limits, communicated during card delivery and in monthly statements.
The available credit limit may change based on internal criteria, with immediate customer notification.
Card members can request credit limit increases by providing financial documents.

3. Billing and Statement

Monthly finance charges apply to transactions and cash advances not paid in full.
Finance charges on cash advances apply from the transaction date until payment.
Cardholders paying less than the amount due will incur finance charges on outstanding balances and new transactions until the previous dues are paid.

The Bank sends reminders for outstanding dues; third parties may be involved for collections.
ICICI Bank has a right of lien and set off on the card member's monies if the card account balance is not repaid within the prescribed time.

Monthly statements reflect payments, transactions and outstanding balances.
Card members can pay the minimum amount due or the total amount due by the payment due date.
Payments may be made through various channels including Net Banking, ATMs, Phone Banking, NEFT Fund Transfer and more.

4. Right of Lien

The Bank can set off any card member's monies in any account/custody if the card balance is not repaid.

5. Termination/Revocation of the Card Membership

Card members can terminate the card membership by submitting a written request and cutting the cards.
The bank may restrict/terminate the card's use for unusual transaction patterns, non-payment or exceeding the credit limit.
The Bank reserves the right to suspend the facility on the Credit Card if default occurs.

6. Loss or Theft or Misuse of Card

Card members must immediately notify the 24–hour Call Centre if the card is lost, stolen or misused.
The Bank is not liable for transactions incurred before reporting the loss.
Card members are responsible for losses due to fraudulent or careless actions.

7. Reward Points

Reward points are earned for transactions as per the terms and conditions.
Reward points are valid for a specified duration.
Several terms and conditions apply to reward points, including reversals for certain transactions.

8. Disclosure

The Bank can disclose information related to Credit Cards to credit bureaus without notice.
Card members are responsible for updating themselves with regulatory guidelines.

9. Lounge Access

Charges may apply for lounge access exceeding complimentary limits.
Lounge access details vary by card variant.
Safety and non-transferability of Priority Pass should be ensured.
These terms and conditions are subject to change at the discretion of ICICI Bank. For specific charges and details, please refer to the Schedule of Charges available from ICICI Bank.

Domestic Lounge Programme

Every journey now feels exceptional with a premium Domestic Airport Lounge Programme that provides access to an exclusive network of 80+ exquisite domestic airport lounges across India. Step into an environment designed for comfort, where you can relax, rejuvenate and enhance your travel experience.

Enjoy curated amenities including refined ambience, gourmet refreshments, comfortable seating and a perfect escape from the airport crowd. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Access to domestic lounges is available through your eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card, ensuring a seamless and elevated travel experience.

Note: We have updated the eligibility criteria for our domestic lounge access to enhance your travel experience. To avail this benefit, you must spend a minimum of ₹75,000 or more on your eligible Credit Card within a calendar quarter. The eligible spend entitles you to access lounge benefits in the subsequent calendar quarter.

Domestic airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders.

Emeralde Private Metal Credit Cards, Diamant Credit Cards and Times Black Credit Cards provide complimentary unlimited domestic lounge access.

For the customers with dual Credit Card variants of Rubyx and Sapphiro (Mastercard & Amex / Visa & RuPay), the benefit will be equally distributed amongst both the variants.

International Lounge Programme

Get access to a global network of 1,800+ international airport lounges across 146 countries with your Priority Pass Membership Card. Designed for comfort and convenience, these lounges provide premium seating, curated dining options and an elegant space to unwind before your flight.

With seamless worldwide access, your Priority Pass Membership Card delivers a reliable and elevated standard of service across leading international airports. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Note: The Priority Pass Membership Card is eligible for complimentary airport lounge access outside India. Customers are required to present their valid Priority Pass Membership Card at the lounge to avail the complimentary international (global) lounge access benefit. The Priority Pass Membership Card remains valid until the expiry date of the associated Credit Card. Any lounge visit exceeding the complimentary access entitlement will be chargeable. The international (global) airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders except Emeralde Private Metal, Diamant and Times Black Credit Cards.

The applicable charges for additional international lounge access will be billed to the Credit Card within 60 days from the month of usage and will appear in the subsequent statement.

The Priority Pass Membership Card is included in the Welcome Kit provided along with the eligible Credit Card.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?

The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.

Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card? 

To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.

How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?

You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.

How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?

To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:

1. Select the movie you want to watch

2. Click on ‘Book tickets’ 

3. Select the location and venue

4. Select the number of seats and proceed 

5. Click on ‘Pay’

6. Accept the T&Cs 

7. Click on the ‘Unlock Offers’ or ‘Promo Code’ button

8. Click on the ICICI Bank Credit Card option 

9. Choose the offer applicable to your Credit Card. (For example: Up to ₹ 500 off on the second ticket or 25% off up to ₹ 100 on the second ticket)

10. Enter the entire Credit Card number 

11. Make the payment when you see the ‘offer applied’ message. 

What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?

You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.

What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.

Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?

You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.

Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?

The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.

How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?

ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver. 

Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?

Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.

Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?

Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.

Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?

Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icicibank.com

How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?

Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.

What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?

ICICI Bank 
Chip Credit Cards
 come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.

Will I receive a separate PIN for my Add-on cards?

Yes, you will receive a separate PIN at your mailing address for each Add-on card that has been issued to you.

Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?

All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.

When will I receive my Credit Card PIN?

Your 4-digit PIN will be sent to you separately at your mailing address and should reach you within 7 working days of receiving your Credit Card.

For Ferrari Platinum Cardholders, your 4 digit PIN is sent through SMS on registered mobile number. In case your mobile number is not registered, the PIN is sent separately at your mailing address.

Alternatively, to generate a PIN number for your ICICI Bank Credit Card please follow the below steps.

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to Net Banking with your user ID and Password > My Accounts > Credit Cards > Generate Credit Card PIN Online

(to be used only for Primary card PIN generation, for add-on card same is not applicable)

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to ICICI Bank's iMobile app > Click on Smartkeys & Services > Click on Card Services > Generate credit card PIN. Enter the required details and Submit.

Customer Care:

Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.

To know the local Customer Care numbers, please 
click here
.

Please note:

1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.

2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.

How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:

Visit the BookMyShow website

Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets

Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”

Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”

Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction

How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.

Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

FAQs

How to redeem Credit Card points for rewards?

You can experience seamless redemption of reward points with ICICI Bank. First, log into ICICI Bank Net Banking or the ICICI Bank's iMobile app. In the ‘Rewards’ section, you can redeem your ICICI Bank reward points across multiple categories such as electronics, lifestyle, luxury, shopping and travel.

How to apply for an ICICI Bank Credit Card online?

You can apply online by visiting the ICICI Bank website and selecting a Credit Card that best suits your needs. Make sure to check the eligibility criteria. Fill out the application form with your details. You can also visit any ICICI Bank branch in person, where a representative will help you throughout the process. Don't forget to have your documents like proof of identity, proof of address and income statements handy.

How to avail Complimentary International Airport lounge access?

Enjoy unlimited complimentary access to international airport lounges with ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card. Complimentary benefits are applicable only for the primary Cardholder.

For an ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card customer who has applied for the card on or after 15 November 2024.

Present your Priority Pass Membership Card at the participating international lounges.

For complete list of international airport lounges visit 
https://www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges

DreamFolks Membership

 for the complete list of international airport lounges

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your Emeralde Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period. 

Please go through the below illustration to understand the spends period along with the lounge eligibility period:

Spends period offer -  eligibility period

Spend ₹25,000 between Dec 26, 2025 and Mar 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between Apr 01, 2026 and June 30, 2026.

Spend ₹25,000 between Mar 26, 2026 and June 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between July 01, 2026 and Sep 30, 2026.

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here
.

Add-on/Plus card members need to individually spend ₹25,000 in the preceding spends quarter, to be eligible for the offer in the subsequent calendar quarter

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section

Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking

Choose ICICI Bank Complimentary tickets offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards

Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’

Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page.

Who should use this Card?

The Emeralde Credit Card is an ideal Card for people who enjoy a luxurious lifestyle. You get unlimited international and domestic lounge access for the primary Cardholder, a shopping voucher from TATA CLiQ worth ₹5,000 (only American Express Cardholders) and ICICI Bank reward points.

Can I make an online purchase with the Emeralde Credit Card?

Yes, you can easily make online purchases across India and in select overseas online stores using the Emeralde Credit Card.

What are the benefits offered with the Emeralde Credit Card?

The Emeralde Credit Card gives you benefits such as the following, and many more.

Buy one ticket and get up to ₹750 off on the second ticket, up to 4 times in a month through BookMyShow

Unlimited international and domestic airport lounge access

Up to 4 golf rounds every month, basis spends on the Card

What is the age limit to apply for the Emeralde Credit Card?

You must be between 21–65 years of age to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card.

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

For lounge visits within India, the primary Cardholder can avail unlimited complimentary lounge access using their ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card. Please swipe the ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card to avail the complimentary lounge access. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here (PDF, 273 KB)
 .

What are the golf privileges and the eligibility criteria to avail them?

As an Emeralde Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for a round or lesson of golf for every ₹ 50,000 spent on retail purchases in the previous calendar month. You can avail a maximum of 4 rounds per month. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit  
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered for your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months. 

To view the updated list of golf courses, please 
click here (PDF, 315 KB)
. For complete details of the golf programme and the associated terms and conditions, please  
click here (PDF, 216 KB)
. You may also call iAssist, the 24/7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL or BSNL lines) or 022 67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking.

How do I make the booking for Golf Rounds?

Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps:

Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform 
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 with your registered mobile number.

Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.

Submit your booking request and await confirmation.

Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details.

You may also call i-Assist, our 24X7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable), for assistance with online booking. An authorisation amount of ₹2 shall be taken for each eligible Card.

What Air Accident insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?

The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident insurance coverage of ₹ 3 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the incident. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplemental Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards, please 
click here (PDF, 255 KB)
. 

What are the key features of the concierge services offered?

The concierge service provides 24/7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower and gift deliveries, hotel and flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 67872016 (standard call charges applicable).

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an

Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹ 4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplemental) Cardholder, helping them to save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

FAQs

How to redeem Credit Card points for rewards?

You can experience seamless redemption of reward points with ICICI Bank. First, log into ICICI Bank Net Banking or the ICICI Bank's iMobile app. In the ‘Rewards’ section, you can redeem your ICICI Bank reward points across multiple categories such as electronics, lifestyle, luxury, shopping and travel.

How to apply for an ICICI Bank Credit Card online?

You can apply online by visiting the ICICI Bank website and selecting a Credit Card that best suits your needs. Make sure to check the eligibility criteria. Fill out the application form with your details. You can also visit any ICICI Bank branch in person, where a representative will help you throughout the process. Don't forget to have your documents like proof of identity, proof of address and income statements handy.

How to avail Complimentary International Airport lounge access?

Enjoy unlimited complimentary access to international airport lounges with ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card. Complimentary benefits are applicable only for the primary Cardholder.

For an ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card customer who has applied for the card on or after 15 November 2024.

https://www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your Emeralde Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period. 

Please go through the below illustration to understand the spends period along with the lounge eligibility period:

Spends period offer -  eligibility period

Spend ₹25,000 between Dec 26, 2025 and Mar 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between Apr 01, 2026 and June 30, 2026.

Spend ₹25,000 between Mar 26, 2026 and June 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between July 01, 2026 and Sep 30, 2026.

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here
.

Add-on/Plus card members need to individually spend ₹25,000 in the preceding spends quarter, to be eligible for the offer in the subsequent calendar quarter

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section

Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking

Choose ICICI Bank Complimentary tickets offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards

Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’

Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page.

Who should use this Card?

The Emeralde Credit Card is an ideal Card for people who enjoy a luxurious lifestyle. You get unlimited international and domestic lounge access for the primary Cardholder, a shopping voucher from TATA CLiQ worth ₹5,000 (only American Express Cardholders) and ICICI Bank reward points.

Can I make an online purchase with the Emeralde Credit Card?

Yes, you can easily make online purchases across India and in select overseas online stores using the Emeralde Credit Card.

What are the benefits offered with the Emeralde Credit Card?

The Emeralde Credit Card gives you benefits such as the following, and many more.

Buy one ticket and get up to ₹750 off on the second ticket, up to 4 times in a month through BookMyShow

Unlimited international and domestic airport lounge access

Up to 4 golf rounds every month, basis spends on the Card

What is the age limit to apply for the Emeralde Credit Card?

You must be between 21–65 years of age to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card.

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

For lounge visits within India, the primary Cardholder can avail unlimited complimentary lounge access using their ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card. Please swipe the ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card to avail the complimentary lounge access. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here (PDF, 273 KB)
 .

What are the golf privileges and the eligibility criteria to avail them?

As an Emeralde Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for a round or lesson of golf for every ₹ 50,000 spent on retail purchases in the previous calendar month. You can avail a maximum of 4 rounds per month. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit  
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered for your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months. 

To view the updated list of golf courses, please 
click here (PDF, 315 KB)
. For complete details of the golf programme and the associated terms and conditions, please  
click here (PDF, 216 KB)
. You may also call iAssist, the 24/7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL or BSNL lines) or 022 67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking.

How do I make the booking for Golf Rounds?

Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps:

Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform 
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 with your registered mobile number.

Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.

Submit your booking request and await confirmation.

Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details.

You may also call i-Assist, our 24X7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable), for assistance with online booking. An authorisation amount of ₹2 shall be taken for each eligible Card.

What Air Accident insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?

The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident insurance coverage of ₹ 3 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the incident. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplemental Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards, please 
click here (PDF, 255 KB)
. 

What are the key features of the concierge services offered?

The concierge service provides 24/7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower and gift deliveries, hotel and flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 67872016 (standard call charges applicable).

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an

Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹ 4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplemental) Cardholder, helping them to save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card FAQs

Is the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card a luxury Credit Card?

Yes. The Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card is a luxury Credit Card from ICICI Bank. It is packed with plenty of premium benefits.

What is the best metal Credit Card currently available with ICICI bank?

If you are looking for the best metal Credit Card, then the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card is an excellent choice for you. It has top luxury lifestyle offers & benefits.

Is there a joining fee and Annual fee for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?

Yes. The Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card has a joining fee and Annual fee of ₹12,499 + GST.

How can Emeralde Private Metal Credit Cardholders claim their joining vouchers?

Step 1: Log into ICICI Bank Rewards

•   iMobile App:

Open iMobile 🡪 Cards & Forex 🡪  Select Credit Card 🡪 Redeem 🡪 Joining Benefit

•   Internet Banking:

Log in 🡪 Cards 🡪 Credit cards 🡪 Select Credit Card 🡪 Redeem 🡪 Joining Benefit

Step 2: On the Rewards site, click the ‘Joining Benefit / Annual Benefit’ tab to open the Benefits Page.

Step 3: Find details for your TAJ Epicure and EazyDiner vouchers.    

Your Voucher Code and / or PIN and steps to redeem are displayed next to each voucher

Follow the on-screen instructions for membership activation and voucher redemption.

For details and T&Cs, 
click here

When will I get the Joining Benefits for my Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?

You will receive an e-mail regarding the same within 45 business days after the payment of the Joining Fee.

How to avail complimentary international airport lounge access?

Enjoy unlimited complimentary access to international airport lounges with ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card.

Priority Pass Membership

Complimentary Priority Pass Membership for both the primary cardholder and Plus cardholder with ICICI Bank Emeralde Metal Credit Card

Access 1,800+ lounges in 146 countries worldwide

Present your Priority Pass Membership Card at the participating international lounges.

For complete list of international airport lounges visit 
https://www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

For lounge visits within India, Primary and Add-on Cardholders can avail unlimited complimentary lounge access through ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card. Please swipe the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card to avail the complimentary lounge access. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here
.

What are the golf privileges and eligibility criteria?

As an Emeralde Private Metal, Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for unlimited round or lesson of golf. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit 
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
   and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered against your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months.

To view the updated list of golf courses, please 
click here
. For complete details on the Golf programme and the associated terms and conditions, please
click here
. You may also call iAssist, the 24x7 concierge service on 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL or BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking.

How do I make the booking for Golf Rounds?

Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps:

Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform 
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 with your registered mobile number.

Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.

Submit your booking request and await confirmation.

Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details.

You may also call i-Assist, our 24X7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable), for assistance with online booking. An authorisation amount of ₹2 shall be taken for each eligible Card.

What are the movie ticket benefits available Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?

Cardholders are eligible for a Buy-One-Get-One movies, sport events, theatre or concert tickets offer worth up to ₹750 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here
.

What are the key features of the concierge services offered?

The concierge services provide 24/7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower and gift deliveries, hotel and flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable).

What Air Accident Insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?

The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident Insurance coverage of ₹3 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the event. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplementary Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards.

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please 
click here
 .

What is the age limit for the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?

You must be between the age group of 21–65 years to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card.

How can I know the bill due date of my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can find the bill due date of your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card on your monthly statement, in the iMobile app, through Internet Banking or by contacting Customer Care at 1800 1080.

Is it safe to transact with the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?

Yes. Since your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip for high-level security, you can transact safely & securely.

What are the key features of the Mastercard Privileges?

Mastercard Moments is an exclusive programme specially created for Mastercard cardholders. At the heart of this programme is a host of exceptional experiences designed to inspire and enrich the lives of our Mastercard cardholders, with programme members able to enjoy additional benefits.

For more details, 
https://specials.priceless.com/en-in/homePage

How do I find the CVV on my Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card?

Flip your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your Card Verification Value (CVV). You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

Credit Card EMI Calculator FAQs

What does the ICICI Bank Credit Card EMI Calculator do?

The EMI Calculator helps you budget your expenses by calculating your monthly EMI, total interest payable and the total amount to be paid. You can use it by entering the transaction amount, selecting the EMI type (Instant or On-Call), tenure and interest rate.

What is the maximum tenure available for EMI?

The maximum tenure available for 
ICICI Bank Credit Card EMI
 is up to 24 months. This allows you to choose a repayment period that best fits your budget and financial planning.

What are the benefits of using ICICI Bank’s EMI facility?

Instant EMI conversion with flexible tenure options up to 24 months.

What information is needed to calculate EMI?

To calculate your EMIs, you need to select the type of EMI (Instant or On-Call), input the transaction amount, choose the tenure and enter the applicable interest rate. The calculator will display your EMI, total interest payable and the total repayment amount.

What is a Credit Card EMI Calculator, and how does it work?

A Credit Card EMI calculator helps estimate the repayment amount based on tenure and applicable charges. It uses inputs such as transaction amount, tenure and applicable Credit Card interest rate to calculate the installment amount.

FAQs

What is ICICI Bank Instant EMI?

ICICI Bank Instant EMI allows you to convert eligible Credit Card purchases into easy monthly instalments. You can shop in full and repay in parts, choosing from flexible tenure options ranging from 3 to 24 months.

What is the minimum and maximum transaction amount eligible for Instant EMI?

You can convert transactions starting from as low as ₹1,500 up to ₹10 lakh into Instant EMI, provided your ICICI Bank Credit Card has sufficient available credit at the time of the request.

Is any documentation required to avail Instant EMI?

No additional paperwork is needed! Instant EMI conversion is completely hassle-free and paperless. Just request EMI at the time of transaction, and if your card account has a sufficient credit limit, it will be approved instantly.

What are the tenure and interest rate options under Instant EMI?

ICICI Bank offers flexible tenures of 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, or 24 months. An interest rate of 15.99% p.a. is applicable across these tenures. For selected merchants, No Extra Cost EMI options are also available — the extra cost is borne by the merchant or brand, not by ICICI Bank.

How can I check and track my Instant EMI transactions?

Once your transaction is converted into Instant EMI, the details will appear clearly in your monthly Credit Card statement. You can also use the 
EMI Calculator
 on the ICICI Bank website to view and plan your repayment schedule.

EMI On Call FAQs

What is the ‘EMI On Call’ facility?

After making a purchase with your Credit Card, you can choose to pay for it in the form of EMIs (Equated Monthly Instalments) through ICICI Bank's iMobile app, WhatsApp Banking, Net Banking, the OTP page or using your phone. ICICI Bank’s EMI On Call facility helps you pay the instalments conveniently over a tenure that ranges from 3 months – 24 months.

What types of transactions can be converted to ‘EMI On Call’?

All retail transactions of ₹ 1,500 and above can be converted into EMIs, with some exceptions:

Transactions older than 30 days cannot be converted into EMIs

Certain categories of transactions like cash, gambling, fuel, gold and jewellery purchase, etc. are not eligible for the ‘EMI On Call’ facility. In particular, jewellery & gold transactions cannot be converted into EMIs as per the guidelines issued by RBI from time to time.

What are the charges applicable on availing the EMI On Call facility?

This facility offers EMI payments with interest payment at a rate of up to 1.5% per month on a monthly reducing balance basis. A one-time processing fee of up to 2% of the transaction value is charged at the time of EMI conversion. A foreclosure fee of up to 3% and advance EMI interest and GST as applicable shall be chargeable if you opt for pre-closure of the EMIs.

How can I pay the EMIs through ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Customers wondering how to pay EMI through Credit Card do not need to make a separate payment for EMIs. The EMI amount is included in the monthly ICICI Bank Credit Card statement and can be paid along with the total outstanding amount as per the billing cycle, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

What if I convert my Credit Card transaction into EMI after the statement is generated?

You can deduct the converted amount from the statement bill and pay the differential amount.

Will converting to EMI affect my credit score?

Converting to EMI does not negatively impact your credit score as long as you make timely EMI payments. However, late payments can affect your credit score.

Is No Cost EMI available on an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, No Cost EMI may be available on select transactions, subject to merchant tie-ups and ICICI Bank terms and conditions.

Who is eligible for No Cost EMI on Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card?

All customers who hold an active Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card are eligible for No Cost EMI, subject to applicable merchant terms and transaction criteria.

FAQs

How do I convert a transaction into EMI?

You can convert eligible transactions of ₹3,000 or more into EMIs using the ‘EMI on Call’ service or directly at partner outlets through Instant EMI. You may also log in to ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking to check and convert eligible transactions into EMI with just a few clicks.

Are there any charges for EMI conversion?

Yes, EMI conversions may attract a nominal processing fee and interest rate, depending on the transaction amount and selected tenure. These charges will be clearly displayed before you confirm the conversion, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.

What is a loan on a Credit Card (PLCC)?

Personal Loan on Credit Card
 allows you to avail an instant personal loan on your ICICI Bank Credit Card in case of emergencies or immediate cash needs. The loan is disbursed quickly and repaid in easy EMIs, with competitive interest rates and minimal documentation.

How does Balance Transfer help save money?

The Balance Transfer feature lets you transfer outstanding amounts from other bank credit cards to your 
ICICI Bank Credit Card
 at lower interest rates. It helps you reduce the interest burden and repay your dues more efficiently over a structured plan.

Emirates Skywards ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card FAQs

How can I qualify for Emirates Skywards Gold Tier membership using the ICICI Bank Emirates Emeralde Credit Card?

To qualify for an upgrade to Skywards Gold Tier, the Emirates Emeralde Credit Cardholder must:

Spend a total of ₹15 lakhs within an anniversary year.

Out of this, at least ₹50,000 must be spent on Emirates bookings.

Even if these criteria are met early, the upgrade happens only after 12 months from the card issuance date and upon payment of the annual fee for the following year.

Do supplementary cardholders earn Skywards Miles?

Yes. Any eligible spend made by supplementary cardholders of Emirates Emeralde Credit Card will earn Skywards Miles, which will be credited to the primary cardholder’s Emirates Skywards account. The rate of earning remains the same as for primary cardholders.

How to avail complimentary international airport lounge access?

Enjoy unlimited complimentary access to international airport lounges with ICICI Bank Emirates Emerald Credit Card. Complimentary benefits are applicable only for the primary cardholder.

Emirates Rubyx Credit Card FAQs

What are the ways to get an Emirates Rubyx Credit Card?

You can apply online through the ICICI Bank website or by visiting an ICICI Bank branch.

Does Emirates Rubyx Credit Card offer international airport lounge access?

No, the Emirates Rubyx Credit Card offers 1 complimentary domestic lounge visit per quarter. and is available only on a spend of ₹75,000 in the preceding quarter.

How can I avail discount on Emirates flight bookings using my ICICI Bank Emirates Rubyx Credit Card?

To avail upto 10% discount on Emirates flight bookings, please follow the below steps

Visit 
www.emirates.com
 or open the Emirates App.

Click on “Book Now”

Enter promo code “INICI26” before searching for flights.

Complete your booking using your Emirates Skywards ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card at the time of payment.

How can I redeem the Skywards Miles earned?

You can redeem the miles for flight bookings, upgrades, hotel stays, and more through Emirates and its partners.

Does Emirates Rubyx Credit Card offer an annual fee waiver?

No, the annual card charges cannot be waived. However, the complimentary Emirates Skywards Blue Tier Membership gets automatically renewed after the annual fee payment.

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your Emirates Rubyx Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period. 

Please go through the below illustration to understand the spends period along with the lounge eligibility period:

Spends period offer -  eligibility period

Spend ₹25,000 between Dec 26, 2025 and Mar 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between Apr 01, 2026 and June 30, 2026. 

 Spend ₹25,000 between Mar 26, 2026 and June 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between July 01, 2026 and Sep 30, 2026.

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here 
.

Add-on/Plus card members need to individually spend ₹25,000 in the preceding spends quarter, to be eligible for the offer in the subsequent calendar quarter

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section 

 Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking 

 Choose ICICI Bank Credit Card 25% Discount Offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards 

 Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’ 

 Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page. 

What are the entertainment and lifestyle benefits of this card?

You can avail of discounts while dining out in select restaurants and movie ticket bookings.

How is the maximum credit limit for the Emirates Rubyx credit card determined?

The credit limit is determined by the bank and depends on several factors like your credit score, income, and repayment history.

Who is this card best suited for?

You are a frequent Emirates flyer and want to earn Skywards Miles on your spending, but are looking for an affordable credit card with valuable benefits.
