Emirates Rubyx Credit Card FAQs

What are the ways to get an Emirates Rubyx Credit Card?

You can apply online through the ICICI Bank website or by visiting an ICICI Bank branch.

Does Emirates Rubyx Credit Card offer international airport lounge access?

No, the Emirates Rubyx Credit Card offers 1 complimentary domestic lounge visit per quarter. and is available only on a spend of ₹75,000 in the preceding quarter.

How can I avail discount on Emirates flight bookings using my ICICI Bank Emirates Rubyx Credit Card?

To avail upto 10% discount on Emirates flight bookings, please follow the below steps

Visit 
www.emirates.com
 or open the Emirates App.

Click on “Book Now”

Enter promo code “INICI26” before searching for flights.

Complete your booking using your Emirates Skywards ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card at the time of payment.

How can I redeem the Skywards Miles earned?

You can redeem the miles for flight bookings, upgrades, hotel stays, and more through Emirates and its partners.

Does Emirates Rubyx Credit Card offer an annual fee waiver?

No, the annual card charges cannot be waived. However, the complimentary Emirates Skywards Blue Tier Membership gets automatically renewed after the annual fee payment.

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your Emirates Rubyx Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period. 

Please go through the below illustration to understand the spends period along with the lounge eligibility period:

Spends period offer -  eligibility period

Spend ₹25,000 between Dec 26, 2025 and Mar 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between Apr 01, 2026 and June 30, 2026. 

 Spend ₹25,000 between Mar 26, 2026 and June 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between July 01, 2026 and Sep 30, 2026.

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here 
.

Add-on/Plus card members need to individually spend ₹25,000 in the preceding spends quarter, to be eligible for the offer in the subsequent calendar quarter

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section 

 Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking 

 Choose ICICI Bank Credit Card 25% Discount Offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards 

 Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’ 

 Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page. 

What are the entertainment and lifestyle benefits of this card?

You can avail of discounts while dining out in select restaurants and movie ticket bookings.

How is the maximum credit limit for the Emirates Rubyx credit card determined?

The credit limit is determined by the bank and depends on several factors like your credit score, income, and repayment history.

Who is this card best suited for?

You are a frequent Emirates flyer and want to earn Skywards Miles on your spending, but are looking for an affordable credit card with valuable benefits.

Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card FAQs

What is the Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card?

A premium travel credit card by ICICI Bank and Emirates Skywards. It rewards you with Skywards Miles on spends, free lounge access, travel privileges, and an exclusive Emirates Silver Tier status.

What are the joining and annual benefits of the Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card?

Cardholders receive 5,000 Skywards Miles and a complimentary Emirates Skywards Silver Tier membership as joining benefits.

How to avail complimentary international airport lounge access?

Enjoy 2 complimentary accesses to international airport lounges with ICICI Bank Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card. Complimentary benefits are applicable only for the primary cardholder.

For an ICICI Bank Emriates Sapphiro Credit Card customer who has applied for the card on or after 15 November 2024.

Click here (PDF, 1.12 MB)
 for the complete list of international airport lounges.

What type of lounge access is provided?

The primary cardholder receives complimentary access to domestic lounges twice a quarter and international lounges twice a year.

Earn up to 2 Skywards Miles per ₹100 spent on most categories, including dining, travel, and entertainment.

How do I redeem the Skywards Miles?

Miles in your Emirates Skywards account can be redeemed for flights, upgrades, hotel stays, and more with Emirates and its partners.

How can I maintain the Emirates Silver Tier benefit in the subsequent years?

To retain the Silver Tier status in subsequent years, an annual spend of ₹5 lakh is required.

Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card FAQs

What is the Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card?

A premium travel credit card by ICICI Bank and Emirates Skywards. It rewards you with Skywards Miles on spends, free lounge access, travel privileges, and an exclusive Emirates Silver Tier status.

What are the joining and annual benefits of the Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card?

Cardholders receive 5,000 Skywards Miles and a complimentary Emirates Skywards Silver Tier membership as joining benefits.

How to avail complimentary international airport lounge access?

Enjoy 2 complimentary accesses to international airport lounges with ICICI Bank Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card. Complimentary benefits are applicable only for the primary cardholder.

For an ICICI Bank Emriates Sapphiro Credit Card customer who has applied for the card on or after 15 November 2024.

Priority Pass Membership

Complimentary Priority Pass Membership for the primary cardholder with ICICI Bank Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card

Access 1,400+ lounges in 145+ countries worldwide

Present your Priority Pass Membership Card at the participating international lounges.

For complete list of international airport lounges visit 
www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges

For an ICICI Bank Emriates Sapphiro Credit Card customer who has applied for the card before 15 November 2024.

DreamFolks Membership

Access 650+ lounges in 100+ countries.

Present your DreamFolks Membership Card at the participating international lounges.

Click here (PDF, 1.12 MB)
 for the complete list of international airport lounges.

What type of lounge access is provided?

The primary cardholder receives complimentary access to domestic lounges twice a quarter and international lounges twice a year.

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period. 

Please go through the below illustration to understand the spends period along with the lounge eligibility period:

Spends period offer -  eligibility period

Spend ₹25,000 between Dec 26, 2025 and Mar 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between Apr 01, 2026 and June 30, 2026.

Spend ₹25,000 between Mar 26, 2026 and June 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between July 01, 2026 and Sep 30, 2026.

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here
.

Add-on/Plus card members need to individually spend ₹25,000 in the preceding spends quarter, to be eligible for the offer in the subsequent calendar quarter

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section

Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking

Choose ICICI Bank Complimentary tickets offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards

Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’

Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page.

How can I avail discount on Emirates flight bookings using my ICICI Bank Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card?

To avail upto 10% discount on Emirates flight bookings, please follow the below steps

Visit 
www.emirates.com
 or open the Emirates App.

Click on “Book Now”

Enter promo code “INICI26” before searching for flights.

Complete your booking using your Emirates Skywards ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card at the time of payment.

How are Skywards Miles earned?

Earn up to 2 Skywards Miles per ₹100 spent on most categories, including dining, travel, and entertainment.

How do I redeem the Skywards Miles?

Miles in your Emirates Skywards account can be redeemed for flights, upgrades, hotel stays, and more with Emirates and its partners.

How can I maintain the Emirates Silver Tier benefit in the subsequent years?

To retain the Silver Tier status in subsequent years, an annual spend of ₹5 lakh is required.

Who is this card best suited for?

You are a frequent Emirates flyer, want to earn Skywards Miles on your spending, and are comfortable with reward redemption being limited to Emirates.

Emirates Skywards Credit Card FAQs

What are the kinds of Emirates Skywards credit cards available in India?

The types of Emirates Skywards Credit Cards in India are

Emirates Emeralde: Best for High- End Flying Perks

Emirates Sapphiro: Luxury Travel and Lifestyle

Emirates Rubyx: Best for Frequent Flyers

How do I accumulate Skywards Miles on these credit cards?

You get 2.5 Miles, 2 miles and 1.5 miles for ₹100 spent using your Emaralde, Sapphiro and Rubyx credit cards. Miles are awarded for expenditure on travel, lifestyle, and daily spends.

Is airport lounge access available on these cards?

Yes, lounge access is card-specific. The Emarlade card entitles users to unrestricted access to domestic and international airport lounges. Sapphiro offers two free domestic lounge visits every quarter and two free foreign lounge visits annually, whereas Rubyx offers one free domestic lounge visit every three months.

What should I do if I notice an unauthorised transaction on my credit card?

If you detect any unauthorised transaction, immediately contact ICICI Bank Customer Care or Internet Banking to report it.

How do I get an Emirates Skywards Credit Card?

You can apply online from the ICICI Bank website or any ICICI Bank branch. Check if you meet the eligibility criteria and have the documents necessary for a smooth application.

Can I apply for an add-on card for my family members?

Yes, you can apply for up to three add-on cards for your immediate family members (spouse, parents, siblings, or children 18 years and above). The cards have the same credit limit and benefits as the primary card, including Skywards Miles accrual.

How do I redeem my Skywards Miles accrued through the credit card?

The Skywards Miles are credited to your Emirates Skywards account. You can redeem them for Emirates flights, upgrades, hotel stays, and other partner services.

Domestic Lounge Programme

Every journey now feels exceptional with a premium Domestic Airport Lounge Programme that provides access to an exclusive network of 80+ exquisite domestic airport lounges across India. Step into an environment designed for comfort, where you can relax, rejuvenate and enhance your travel experience.

Enjoy curated amenities including refined ambience, gourmet refreshments, comfortable seating and a perfect escape from the airport crowd. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Access to domestic lounges is available through your eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card, ensuring a seamless and elevated travel experience.

Note: We have updated the eligibility criteria for our domestic lounge access to enhance your travel experience. To avail this benefit, you must spend a minimum of ₹75,000 or more on your eligible Credit Card within a calendar quarter. The eligible spend entitles you to access lounge benefits in the subsequent calendar quarter.

Domestic airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders.

Emeralde Private Metal Credit Cards, Diamant Credit Cards and Times Black Credit Cards provide complimentary unlimited domestic lounge access.

For the customers with dual Credit Card variants of Rubyx and Sapphiro (Mastercard & Amex / Visa & RuPay), the benefit will be equally distributed amongst both the variants.

International Lounge Programme

Get access to a global network of 1,800+ international airport lounges across 146 countries with your Priority Pass Membership Card. Designed for comfort and convenience, these lounges provide premium seating, curated dining options and an elegant space to unwind before your flight.

With seamless worldwide access, your Priority Pass Membership Card delivers a reliable and elevated standard of service across leading international airports. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Note: The Priority Pass Membership Card is eligible for complimentary airport lounge access outside India. Customers are required to present their valid Priority Pass Membership Card at the lounge to avail the complimentary international (global) lounge access benefit. The Priority Pass Membership Card remains valid until the expiry date of the associated Credit Card. Any lounge visit exceeding the complimentary access entitlement will be chargeable. The international (global) airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders except Emeralde Private Metal, Diamant and Times Black Credit Cards.

The applicable charges for additional international lounge access will be billed to the Credit Card within 60 days from the month of usage and will appear in the subsequent statement.

The Priority Pass Membership Card is included in the Welcome Kit provided along with the eligible Credit Card.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?

The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.

Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card? 

To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.

How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?

You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.

How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?

To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:

1. Select the movie you want to watch

2. Click on ‘Book tickets’ 

3. Select the location and venue

4. Select the number of seats and proceed 

5. Click on ‘Pay’

6. Accept the T&Cs 

7. Click on the ‘Unlock Offers’ or ‘Promo Code’ button

8. Click on the ICICI Bank Credit Card option 

9. Choose the offer applicable to your Credit Card. (For example: Up to ₹ 500 off on the second ticket or 25% off up to ₹ 100 on the second ticket)

10. Enter the entire Credit Card number 

11. Make the payment when you see the ‘offer applied’ message. 

What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?

You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.

What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.

Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?

You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.

Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?

The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.

How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?

ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver. 

Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?

Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.

Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?

Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.

Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?

Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icicibank.com

How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?

Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.

What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?

ICICI Bank 
Chip Credit Cards
 come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.

Will I receive a separate PIN for my Add-on cards?

Yes, you will receive a separate PIN at your mailing address for each Add-on card that has been issued to you.

Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?

All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.

When will I receive my Credit Card PIN?

Your 4-digit PIN will be sent to you separately at your mailing address and should reach you within 7 working days of receiving your Credit Card.

For Ferrari Platinum Cardholders, your 4 digit PIN is sent through SMS on registered mobile number. In case your mobile number is not registered, the PIN is sent separately at your mailing address.

Alternatively, to generate a PIN number for your ICICI Bank Credit Card please follow the below steps.

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to Net Banking with your user ID and Password > My Accounts > Credit Cards > Generate Credit Card PIN Online

(to be used only for Primary card PIN generation, for add-on card same is not applicable)

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to ICICI Bank's iMobile app > Click on Smartkeys & Services > Click on Card Services > Generate credit card PIN. Enter the required details and Submit.

Customer Care:

Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.

To know the local Customer Care numbers, please 
click here
.

Please note:

1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.

2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.

How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:

Visit the BookMyShow website

Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets

Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”

Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”

Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction

How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.

Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Domestic Lounge Programme

Every journey now feels exceptional with a premium Domestic Airport Lounge Programme that provides access to an exclusive network of 80+ exquisite domestic airport lounges across India. Step into an environment designed for comfort, where you can relax, rejuvenate and enhance your travel experience.

Enjoy curated amenities including refined ambience, gourmet refreshments, comfortable seating and a perfect escape from the airport crowd. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Access to domestic lounges is available through your eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card, ensuring a seamless and elevated travel experience.

Note: We have updated the eligibility criteria for our domestic lounge access to enhance your travel experience. Domestic airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders.

International Lounge Programme

Get access to a global network of 1,800+ international airport lounges across 146 countries with your Priority Pass Membership Card. Designed for comfort and convenience, these lounges provide premium seating, curated dining options and an elegant space to unwind before your flight.

With seamless worldwide access, your Priority Pass Membership Card delivers a reliable and elevated standard of service across leading international airports. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Note: The Priority Pass Membership Card is eligible for complimentary airport lounge access outside India. Customers are required to present their valid Priority Pass Membership Card at the lounge to avail the complimentary international (global) lounge access benefit. The Priority Pass Membership Card remains valid until the expiry date of the associated Credit Card. Any lounge visit exceeding the complimentary access entitlement will be chargeable. The international (global) airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders except Emeralde Private Metal, Diamant and Times Black Credit Cards.

The applicable charges for additional international lounge access will be billed to the Credit Card within 60 days from the month of usage and will appear in the subsequent statement.

The Priority Pass Membership Card is included in the Welcome Kit provided along with the eligible Credit Card.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?

The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.

Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card? 

To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.

How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?

You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.

How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?

To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:

1. Select the movie you want to watch

2. Click on ‘Book tickets’ 

3. Select the location and venue

4. Select the number of seats and proceed 

5. Click on ‘Pay’

6. Accept the T&Cs 

7. Click on the ‘Unlock Offers’ or ‘Promo Code’ button

8. Click on the ICICI Bank Credit Card option 

9. Choose the offer applicable to your Credit Card. (For example: Up to ₹ 500 off on the second ticket or 25% off up to ₹ 100 on the second ticket)

10. Enter the entire Credit Card number 

11. Make the payment when you see the ‘offer applied’ message. 

What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?

You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.

What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.

Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?

You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.

Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?

The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.

How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?

ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver. 

Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?

Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.

Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?

Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.

Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?

Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icicibank.com

How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?

Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.

What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?

ICICI Bank 
Chip Credit Cards
 come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.

Will I receive a separate PIN for my Add-on cards?

Yes, you will receive a separate PIN at your mailing address for each Add-on card that has been issued to you.

Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?

All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.

When will I receive my Credit Card PIN?

Your 4-digit PIN will be sent to you separately at your mailing address and should reach you within 7 working days of receiving your Credit Card.

For Ferrari Platinum Cardholders, your 4 digit PIN is sent through SMS on registered mobile number. In case your mobile number is not registered, the PIN is sent separately at your mailing address.

Alternatively, to generate a PIN number for your ICICI Bank Credit Card please follow the below steps.

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to Net Banking with your user ID and Password > My Accounts > Credit Cards > Generate Credit Card PIN Online

(to be used only for Primary card PIN generation, for add-on card same is not applicable)

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to ICICI Bank's iMobile app > Click on Smartkeys & Services > Click on Card Services > Generate credit card PIN. Enter the required details and Submit.

Customer Care:

Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.

To know the local Customer Care numbers, please 
click here
.

Please note:

1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.

2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.

How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:

Visit the BookMyShow website

Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets

Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”

Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”

Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction

How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.

Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

International Lounge Programme

Get access to a global network of 1,800+ international airport lounges across 146 countries with your Priority Pass Membership Card. Designed for comfort and convenience, these lounges provide premium seating, curated dining options and an elegant space to unwind before your flight.

With seamless worldwide access, your Priority Pass Membership Card delivers a reliable and elevated standard of service across leading international airports. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the lounge experience is designed to enhance every stage of your journey.

Note: The Priority Pass Membership Card is eligible for complimentary airport lounge access outside India. Customers are required to present their valid Priority Pass Membership Card at the lounge to avail the complimentary international (global) lounge access benefit. The Priority Pass Membership Card remains valid until the expiry date of the associated Credit Card. Any lounge visit exceeding the complimentary access entitlement will be chargeable. The international (global) airport lounge access benefit is exclusively available to primary cardholders except Emeralde Private Metal, Diamant and Times Black Credit Cards.

The applicable charges for additional international lounge access will be billed to the Credit Card within 60 days from the month of usage and will appear in the subsequent statement.

The Priority Pass Membership Card is included in the Welcome Kit provided along with the eligible Credit Card.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme?

The ICICI Bank Credit Card Experience Programme is an exclusive programme for select ICICI Bank Credit Card customers. By opting for this programme, you get handpicked privileges and offers from top brands.

Where can I find privileges or experiences specific to my card? 

To find an experience specific to your card, go to the Credit Card Experience Programme Page > Eligible Cards. You will find the privileges or experiences specific to your card.

How to keep track of all the latest offers and privileges?

You will receive regular updates about the latest offers and privileges on your registered mobile number and e-mail ID. If you want to know more about any offer or need any other information related to the Credit Card Experience Programme, you can check the Credit Card Experience Programme page or offers page on our website.

How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?

To avail your offer, you can follow the below steps on BookMyShow:

1. Select the movie you want to watch

2. Click on ‘Book tickets’ 

3. Select the location and venue

4. Select the number of seats and proceed 

5. Click on ‘Pay’

6. Accept the T&Cs 

7. Click on the ‘Unlock Offers’ or ‘Promo Code’ button

8. Click on the ICICI Bank Credit Card option 

9. Choose the offer applicable to your Credit Card. (For example: Up to ₹ 500 off on the second ticket or 25% off up to ₹ 100 on the second ticket)

10. Enter the entire Credit Card number 

11. Make the payment when you see the ‘offer applied’ message. 

What movie offers are available for ICICI Bank Credit Card customers?

You will get discounts on platforms like BookMyShow and INOX.

What travel benefits do I get with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You will get travel benefits like complimentary lounge access at airports and railway stations, discounts and offers on travel booking sites, Uber vouchers and more.

Which Credit Card is the best for travel benefits?

You can opt for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card. It provides complimentary international and domestic airport lounge access, welcome vouchers from Uber & EaseMyTrip, air accident insurance cover up to ₹ 3 crore and more.

Are there any dining offers I can avail with my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

There are limited time culinary offers on Swiggy, Zomato and EazyDiner that you can avail with your ICICI Bank Credit Card.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card is most suitable for Football enthusiasts?

The Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank is perfect for Football enthusiasts. It comes with several amazing offers and an opportunity to win a fully paid trip to Old Trafford.

How can I win a trip to Old Trafford using my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can use the Manchester United Credit Card by ICICI Bank and get a fully paid trip to Old Trafford by becoming one of the top 18 spenders.

Which ICICI Bank Credit Card offers fuel savings?

ICICI Bank offers a wide range of Credit Cards such as ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Bank Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) Super Saver Credit Card with the benefit of fuel surcharge waiver. 

Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?

Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.

Can I use my Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas?

Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the point of sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.

Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?

Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icicibank.com

How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?

Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.

What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?

ICICI Bank 
Chip Credit Cards
 come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.

Will I receive a separate PIN for my Add-on cards?

Yes, you will receive a separate PIN at your mailing address for each Add-on card that has been issued to you.

Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?

All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.

When will I receive my Credit Card PIN?

Your 4-digit PIN will be sent to you separately at your mailing address and should reach you within 7 working days of receiving your Credit Card.

For Ferrari Platinum Cardholders, your 4 digit PIN is sent through SMS on registered mobile number. In case your mobile number is not registered, the PIN is sent separately at your mailing address.

Alternatively, to generate a PIN number for your ICICI Bank Credit Card please follow the below steps.

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to Net Banking with your user ID and Password > My Accounts > Credit Cards > Generate Credit Card PIN Online

(to be used only for Primary card PIN generation, for add-on card same is not applicable)

Pin generation through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Login to ICICI Bank's iMobile app > Click on Smartkeys & Services > Click on Card Services > Generate credit card PIN. Enter the required details and Submit.

Customer Care:

Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.

To know the local Customer Care numbers, please 
click here
.

Please note:

1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.

2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.

How do I avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer using ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

Here is the process to avail the Buy 1 Get 1 movie ticket offer:

Visit the BookMyShow website

Select the movie, cinema, showtime and choose at least two tickets

Proceed to checkout and open “Avail Discounts & Offers”

Select the “ICICI Bank Credit Card Offer”

Enter your card details to apply the discount and complete the transaction

How many free movie tickets can I get per month with ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

The number of complimentary movie tickets depends on the specific ICICI Bank Credit Card variant.

Cardholders can get up to 2 free movie tickets per month with ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card, ICICI Bank Emerald Credit Card and ICICI Bank Emerald Private Metal Credit Card. Cardholders of ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card can get up to 4 free movie tickets per month, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Expressions Credit Card FAQs

Does the Expressions Credit Card provide discounts on movie tickets?

Yes, the Expressions Credit Card provides a ₹100 discount on the purchase of two movie tickets at BookMShow and INOX. You can avail this offer twice a month.

Is an Expressions Credit Card free?

No, the card has a joining fee of ₹499 and an annual fee of ₹499.

What does CVV stand for in a Credit Card? How do I find it in my Expressions Credit Card?

Flip your Expressions Credit Card to the back. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your CVV. You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking. 

Which Bank’s Credit Card is considered to be the best?

If you’re looking for one of the best Credit Cards, then ICICI Bank’s Expressions Credit Card is an excellent choice for you. It offers custom Credit Card designs, so your card can reflect your unique personality. 

What is the age limit for an Expressions Credit Card?

You must be in the age group of 21 – 65 years to be eligible for an ICICI Bank Expressions Credit Card

How can I find out the due date of an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can find your ICICI Bank Expressions Credit Card due date on your monthly statement, in the iMobile app, through Internet Banking or by contacting Customer Care on 1800 1080.

Which Bank allows Credit Card image customisation easily?

You can opt for ICICI Bank, as it offers a seamless application process. The Expressions Credit Card has an option to select the card image. For more information about the application process, call 1800 1080. 

What are ICICI Bank Credit Card Reward Points?

If you’re a Credit Cardholder, you will earn ICICI Bank Reward Points on certain spending. These points can be redeemed through the Reward catalogue on the Bank's website or by logging in to the ICICI Bank's iMobile app. You can use them to purchase vouchers, offers, e-gift cards and more.

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

To enjoy domestic lounge access, you must spend ₹ 75,000 or more on Expressions Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.

Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria, 
click here
. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here
.

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your Expressions Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period. 

Please go through the below illustration to understand the spends period along with the lounge eligibility period:

Spends period offer -  eligibility period

Spend ₹25,000 between Dec 26, 2025 and Mar 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between Apr 01, 2026 and June 30, 2026. 

 Spend ₹25,000 between Mar 26, 2026 and June 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between July 01, 2026 and Sep 30, 2026.

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here 
.

Add-on/Plus card members need to individually spend ₹25,000 in the preceding spends quarter, to be eligible for the offer in the subsequent calendar quarter

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section 

 Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking 

 Choose ICICI Bank Credit Card 25% Discount Offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards 

 Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’ 

 Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page. 

What are the movie ticket benefits available?

Cardholders are eligible for a 25% off on movie ticket offer worth up to ₹ 100 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here
.

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please 
click here

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions worth ₹400 – ₹4,000 at HPCL pumps. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplemental) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here 
.

Add-on/Plus card members need to individually spend ₹25,000 in the preceding spends quarter, to be eligible for the offer in the subsequent calendar quarter

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section 

 Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking 

 Choose ICICI Bank Credit Card 25% Discount Offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards 

 Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’ 

 Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page. 

What are the movie ticket benefits available?

Cardholders are eligible for a 25% off on movie ticket offer worth up to ₹ 100 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here
.

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please 
click here

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions worth ₹400 – ₹4,000 at HPCL pumps. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplemental) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

NRI credit card FAQs

NRI Credit Card FAQs

          Search FAQs

 Basic information 

                EXPAND ALL

                            What is an NRI credit card?

An NRI credit card is a credit card issued by ICICI Bank to Non-Resident Indians (NRE/NRO) with valid proof of overseas address, passport, visa, min. CRV and a satisfactory credit score are eligible.

                            Can NRI customers avail unsecured credit cards?

Yes, both NRE and NRO account holders are eligible to avail unsecured credit cards, subject to eligibility. No fixed deposit or collateral is required.

                            Which ICICI Bank credit card variants are available for NRI customers?

Credit card offering to NRI Customer depends on the account type and eligibility criteria of the Bank, below are current credit card offering to NRI customers:

NRE Offerings: Coral Credit Card, HPCL Coral Credit Card, HPCL Super Saver Credit Card, Rubyx Credit Card, Sapphiro Credit Card, Emeralde Credit Card, Adani One Platinum Credit Card, Adani One Signature Credit Card, Emirates Rubyx Credit Card, Emirates Sapphiro Credit Card, Emirates Emeralde Credit Card, MakeMyTrip Travel Credit Card and Times Black Credit Card.

NRO Offerings: NRI Coral Credit Card and NRI Sapphiro Credit Card.

Eligibility and documentation

                EXPAND ALL

                            What is the eligibility criteria for NRI customers to apply for a NRI credit card?

The customer must have a minimum CRV of ₹50 lakhs, hold an NRE or NRO account with ICICI Bank, be at least 25 years old, and be an individual primary account holder. The maximum age is 58 years for salaried and 65 years for self-employed applicants.

                            Are joint account holders eligible for NRI credit cards?

No, only individual applicants and primary account holders are eligible to apply for NRI credit cards. Joint account holders cannot apply independently.

                            What documents are required if the customer is KYC compliant?

If the customer is already KYC compliant, no additional documents are required. The branch or relationship manager can proceed with the application without collecting fresh documentation.

                            What documents are required if the customer’s re-KYC is due?

Documents include overseas address proof, PAN or Form 60, photograph, valid passport, valid visa/work permit/resident card, FATCA form (if applicable), and any government-issued address proof. Overseas address is mandatory.  

                            Is overseas address mandatory for NRI credit card applications?

Yes, overseas address proof in the name of the applicant is mandatory for processing the NRI credit card application.

Interest Rate, Fee & Charges

                EXPAND ALL

                            Are interest rates, joining/annual fee and other charges the same for all NRI credit cards?

Interest rates, joining/annual fees, and other charges vary depending on the card variant.

You can check the latest schedule of charges in Most Important Terms and Conditions

( MITC )

Repayment and tenure

                EXPAND ALL

                            How can NRI customers repay their credit card dues?

Repayments can be made through auto-debit facility from the linked NRE or NRO account. Customers must authorize auto-debit while submitting the application form.

                            Is auto-debit mandatory for NRI credit cards?

Auto-debit authorization is required as part of the application process to ensure timely repayment from the customer’s ICICI Bank account.

Security, custody and safety

                EXPAND ALL

                            Can NRO cardholders use their card for international transactions?

No, NRO customers can use their credit card only for domestic transactions within India. International transactions are not permitted on NRO credit cards.

                            Are NRI credit cards enabled for lounge access?

International and domestic lounge access is available only to NRE customers, depending on the variant of the card. NRO customers are eligible for domestic lounge access only.

                            Are customers from all countries eligible to apply for NRI credit cards?

No, customers from OFAC-listed countries and ECGC-classified high-risk, very high-risk, and off-cover countries are excluded.

Closure

                EXPAND ALL

                            How can an NRI customer close their credit card account?

The customer can submit a closure request through their relationship manager or by visiting the nearest ICICI Bank branch. All outstanding dues must be cleared before the card can be officially closed. 

                            Is there any penalty for closing an NRI credit card?

Closure charges, if any, depend on the specific card variant and bank’s prevailing policy. Customers should verify with ICICI Bank customer service.

Service requests and account management

                EXPAND ALL

                            How can NRI customers apply for a credit card?

Customers must visit an ICICI Bank branch in India or an overseas representative.

                            Is non-face-to-face application allowed for NRI credit cards?

Yes, for pre-qualified customers meeting CRV and KYC criteria, the relationship manager can process applications through scanned forms with signature and bank seal.

                            Can NRI customers apply for add-on cards?

Yes, NRI customers can apply for supplementary cards by submitting the add-on card application form along with identity and address proof of the supplementary applicant.

Customer Service

                EXPAND ALL

                            How can customers get variant-specific information?

Customers can visit ICICI Bank’s official website under Cards > Credit Cards or refer to the credit card FAQ section for detailed information.

Miscellaneous

                EXPAND ALL

                            Can customers from high-risk countries apply if they meet CRV criteria?

No, even if CRV criteria are met, customers from excluded or high-risk countries as per OFAC and ECGC lists are not eligible

Credit Card FAQs

          Search FAQs

 Basic information 

                EXPAND ALL

                            What is a Credit Card?

A Credit Card is a payment instrument issued by the Bank that allows customers to make purchases on credit within a pre-set limit. Customers can repay either the total outstanding amount or the minimum amount due on or before the due date every month.

                            What are the advantages of using a Credit Card? 

A Credit Card offers several benefits such as:
Convenient and secure payments
Interest free credit period (up to the billing cycle)
Rewards points and/or cashback
EMI payments
Credit score building
Exclusive shopping offers
Concierge services etc. 

                            What is the validity period of a Credit Card? 

                            ICICI Bank Credit Cards come with a validity of up to 7 years. 

                            What is the credit period for a Credit Card? 

The credit period typically ranges between 18-48 days, depending on your billing cycle and the date of purchase. 

                            What are the main types of ICICI Bank Credit Card? 

ICICI Bank offers a wide range of 
Credit Cards
 to suit different customer needs, including

Lifestyle credit cards

Travel credit cards

Shopping credit cards

Fuel credit cards

Co-branded credit cards

Business credit cards

Student credit cards

Cards with airport lounge benefits

Entry-level cards etc. 

To know about the credit cards offered by ICICI Bank, 
click here
.

                            What are the benefits provided by ICICI Bank Credit Cards? 

ICICI Bank Credit Cards
 offer various benefits such as:

Rewards points and cashback

Fuel savings and surcharge waiver

Domestic and International airport lounge access

EMI Conversions

Partner merchants discounts

Zero liability on lost/stolen cards

Milestone benefits etc. 

                            What is a Contactless Credit Card and how does it work? 

A Contactless Credit Card enables tap-and-pay transactions at NFC-enabled POS terminals. During contactless payments, the card does not leave the customer’s hand, thus reducing fraud risk. Also, the low-value transactions can be performed without entering a PIN (as per regulatory limits). 

                            What is a secured Credit Card and who should take it?

A Secured Credit card is issued against a Fixed Deposit placed with the Bank. There should be no lien or partial withdrawal on the Fixed Deposit at the time of issuance. It is suitable for customers who have a limited credit history or want to build/repair their credit score. The secured card is issued only to primary account holders.

                            How does a Credit Card work?

You can use your card to pay for your transactions at merchant- retail or online. Transactions are added to your account and reflected in the monthly statement. You then repay the dues by the due date.

                            What is a Credit Limit?

The Credit Limit is the maximum amount you can spend on your card at any given time. It is assigned by the Bank based on eligibility criteria.

                            What is the billing cycle?

A billing cycle is the period between two statement dates and typically ranges from 28 to 31 days.

                            What is the Total Amount Due? 

 The Total Amount Due is the full outstanding amount on your Credit Card for the billing cycle. 

                            What is the Minimum Amount Due?

It is the minimum sum you must pay by the due date to avoid late payment fees. Interest will continue to apply on the remaining balance.

                            What is a due date?

The due date is the last date by which your payment must be made to avoid late fees and maintain a healthy account status.

                            What is the interest-free period?

It is the period from the transaction date to the statement due date when no interest is charged, provided the previous balance is cleared in full.

                            What are reward points?

Reward points are loyalty points earned on eligible transactions made using your Credit Card. These accumulated points can be redeemed for various benefits such as gift vouchers, merchandise, travel bookings or statement credit, depending on the card’s rewards program.

                            Can I withdraw cash using a Credit Card?

Yes, cash withdrawal is possible at ATMs. Cash advances attract interest and transaction fees from the transaction date.

                            What is revolving credit?

Revolving credit is a repayment option that allows you to pay only the minimum amount due and carry forward the remaining outstanding balance to the next billing cycle. Interest is charged on the unpaid portion until it is fully repaid.

                            Are international transactions allowed?

Yes, many ICICI Bank Credit Cards support international usage. Foreign currency mark-up charges may apply as per the card’s terms and conditions.

Fees and charges

                EXPAND ALL

                            What is a joining fee?

A joining fee is a one-time charge applied at the time of issuing a Credit Card. In many cases, the joining fee is accompanied by welcome benefits such as reward points, vouchers or other introductory offers.

                            What is an annual fee?

An annual fee is a recurring yearly charge levied for maintaining Credit Card services and associated benefits. Certain cards may offer annual fee waivers when you meet specified spending thresholds during the year.

                            Can my annual fee be waived?

Yes. Certain ICICI Bank Credit Cards offer annual fee waivers when you meet the prescribed annual spending criteria. The waiver may apply for the first year, subsequent years, or both, depending on the card’s terms and conditions.

                            What are finance charges?

Finance charges are interest costs applied to outstanding dues on your Credit Card. They may be levied on unpaid balances, cash advances, EMI conversions and amounts carried forward under revolving credit until fully repaid.

                            When do interest charges start?

Interest charges begin when the Total Amount Due is not paid on or before the due date. Interest is also applicable from the date of transaction on cash withdrawals, as there is no interest-free period on cash advances.

                            What is a late payment fee?

A late payment fee is a charge applied when the Minimum Amount Due or the Total Amount Due is not paid on or before the specified due date. The fee amount may vary based on the outstanding balance and the Credit Card’s terms and conditions.

                            Does late payment affect interest? 

  Yes. When you miss the due date, interest continues to accrue on the outstanding balance until it is cleared. Interest may also apply on new purchases until the dues are fully paid.  

                            Do late payment fees impact my credit score?

Yes. Consistent delays or missed payments may negatively affect your credit history and reduce your credit score, as payment behaviour is a key factor in credit assessment.

                            What is a forex markup fee?

                            What is MITC and where can I check the details of MITC?

MITC stands for Most Important Terms and Conditions of ICICI Bank Credit Cards. You can view the MITC, detailed Terms & Conditions and FAQs on the ICICI Bank website under the Credit Card product section in the quick links.

                            What is an e-Welcome Kit or digitised Welcome Kit?

An e-Welcome Kit is a digitised membership pack which includes the Membership Guide, Terms & Conditions and the MITC in downloadable PDF format for easy access.

                            How can I update my email address for my Credit Card?

You can update your email address through the iMobile app by going to Cards & Forex > Select your Credit Card > Manage, or via Net Banking under Cards > Credit Cards > Manage Your Credit Card.

                            I want my Credit Card delivery to be sent to an alternate address. What should I do?

Credit Cards can be delivered only to the mailing address registered with the Bank or to the nearest ICICI Bank Branch. If you are unavailable at that address, you may leave an authorisation letter with a family member along with their valid ID proof so they can receive the card on your behalf.
