Credit Card FAQs

          Search FAQs

 Basic information 

                EXPAND ALL

                            What is a Credit Card?

A Credit Card is a payment instrument issued by the Bank that allows customers to make purchases on credit within a pre-set limit. Customers can repay either the total outstanding amount or the minimum amount due on or before the due date every month.

                            What are the advantages of using a Credit Card? 

A Credit Card offers several benefits such as:
Convenient and secure payments
Interest free credit period (up to the billing cycle)
Rewards points and/or cashback
EMI payments
Credit score building
Exclusive shopping offers
Concierge services etc. 

                            What is the validity period of a Credit Card? 

                            ICICI Bank Credit Cards come with a validity of up to 7 years. 

                            What is the credit period for a Credit Card? 

The credit period typically ranges between 18-48 days, depending on your billing cycle and the date of purchase. 

                            What are the main types of ICICI Bank Credit Card? 

ICICI Bank offers a wide range of 
Credit Cards
 to suit different customer needs, including

Lifestyle credit cards

Travel credit cards

Shopping credit cards

Fuel credit cards

Co-branded credit cards

Business credit cards

Student credit cards

Cards with airport lounge benefits

Entry-level cards etc. 

To know about the credit cards offered by ICICI Bank, 
click here
.

                            What are the benefits provided by ICICI Bank Credit Cards? 

ICICI Bank Credit Cards
 offer various benefits such as:

Rewards points and cashback

Fuel savings and surcharge waiver

Domestic and International airport lounge access

EMI Conversions

Partner merchants discounts

Zero liability on lost/stolen cards

Milestone benefits etc. 

                            What is a Contactless Credit Card and how does it work? 

A Contactless Credit Card enables tap-and-pay transactions at NFC-enabled POS terminals. During contactless payments, the card does not leave the customer’s hand, thus reducing fraud risk. Also, the low-value transactions can be performed without entering a PIN (as per regulatory limits). 

                            What is a secured Credit Card and who should take it?

A Secured Credit card is issued against a Fixed Deposit placed with the Bank. There should be no lien or partial withdrawal on the Fixed Deposit at the time of issuance. It is suitable for customers who have a limited credit history or want to build/repair their credit score. The secured card is issued only to primary account holders.

                            How does a Credit Card work?

You can use your card to pay for your transactions at merchant- retail or online. Transactions are added to your account and reflected in the monthly statement. You then repay the dues by the due date.

                            What is a Credit Limit?

The Credit Limit is the maximum amount you can spend on your card at any given time. It is assigned by the Bank based on eligibility criteria.

                            What is the billing cycle?

A billing cycle is the period between two statement dates and typically ranges from 28 to 31 days.

                            What is the Total Amount Due? 

 The Total Amount Due is the full outstanding amount on your Credit Card for the billing cycle. 

                            What is the Minimum Amount Due?

It is the minimum sum you must pay by the due date to avoid late payment fees. Interest will continue to apply on the remaining balance.

                            What is a due date?

The due date is the last date by which your payment must be made to avoid late fees and maintain a healthy account status.

                            What is the interest-free period?

It is the period from the transaction date to the statement due date when no interest is charged, provided the previous balance is cleared in full.

                            What are reward points?

Reward points are loyalty points earned on eligible transactions made using your Credit Card. These accumulated points can be redeemed for various benefits such as gift vouchers, merchandise, travel bookings or statement credit, depending on the card’s rewards program.

                            Can I withdraw cash using a Credit Card?

Yes, cash withdrawal is possible at ATMs. Cash advances attract interest and transaction fees from the transaction date.

                            What is revolving credit?

Revolving credit is a repayment option that allows you to pay only the minimum amount due and carry forward the remaining outstanding balance to the next billing cycle. Interest is charged on the unpaid portion until it is fully repaid.

                            Are international transactions allowed?

Yes, many ICICI Bank Credit Cards support international usage. Foreign currency mark-up charges may apply as per the card’s terms and conditions.

Fees and charges

                EXPAND ALL

                            What is a joining fee?

A joining fee is a one-time charge applied at the time of issuing a Credit Card. In many cases, the joining fee is accompanied by welcome benefits such as reward points, vouchers or other introductory offers.

                            What is an annual fee?

An annual fee is a recurring yearly charge levied for maintaining Credit Card services and associated benefits. Certain cards may offer annual fee waivers when you meet specified spending thresholds during the year.

                            Can my annual fee be waived?

Yes. Certain ICICI Bank Credit Cards offer annual fee waivers when you meet the prescribed annual spending criteria. The waiver may apply for the first year, subsequent years, or both, depending on the card’s terms and conditions.

                            What are finance charges?

Finance charges are interest costs applied to outstanding dues on your Credit Card. They may be levied on unpaid balances, cash advances, EMI conversions and amounts carried forward under revolving credit until fully repaid.

                            When do interest charges start?

Interest charges begin when the Total Amount Due is not paid on or before the due date. Interest is also applicable from the date of transaction on cash withdrawals, as there is no interest-free period on cash advances.

                            What is a late payment fee?

A late payment fee is a charge applied when the Minimum Amount Due or the Total Amount Due is not paid on or before the specified due date. The fee amount may vary based on the outstanding balance and the Credit Card’s terms and conditions.

                            Does late payment affect interest? 

  Yes. When you miss the due date, interest continues to accrue on the outstanding balance until it is cleared. Interest may also apply on new purchases until the dues are fully paid.  

                            Do late payment fees impact my credit score?

Yes. Consistent delays or missed payments may negatively affect your credit history and reduce your credit score, as payment behaviour is a key factor in credit assessment.

                            What is a forex markup fee?

A forex markup fee is an additional charge applied on international transactions, including purchases made in foreign currencies or when using the card outside India. It is calculated as a percentage of the transaction value.

                            How does currency conversion work?

For international transactions, the amount is first converted into INR using the card network’s exchange rate. The applicable forex markup percentage is then added to the converted value and reflected in your statement.

                            Are there any GST charges?

Yes. GST is applicable on Credit Card fees, interest, and other service-related charges as per prevailing tax regulations. The GST amount will be reflected in your monthly statement.

Eligibility and documentation

                EXPAND ALL

                            How do I apply for a Credit Card online? 

You can apply through the ICICI Bank website or mobile app by providing basic personal and income details. Once submitted, the Bank will verify your eligibility and inform you of the application status.

                            What is the minimum age to apply?

Primary Credit Card applicants must generally be 18 years or older. The eligible age for Plus Card (Add-on card) may begin from 12 years onward, depending on the card type and Bank policy.

                            Do I need a bank account with ICICI Bank to apply?

No. You may apply for an ICICI Bank Credit Card even if you do not hold an ICICI Bank account. Approval is subject to eligibility, documentation and verification.

                            Why has my Credit Card application been rejected?

A Credit Card application may be declined due to factors such as insufficient credit history, low credit score, inadequate income, incorrect or incomplete documentation, multiple recent applications, or non-fulfilment of the Bank’s internal eligibility criteria.

                            Does my CIBIL score affect eligibility?

Yes. A good CIBIL score and a strong repayment history improve your chances of Credit Card approval and may also support a higher credit limit. Poor or inconsistent credit behaviour can reduce eligibility.

                            Do I need a PAN card to apply?

Yes. A PAN card is mandatory for Credit Card issuance and is required to assess eligibility, verify identity and comply with regulatory norms.

                            Are Aadhaar and PAN mandatory to link?

Yes. Linking Aadhaar and PAN is required as per regulatory guidelines to complete KYC, verify customer identity and enable smooth processing of the Credit Card application.

                            Will I be informed if my application is rejected?

Yes. You will receive a communication regarding the rejection along with broad reasons such as eligibility or documentation issues. However, the exact internal credit assessment parameters may not be disclosed.

                            How do I check the status of my Credit Card application?

You can track your application status online using the “Track My Application” option on the ICICI Bank website or through the iMobile app. You may need to enter your registered mobile number, application number or reference details to view the status.

                            Can I apply for a Credit Card if I have an ongoing loan?

Yes. You can apply for a Credit Card even if you have an active loan. Approval will depend on your overall credit profile, including repayment history, income stability and existing debt obligations.

                            Does ICICI Bank give Credit Cards to students?

Yes. ICICI Bank offers Credit Cards to eligible final-year students of select top colleges/institutes under specific student card programmes. Issuance is subject to the Bank’s internal criteria, college listing and successful verification of documents.

                            Can NRI customers apply?

Yes. NRI customers may apply for eligible ICICI Bank Credit Cards, subject to product availability, regulatory guidelines and completion of required documentation.

                            Can retired individuals apply?

Yes. Retired individuals can apply for Credit Cards based on pension income, savings or by opting for secured cards issued against a Fixed Deposit, subject to Bank evaluation and verification.

                            What if I do not have a credit score?

If you do not have a credit score, you may opt for a secured Credit Card issued against a Fixed Deposit or apply for an entry-level card, which can help you start building your credit history through responsible usage and timely repayments.

Credit limit and usage

                EXPAND ALL

                            How is my credit limit decided?

Your Credit Card limit is determined based on multiple factors such as your declared income, existing repayment history, type of card applied for and the Bank’s internal risk evaluation. Limits may be revised over time based on usage and performance.

                            Can I request a limit increase?

Yes. You can request a credit limit increase through iMobile, Net Banking or by contacting customer support. Approval is subject to usage patterns, repayment behaviour, income documentation and overall credit profile.

                            Can a limit be reduced?

Yes. The Bank may reduce the credit limit based on internal risk assessments, regulatory requirements or changes in your creditworthiness. 

                            How often can I change my Credit Card limits?

You may request a change in your credit limit at any time. Approval frequency depends on usage history, repayment behaviour, income documents and the Bank’s internal eligibility criteria.

                            What is a self-set limit on my Credit Card?

A self-set limit is a feature that allows you to define your own spending limit on the Credit Card, lower than the assigned limit. It helps you control expenses, manage usage and enhance security.

                            What is a temporary credit-limit enhancement on my Credit Card?

A temporary credit-limit enhancement allows you to use a higher credit limit for a short period when you need additional spending capacity. You can request this by contacting the ICICI Bank Customer Care Centre, and the approval is at the Bank’s discretion. This facility is available only after 9 months of card membership and is granted based on your credit history.

                            How do I manage my Credit Card usage controls?

You can manage usage controls through the iMobile Pay app by setting spend limits, enabling or disabling domestic or international transactions, and controlling specific channels such as online, POS or ATM.

                            Why is my international transaction getting declined?

Your international transaction may be declined if international usage is disabled on your Credit Card. You can enable it through the iMobile app under cards controls.

                            How do I link my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with iMobile for UPI payments?

To link your RuPay Credit Card, log in to the iMobile app, go to UPI Payments, select UPI Settings, choose Link your RuPay Credit Card to UPI, enter and confirm your preferred UPI ID, select your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card and tap Confirm to complete the process.

                            How can I reduce my ICICI Bank Credit Card limit?

You can reduce your ICICI Bank Credit Card limit through the following options:

ICICI Bank iMobile App:

Log in to the app

Go to ‘Cards/Forex/PayLater’ and select your Credit Card

Select ‘Manage Card’

Click on ‘Manage Credit Limit’ under ‘More options’

Adjust the spend limit and submit

Net Banking:

Log in to ICICI Bank Net Banking

Click on ‘Cards’ > ‘Credit Card’

Select ‘Modify Credit Limit’ and proceed.

Customer Care/Branch:

Contact ICICI Bank Customer Care or visit a branch to request a reduction in your credit limit.

                                              Rewards & Offers                                              

                EXPAND ALL

                            What is ICICI Bank Rewards?

ICICI Bank Rewards is a loyalty program that allows you to earn reward points on eligible transactions made using your Credit Card on ICICI Bank Rewards Programme, which can later be redeemed for vouchers, merchandise, travel or statement credit depending on the card’s benefits.

                            How can I redeem my ICICI Bank Rewards?

You can redeem your ICICI Bank Reward Points through Net Banking by selecting Cards > Credit Cards > Reward Points > Redeem Now, or through the iMobile app by navigating to Cards & Forex, selecting your Credit Card and viewing the available points to redeem. Points can be redeemed for merchandise, e-vouchers, travel bookings, statement credit and other catalogue options based on your card’s rewards program.

                            How can I view my reward points summary?

You can view your reward points balance and redemption history through iMobile app or Net Banking.

                            What are the minimum reward points required to redeem?

The minimum reward points required for redemption vary based on the product or service category selected on the ICICI Bank Rewards portal and each item will display its respective points requirement. 

                            Are EMIs eligible for reward points?

No. EMIs, including transactions converted into EMI, are generally not eligible for reward points as per the card’s terms and conditions.

                            Are reward points equal to currency?

No. Reward points are not equivalent to currency and have a redemption value determined by the Bank. The value may vary across products, services or catalogue categories.

                            Do add-on card spends earn reward points?

Yes. Eligible spends made on add-on cards earn reward points, which are accumulated under the primary cardholder’s account.

                            What is accelerated reward?

Accelerated reward refers to the benefit of earning additional reward points on specific categories or partner merchants, such as travel, hotel bookings or online shopping, beyond the standard earn rate.

                            What are the Terms and Conditions for redeeming products?

The Terms and Conditions for redemption include reward point validity, applicable delivery timelines, return or replacement policies and the points required for each product category as listed on the ICICI Bank Rewards portal.

                            Do Reward points expire?

Yes. ICICI Bank Reward Points issued on ICICI Bank Credit Cards carry a validity of 3 years from the date of issuance, after which they automatically expire if not redeemed.

                            Why did I not receive reward points for my purchase?

You may not receive reward points if the transaction type is not eligible under the rewards program. Certain spends such as fuel, cash withdrawals, EMI conversions, fee payments or wallet loads may not earn reward points as per the card’s terms and conditions.

                            Do I lose my reward points if I close my Credit Card?

Yes. Any unredeemed reward points will be forfeited when you close your Credit Card account.

                            Can I redeem points for bill payment or statement credit?

Yes, but only if your specific ICICI Bank Credit Card offers this feature, as redemption options vary by card type and rewards program.

                            Are there any charges for redemption of reward points?

Yes. A Redemption Handling Fee of ₹99 plus applicable GST is charged for every redemption request. This fee along with the GST amount, will appear in your monthly Credit Card statement.

                            Can I change the item I have ordered if the number of reward points being redeemed are the same?

No. Once a redemption request is placed, the selected item cannot be changed, even if the reward points required remain the same.

                                              Travel & Lifestyle                                              

                EXPAND ALL

                            What is Airport Lounge Access?

Airport Lounge Access is a benefit offered on eligible ICICI Bank Credit Cards that provides complimentary visits to domestic or international airport lounges, allowing you to relax and enjoy services such as seating, refreshments and Wi-Fi before your flight. 

                            Which is the best Credit Card for travel benefits?

ICICI Bank offers several travel-focused Credit Cards such as Sapphiro, Emeralde, Emeralde Private Metal, and select co-branded travel cards that provide premium perks including airport lounge access, travel rewards, concierge services and partner privileges. 

                            How do I activate Priority Pass membership?

The Priority Pass sent along with your Credit Card is already activated and can be used directly for accessing international airport lounges. No additional activation steps are required.

                            Where can I find the list of Lounge details where Priority Pass is accepted?

Priority Pass lounges are searchable at prioritypass.com > Lounge Search; Priority Pass covers a wide global network of lounges - check the site of Priority Pass for the latest lounge list.

                            Which Credit Card offers fuel savings?

ICICI Bank fuel credit cards such as the HPCL Super Saver Credit Card provide benefits like fuel surcharge waiver, accelerated reward points on fuel spends and cashback at partner fuel stations.

                            How do I avail the BookMyShow offer?

To avail the BookMyShow offer, select your movie, seats, location and showtime, proceed to the payment page, accept the terms and conditions, open the Offers/Apply Promo Codes section, choose Credit Cards, search for ICICI, select the applicable offer for your card (for example, “Up to ₹500 off on 2nd ticket” or “25% off up to ₹100 on 2nd ticket”), enter your complete Credit Card number and continue to make the payment.

                            Is there a limit on the free movie ticket value?

Yes. The value of the complimentary movie ticket is capped as per the specific offer and terms applicable to your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Limits may vary based on the card variant.

                            Is there a limit on the price of the free movie ticket on BookMyShow?

Yes. The free ticket value under the BookMyShow offer is capped based on your ICICI Bank Credit Card type:

                            I applied for the offer, but my transaction did not get through on BookMyShow. Now I am unable to avail the offer. What should I do?

If you see “Transaction failed,” wait 20 minutes and retry; if message is “Stock for the day is exhausted,” the offer inventory is depleted.

                            My booking has been rejected, but my credit card has been charged. What do I do?

If the booking failed but you were charged, BookMyShow will send a reversal request the same day; the charge should reverse automatically. You may contact Customer Care if reversal is delayed.

                            Do I get complimentary travel insurance with my Credit Card?

Some ICICI Bank Credit Cards offer complimentary travel insurance, available only on select card variants and subject to eligibility, coverage limits and the card’s terms and conditions. For detailed policy coverage, limits and claim procedures, please refer to the Terms & Conditions provided on the respective credit card product page.

                            Are movie offers available on weekends or only weekdays? 

Movie offers on ICICI Bank Credit Cards are available on all days, subject to offer terms and daily quota availability.

Card delivery

                EXPAND ALL

                            Will I be intimated with courier details of credit card once it is dispatched from the Bank?

Yes. You will receive SMS and email alerts with courier name and airway bill number when the card is dispatched.

                            My Credit Card is undelivered and returned to the Bank. How can I get it re-dispatched?

You can request re-dispatch of your Credit Card through Net Banking under Cards > Credit Cards > Manage Your Credit Card > View All > Replacement or renewal card not received, or by calling Customer Care from your registered mobile number. The first delivery attempt will be made within 5 working days from the date of request.

                            My Credit Card is going to expire. When will I receive the renewal card?

You will typically receive your renewal Credit Card about 10 days before your current card’s expiry date. Your existing card remains valid until the last day of the month printed on the card. If you do not receive the renewal card, you can raise a request through Net Banking or by contacting Customer Care.

                            What if I do not receive the renewal card?

If you do not receive your renewal Credit Card, you can raise a non-receipt request through Net Banking under Cards > Credit Cards > Manage Your Credit Card > View All > Replacement/Renewal card not received, or call Customer Care from your registered mobile number for assistance.

                            I have blocked my Credit Card. How can I get a replacement card?

You can request a replacement Credit Card by calling Customer Care from your registered mobile number. Once the request is placed, the first delivery attempt is typically made within 5 working days.

Card access and payment

                EXPAND ALL

                            How do I see my Credit Card number online?

You can view your Credit Card number by logging into the iMobile app or Net Banking and selecting your Credit Card details.

                            How can I know whether my mobile number is registered with ICICI Bank?

If you receive transaction alerts on your mobile, your number is registered; alternatively call Customer Care from your registered mobile number for confirmation.

                            I want the User ID and Password for my ICICI Bank Credit Card login. How do I get them?

To get your User ID, call Customer Care and follow the self-banking option; to generate a password, use the “Get Password” link on the ICICI Bank login page and follow the steps to validate your registered mobile number.

                            How can I change my credit card User ID?

You can change your Net Banking User ID for credit cards by logging in to Net Banking > My Profile > Update user ID; note this is a one-time change

                            How do I register credit card for online bill payment?

Register your card as a biller via Net Banking: Payments & Transfer > Pay Bills > Bill Payment >Credit Card > Select “ICICI Bank Credit Card” and provide the 16-digit card number to complete registration.

                            How do I enable online transaction on my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Log in to iMobile Pay > Cards & Forex > Choose your Credit Card > Manage Card > Enable Online/International/Tap & Pay, or use Net Banking > Cards > Credit Cards > Manage your Card > View All > Manage Credit Card >  Manage Credit Card Usage.

                            Can I get an OTP by e-mail for my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

No. For security, OTPs are sent only to your registered mobile number; ensure your mobile number is updated with the Bank.

                            How do I pay my Credit Card bill?

You can pay your Credit Card bill through iMobile App, Net Banking, UPI, NEFT, auto-debit, cheque or cash payment, depending on your preference.

                            Can I pay through ATM?

Yes. You can make your payment through select ICICI Bank ATMs that accept cash or cheque deposits for Credit Card payments.

                            What happens if cheque payment is delayed?

If your cheque payment is not received and cleared by the due date, late payment charges and interest will be applied on the outstanding amount as per the Credit Card Terms & Conditions.

                            What happens if I make excess payment?

Any excess amount paid becomes a credit balance on your Credit Card account and will be automatically adjusted against your future transactions or outstanding dues.

                            Can I make the payment of amount due on card deducting the refund received from merchant?

Yes. Merchant refunds, reversals, chargebacks or permanent fraud credits posted to your card are treated as payments and will be adjusted against your outstanding balance.

                            I made an excess payment to my credit card by mistake. How can I get it back?

Excess payment is automatically adjusted toward future transactions; for queries call Customer Care or email customer.care@icicibank.com from your registered email with the last 4 digits of your card.

                            Can I change my billing cycle?

Yes. You may request a change in your billing cycle once every six months, provided this feature is available on your specific Credit Card. Approval is subject to the Bank’s internal policies.

                            Is there any charge for online bill payment facility on credit card?

No. Bill payment facility through Net Banking is free of cost.

                            How will my payment get adjusted in case of cash withdrawal?

Payments are allocated in a prescribed order: income and charges, then EMI principal, cash principal and retail principal, as per the Bank’s payment application logic. 

                            The ICICI Bank Credit card payment was made but is not reflecting online - what should I do?

Please allow up to 24 hours for the payment to reflect in your Credit Card account. If it still does not appear after this period, contact Customer Care with the payment reference details for assistance.

                            How should I set up Auto Debit on my Credit Card?

You can set up Auto Debit through the iMobile app by selecting Cards & Forex > Choose your Credit Card > Manage > Manage Auto Pay, or via Net Banking under Cards > Credit Cards > Manage Your Credit Card > View All > Manage Auto Pay. You can also activate Auto Debit by submitting the printed Auto Debit form to the Bank.

                            From where can I get the auto debit form?

Download the Auto-Debit form from www.icic.ibank.in > Form Center > Auto-Debit Facility under Credit Card, fill, sign and send to the address on the form; you can also activate auto-debit online via Net Banking or iMobile if linked to the savings account.

                            Will auto-debit get activated on my credit card automatically if I link my Savings account to my credit card?

No. Linking accounts does not activate auto-debit; you must complete the Auto Debit registration process to enable it.

                            How can I change the Auto Debit option from Minimum Amount Due to Total Amount Due or vice versa?

You can change the Auto Debit option through the iMobile app or Net Banking or by calling Customer Care from your registered mobile number and completing authentication.

                            What are the conditions of Auto Debit?

If Auto Debit is for minimum due and you make a partial payment less than minimum due, Auto Debit will only take the remaining minimum.

If Auto Debit is for total due and you make a part payment, Auto Debit will collect the remaining total due.

Auto Debit will not trigger if payment is made 5 days before the due date.

                            I want to convert a transaction into EMI. What are the EMI tenure options available?

Retail transactions of ₹1,500 and above can be converted into EMI with tenure options of 3, 6, 9, 12, 18 or 24 months. Cash, jewellery and fuel transactions are not eligible for EMI conversion.

                            Can I change my EMI or PLCC EMI billing date?

No. EMI billing dates cannot be changed; the EMI amount will continue to appear in your Credit Card statement.

                            How can I make the payment towards my credit card EMI transactions?

EMI amounts are included in your monthly Credit Card statement and can be paid through any regular Credit Card payment method; no separate payment is required.

                            Will a separate statement be generated for my PLCC account?

No. New PLCC conversions follow the same statement date and payment due date as your Credit Card.

                            Can I foreclose or prepay my loan on my Credit Card?

Yes. You can foreclose the EMI or PLCC on your credit card through iMobile app by visiting Cards & Forex > Manage Card > EMI  Closure  or through Net Banking by visiting Cards > Credit Card > EMI  Closure . Alternatively, you can foreclose your EMI or PLCC loan by calling Customer Care from your registered mobile number or by emailing customer.care@icicibank.com with the last four digits of your Credit Card for further assistance. Part-payment option is not provided in EMI or PLCC.

                            Will I earn reward points after converting a transaction into EMI?

No. Reward points are not earned on EMI transactions or on purchases that have been converted into EMI.

                            How do I check the remaining EMI tenure?

You can check your remaining EMI tenure through the iMobile app, Net Banking or by contacting Customer Care from your registered mobile number.

                            How do I place a request for an amortisation/repayment schedule?

You can download a soft copy of the amortisation schedule on iMobile by visiting Cards & forex>Manage Card>EMI Summary> download by selecting the PLCC/EMI transaction or alternatively you can request a soft copy of the amortisation/repayment schedule by calling Customer Care or by emailing customer.care@icicibank.com with the last four digits of your Credit Card. Soft copies are sent to your registered email ID within 1 working day.

                                              Interest Charges & Statements                                              

                EXPAND ALL

                            Want to know why interest charges are levied on my Credit Card?

Interest is charged when the Total Amount Due is not paid by the due date. It accrues on the total outstanding balance and on all new transactions from the transaction date until previous dues are fully cleared. Interest is also levied on cash advances from the date of withdrawal until repayment.

                            When will the interest charge stop on my Credit Card?

Interest charges stop immediately once the complete outstanding dues are paid in full as per the statement and within the due date.

                            How do I place a request for an interest calculation sheet?

You can request a soft copy or physical copy of the interest calculation sheet by calling Customer Care or by emailing customer.
care@icicibank.com with the last four digits of your Credit Card. Soft copies are sent to your registered email ID within 3 days, and physical copies are delivered to your registered mailing address within 7 days of the request.

                            How do I open my Credit Card e-statement?

Your e-statement is password protected. The password consists of the first four letters of your name (as printed on your Credit Card, in lowercase) followed by your date and month of birth in DDMM format. The password is case sensitive and should not include spaces or special characters. If you are unable to open the statement, please contact Customer Care for assistance.

                            How do I get my Credit Card Account statement?

You can view and download your Credit Card statement through the iMobile app by selecting Cards & Forex > View Statement to access current, last, past or annual statements. You can also retrieve statements via Net Banking under Cards > Credit Cards. Statements can additionally be emailed to you on request.

                            How many months of statements can I view online?

You can view your current statement, last statement and past statements going back up to 5 years. You can also select a custom date range to view or download older statements within this available period through Net Banking or the iMobile app.

                            Can I get a waiver or reversal of late payment or interest charges?

ICICI Bank may review waiver requests on a case-by-case basis, subject to internal assessment.

                                              Disputes, Fraud & Security                                              

                EXPAND ALL

                            What should I do upon receiving my Credit Card?

Upon receiving your Credit Card, sign on the back of the card, activate it as instructed, set your PIN and enable the required transaction channels such as online, international or contactless usage through the iMobile app or Net Banking.

                            What should I do if I lose my Credit Card?

You should block your Credit Card immediately through the iMobile app under Cards & Forex > Block, or via Net Banking by navigating to Cards > Credit Cards > Manage Your Credit Card > Block Card. You can also call Customer Care from your registered mobile number or visit the nearest ICICI Bank branch to block the card and request a replacement.

                            I realised that I’ve lost my card after receiving transaction alerts. The transactions happened without my knowledge. Can I raise a dispute?

You may raise a dispute; however, claims for transactions made before the card was blocked may not be accepted, as financial liability for unauthorised transactions prior to blocking rests with the cardholder.

                            What should I keep in mind while visiting high-risk countries?

When travelling to high-risk countries, inform the Bank in advance, enable only the required transaction channels on your Credit Card, and monitor all SMS and email alerts closely for any unusual activity. It is also advisable to replace your card after returning if it was used in a high-risk region.

                            How can I withdraw a dispute initiated on my Credit Card?

You can withdraw a dispute by calling Customer Care from your registered mobile number or by emailing customer.care@icicibank.com  with the last four digits of your Credit Card and the request details

                            What documents do I need to submit for a disputed transaction?

You must download and fill the Transaction Dispute Form (CDF) from the ICICI Bank website and submit it along with supporting documents based on the dispute type. For example, provide merchant communication for goods or services not received, cancellation proof for unprocessed refunds, or payment proof if the transaction was paid by another mode.

                            Why is my ICICI Bank Credit Card declined due to security reasons?

Your Credit Card may be declined for security reasons if the Bank detects suspicious activity, a high-risk payment location, incorrect OTP entry or an unusual spending pattern. To confirm and unblock the card if required, please contact Customer Care on 1800 1080 from your registered mobile number.

                            What if the customer is passing by a terminal and a contactless transaction takes place?

A contactless transaction cannot occur accidentally. The card must be held within close proximity (around 4 cm) of the terminal, and the cashier must first enter the transaction amount before the tap is processed.

                            What if there is a fraudulent transaction?

If you notice a fraudulent transaction, report it to the Bank immediately. The Bank will investigate the issue and may provide temporary liability protection based on the card’s terms and the time of reporting. Blocking your card promptly helps prevent further unauthorised use.

                            What if the customer waves the Contactless Credit Card twice at the terminal? Will he or she be charged twice?

No. Even if the card is tapped multiple times, the system processes only one transaction for the purchase.

                            How can I block my Credit Card?

You can block your Credit Card instantly through the iMobile app under Cards & Forex > Block, or via Net Banking by navigating to Cards > Credit Cards > Manage Your Credit Card > Block Card. You can also block the card by calling Customer Care from your registered mobile number or by visiting the nearest ICICI Bank branch.

                            What should I keep in mind for online transactions?

For online transactions, always use secure websites, avoid using public or unsecured Wi-Fi, ensure OTP-based authentication is enabled and never share card details or respond to phishing emails claiming to be from the Bank.

                            Can I temporarily lock my Credit Card?

Yes. You can temporarily lock your Credit Card through Net Banking or the iMobile app, or by calling Customer Care from your registered mobile number.

                            What should I do if my Credit Card is stuck in an ATM?

You should immediately block your Credit Card temporarily through Net Banking, the iMobile app or by contacting Customer Care, and then request further assistance or a replacement card if required.

                            Can anyone call Customer Care or visit a branch and change the limit on my card?

No. A third party cannot request a limit change on your behalf. The Bank will authenticate the account holder before processing any limit modification request.

                            Can I have only one User ID for all ICICI Bank relationships?

Yes. You can link multiple ICICI Bank relationships—such as savings accounts, Credit Cards and Demat Accounts—to a single Net Banking User ID, provided key details like your name, date of birth and communication address match. Joint account linking is subject to specific rules.

The CVV is a 3-digit code printed on the signature strip on the back of Visa and MasterCard Credit Cards. For American Express cards, the CVV is a 4-digit code printed on the front of the card.

You can reset your 3D Secure PIN or ATM PIN through the iMobile app, Net Banking or at any ICICI Bank ATM by following the PIN change instructions.

Fuel Credit Card FAQs

Is there an option to apply for an ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card online?

You can apply for a Fuel Credit Card online by visiting the ICICI Bank website and selecting a card that best suits your needs. Make sure to check the eligibility criteria. Fill out the application form with your details. You can also visit any ICICI Bank branch and a Bank representative will help you apply for a Credit Card. Keep your documents like proof of identity, proof of address and Income statements handy.

What is the minimum due for an ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card?

The minimum due is the smallest amount you need to pay by the due date to avoid late fee. It is around 5% of your total outstanding balance plus any Equated Monthly Instalment (EMI) instalments, interest, fees or overdue amounts. 

Will paying the minimum due save me from a penalty? 

Yes. Paying only the minimum due will help you avoid a penalty. However, it will lead to interest charges on the remaining balance.

How can I use an ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card for an in-store purchase? 

To use your ICICI Bank Credit Card for an in-store purchase, just swipe or tap your card on the card machine and enter your Personal Identification Number (PIN). 

How can I pay the bill for my ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card? 

You can pay your ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card bill through Net Banking, ICICI Bank's iMobile app, the iMobile app, National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT), Unified Payments Interface (UPI), by setting up the Auto Debit facility for your account or by visiting an ICICI Bank branch or an Automated Teller Machine (ATM).

How can I know the due date of my ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card?

You can check the due date of your ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card through the monthly statements, the iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling 1800 1080.

What are ICICI Bank Credit Card reward points?

If you are a cardholder, you will earn ICICI Bank reward points on various transactions. These points can be redeemed through the Net Banking or ICICI Bank's iMobile app. You can use them to purchase products, vouchers, E-Gift Cards and more.

What is a fuel surcharge waiver on a Credit Card? What are the other benefits of a Fuel Credit Card?

A fuel surcharge waiver is a Fuel Credit Card benefit from ICICI Bank, waiving off the additional fee or surcharge that is typically added to fuel purchases. You can avail this benefit if you have a Fuel Credit Card from ICICI Bank. Other benefits of a Fuel Credit Card include cashback, reward points on fuel purchases and exclusive discounts on other utilities, making this fuel Credit Card an excellent choice for savings on fuel expenses.

What are Fuel Credit Cards?

If you are an individual seeking financial flexibility, ICICI Bank Credit Cards are exactly what you need. You get benefits like cashback, reward points and exclusive access to premium services, all while experiencing the joy of hassle-free payments. ICICI Bank provides a diverse range of Credit Cards keeping in mind the varying needs of every individual.

What is the lowest Credit Card limit?

The lowest Credit Card limit varies depending on the card issuer. Call 1800 1080 for more details.

How can I see my ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card number online?

To find your ICICI Bank Credit Card number, log in to ICICI Bank's iMobile app and view your details.

How can I redeem Credit Card reward points?

First, log in to ICICI Bank's iMobile app. Go to the ‘Services’ section > Accounts Services > View Reward Points. From the dropdown, select your Credit Card number and then click on ‘Submit’. You will be able to view your reward points. Click on ‘Redeem Now’. You can redeem your ICICI Bank reward points across multiple categories such as Electronics, Lifestyle, Luxury, Shopping and Travel.

How can I increase the limit of ICICI Bank Fuel Credit Card through ICICI Bank's iMobile app?

You can increase your credit limit through ICICI Bank's iMobile app by navigating to the ‘Cards or Forex or Paylater’ section. Select your ‘Card Number’. Go to ‘Manage Card’. Click on ‘Manage Credit Limit’ (under More options). Select the ‘Desired Credit Limit’ and click on ‘Submit’. In case of any queries, call 1800 1080.

How can I check my Credit Card details online? 

To check your 
ICICI Bank Credit Card
 details, log in to  ICICI Bank's iMobile app. Here, you can view all the details related to your Credit Card.

What is a petroleum Credit Card?

A petroleum Credit Card is the same as a Fuel Credit Card. This Credit Card is designed to offer savings on fuel purchases. ICICI Bank’s Fuel Credit Cards provide cashback, reward points and fuel surcharge waivers when used at petrol pumps. These Cards partner with fuel companies and are perfect for daily commuters looking to reduce monthly fuel costs while earning rewards.

Can I use a Fuel Credit Card at any fuel station?

You can apply for a Fuel Credit Card from ICICI Bank and use it at most fuel stations, but the best benefits are usually applicable only at specific partner outlets. Using the Card at pumps other than the partner pumps might not offer rewards or surcharge waivers, so read the terms and conditions carefully before applying for a Card or using it.

Are there Credit Cards specifically for diesel as fuel?

Cashback and Reward points on most Fuel Credit Cards apply to diesel purchases also. They also offer surcharge waivers on fuel spends, regardless of fuel type. However, always check the Card’s terms and partner fuel stations to reconfirm whether diesel purchases are eligible for benefits and rewards.

Generate ICICI Bank Credit Card PIN Online

Below are other points about ICICI Bank Credit Card PIN generation you should keep in mind:

To generate your Credit Card PIN online, the Credit Card must be active. 

 To use our Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system for generating the Credit Card PIN or to place a request for the PIN to be sent to your communication address, all you have to do is call on 1800 1080 

 Your Credit Card PIN generation OTP will always be sent to your registered mobile number 

If you are an ICICI Bank Credit Cardholder, you can easily add or update your registered mobile number by visiting any ICICI Bank branch. Make sure to carry your physical Credit Card, proof of address and photo proof of identity

Online methods to generate your Credit Card PIN

You can generate your Credit Card PIN online through Net Banking or the ICICI Bank’s iMobile app. Both of these methods involve secure authentication processes to make sure that only an authorised person can make changes to the PIN.

Credit Card PIN generation through Bet Banking

Follow the below steps to generate Credit Card PIN through Net Banking.

Log in to ICICI Bank Net Banking 

From the left-hand side menu, select ‘Generate  Card PIN’ from Services

Select ‘Credit Card Pin

Choose your Card and enter your CVV

Click on ‘Submit’ to get the OTP on your registered mobile number

Enter the OTP and click on ‘Set New PIN’ and submit

Congratulations! Your PIN has been generated.

Credit Card PIN generation through iICICI Bank’s iMobile app

Follow the steps below to generate PIN through ICICI Bank’s iMobile app

Log in to the ICICI Bank’s iMobile app and select ‘Services’ 

Click on ‘Card Pin Services’

tap on ‘Generate PIN’

Select your Card and set your Credit Card PIN and tap on ‘Submit’

Congratulations! Your new PIN has been generated.

Credit Card PIN generation through ATM

Follow the steps below to generate the PIN at any ICICI Bank ATM:

Visit any ICICI Bank ATM, carrying your Credit Card
Insert the Card and select ‘Generate PIN’ from the menu
Enter your registered mobile number and follow the on-screen prompts
You will receive an OTP on your registered mobile number. Enter this OTP and set your desired 4-digit PIN to complete the process.

Credit Card PIN generation on call

Follow the steps below to generate the PIN on call:

Call ICICI Bank’s Customer Care on 1800 1080 from your registered mobile number
Use the IVR system to request for Credit Card PIN generation
You will receive an OTP on your registered mobile number
Enter this OTP and follow the prompts to generate your PIN or to request a PIN to be sent by post to your address.

Reissue of Credit Card PIN

In case you have forgotten your Credit Card PIN, you can easily request for reissue of the PIN. One of the ways is through the Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system provided by the Bank. This process involves following automated prompts to verify your identity and request for reissue of the PIN. You can also request for the same through Net Banking or ICICI Bank’s iMobile app.

Conclusion

Generating your PIN online through the ICICI Bank’s iMobile app or Net Banking is quick, convenient and secure. Once you have generated or updated your 
Credit Card
 PIN online, you can start using credit card for carrying out transactions.

Credit Card PIN Generation Online – FAQs

What is a Credit Card PIN?

A Credit Card PIN is a unique code that adds extra security to protect your account from fraud and unauthorised access.

When do you need this PIN?

You may need to enter your Credit Card PIN in several scenarios, such as withdrawing cash from the ATM or for making purchases.

Wondering how to find your Credit Card PIN?

You can find it in the Welcome Kit that you received when you first got your Card. Never share your PIN with anyone, to avoid fraudulent activity.

Can I use this PIN for cash withdrawals?

Yes, you can use the same PIN for cash withdrawals through ATMs. Please note that terms of the Cash Withdrawal facility will be as communicated at the time of delivery of your card. For more information on the same, please contact our Customer Care.

Can I use my Chip and PIN credit card overseas?

Yes, you can use your Chip and PIN Credit Card overseas. Please note that in a few countries, Chip and PIN cards are not the market norm and all the Point Of Sale (POS) terminals may not ask for the PIN. In such a scenario, you can continue to use your card by swiping the magnetic stripe.

Do I need to register my new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure for online transactions?

Yes, you will need to register your new Chip and PIN card for 3D Secure (Verified by VISA or MasterCard SecureCode or American Express Safekey) for online transactions at www.icicibank.com

How do I convert my existing magnetic stripe credit card to Chip and PIN Credit Card?

Please call our Customer Care to convert your existing magnetic stripe Credit Card to Chip and PIN Credit Card.

What is a Chip and PIN Credit Card?

ICICI Bank 
Chip Credit Cards
 come with an embedded micro chip which provides additional security against counterfeiting or duplication of the card. It also provides an extra layer of security in the form of a Personal Identification Number (PIN). You will be required to enter your 4-digit PIN on the terminal for transactions at merchant outlets.

Will I receive a separate PIN for my Add-on cards?

Yes, you will receive a separate PIN at your mailing address for each Add-on card that has been issued to you.

Would every POS terminal ask for a PIN?

All merchants in India are progressively moving towards Chip and PIN configuration on their terminals. If the terminal is already configured for a Chip and PIN card, it will prompt for a PIN for transactions on the Chip and PIN card. If the terminal is not configured for a Chip and PIN card, you can continue to use your card without entering the PIN.

When will I receive my Credit Card PIN?

Your 4-digit PIN will be sent to you separately at your mailing address and should reach you within 7 working days of receiving your Credit Card.

Alternatively, to generate Pin number for your ICICI Bank credit card please follow the below steps.

Net Banking:

Login to Net Banking with your user ID and password > My Accounts > Credit Cards > Generate Credit Card PIN Online

(to be used only for Primary card PIN generation, for Add-on card same is not applicable)

Pin generation through iMobile:

Login to ICICI Bank iMobile app > Click on Smartkeys & Services > Click on Card Services > Generate Credit card Pin. Enter the required details and submit.

Customer Care:

Dial our Customer Care from your registered mobile number and follow the instructions to generate the PIN.

To know the local Customer Care numbers, please 
click here
.

Please note:

1. After 3 incorrect PIN attempts your PIN will be blocked and you have to generate a new PIN.

2. After 9 incorrect PIN entry attempts your card will be blocked automatically and you will need to call our Customer Care for issuance of a replacement Credit Card.

How can I activate my ICICI Bank Credit Card without a bank account?

You can activate your ICICI Bank Credit Card even without a bank account. The process is simple - just call Customer Care on 1800 1080 and our team will help you. Keep your registered mobile number ready for verification, receive the OTP and set your PIN.

How can you change your existing ICICI Bank Credit Card PIN online?

You can change your ICICI Bank Credit Card PIN through Net Banking or the ICICI Bank iMobile app by following these steps:

Via ICICI Bank iMobile app

Log in to the app

2. Select ‘Services’ and click on ‘UPI Services’

3. Tap on ‘Reset UPI PIN’ and select ‘Change UPI PIN’

4. Enter your old UPI PIN and set the new PIN

5. Once completed, your new PIN is generated successfully

Via ICICI Bank Net Banking

Log in to your Net Banking account

2. Navigate to Cards > Credit Cards > Set PIN

3. Enter your CVV

4. Click ‘Submit’ to receive an OTP on your registered mobile number

5. Enter the OTP, click ‘Set New PIN’, and submit

6. Your new Credit Card PIN has been generated successfully

What happens if I enter the wrong PIN multiple times?

If you enter the wrong PIN multiple times, your Credit Card may get temporarily blocked for security reasons. You may need to reset the PIN or contact customer care for assistance.

ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card FAQs

Is the HPCL Coral Credit Card from ICICI Bank?

Yes. The HPCL Coral Credit Card is an ICICI Bank Credit Card that helps you cut costs with cashback and savings on fuel transactions.

Is there a joining fee for the HPCL Coral Credit Card? 

Yes. Joining fee of ₹199 + GST.

Is there an annual fee for the HPCL Coral Credit Card? 

Yes. Annual fee of ₹199 + GST.

What is CVV on a Credit Card? How and where do I find it on my HPCL Coral Credit Card? 

Flip your HPCL Coral Credit Card to view its reverse side. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your CVV. You can also check it by logging in to your iMobile app or Internet Banking. 

Which bank has the best Credit Card?

ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card is an excellent choice and one of the 
best fuel credit card
, offering great savings and cashbacks on fuel transactions.

What is the age limit to apply for an ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card? 

You must be between the age group of 21 to 65 years to be eligible to 
apply for credit card
 and get an ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card.

How do I know the due date for my ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card bill payment? 

You can find the due date in your monthly statement, the iMobile app, through Internet Banking or by contacting our Customer Care on 1800 1080. 

Which bank provides a Credit Card at low rates? 

You can opt for an ICICI Bank Credit Card with a seamless application process. The HPCL Coral Credit Card has low joining and annual fees. For more information, please call our Customer Care on 1800 1080. 

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period. 

Please go through the below illustration to understand the spends period along with the lounge eligibility period:

Spends period offer -  eligibility period

Spend ₹25,000 between Dec 26, 2025 and Mar 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between Apr 01, 2026 and June 30, 2026. 

 Spend ₹25,000 between Mar 26, 2026 and June 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between July 01, 2026 and Sep 30, 2026.

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here 
.

Add-on/Plus card members need to individually spend ₹25,000 in the preceding spends quarter, to be eligible for the offer in the subsequent calendar quarter

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section 

 Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking 

 Choose ICICI Bank Credit Card 25% Discount Offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards 

 Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’ 

 Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page. 

What are the movie ticket benefits available?

Cardholders are eligible for a 25% off on movie ticket offer worth up to ₹100 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets through BookMyShow Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here
.

How can I earn cashback on fuel purchases with my ICICI Bank HPCL Coral Credit Card

Save up to 3.5% on fuel purchases at any HPCL fuel pump.

The fuel savings of 3.5% comprises of:

2.5% cashback when the card is swiped at any HPCL fuel pump (Capped at ₹100 per month).

1% fuel surcharge waiver when the card is swiped at any HPCL fuel pump using ICICI Bank POS machine.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please  
click here
 .

What is the difference between the HPCL Coral Credit Card and ICICI Coral Credit Card?

The HPCL Coral Credit Card offers exclusive benefits for fuel purchases at HPCL stations, providing rewards and discounts specifically for fuel transactions. The ICICI Coral Credit Card, on the other hand, offers general rewards on a wide range of categories such as dining, shopping, and travel, but does not provide the same focus on fuel benefits.

Flip your ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your CVV. You can also check it by logging in to your iMobile app or Internet Banking.

Which bank’s Credit Card should I choose?

If you are looking for the 
best fuel Credit Card
 then the ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card is an excellent choice for you. It offers many benefits and savings on fuel, utility and departmental store purchases.

What is the age limit to apply for an ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card?

You must be between the ages of 21-65 years to be eligible to 
apply for credit card
 and get ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card.

How can I know the payment due date of my ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card?

You can know the payment due date of your ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card through your monthly statements, iMobile app, Internet Banking or by calling 1800 1080.

Which bank gives Credit Cards easily at low cost?

You can opt for an ICICI Bank Credit Card as it offers a hassle-free application process. The HPCL Super Saver Credit Card has low joining and annual fees. For more information about the application process, call 1800 1080.

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

To enjoy domestic lounge access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your HPCL Super Saver Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.

Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria, 
click here
. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here (PDF, 373 KB)
.

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period.

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please

.

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

What are the movie ticket benefits available?

Cardholders are eligible for a 25% off on movie ticket offer worth up to ₹100 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets, applicable on BookMyShow and INOX, twice a month. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms and conditions, please 
click here
.

What services are included in Roadside Assistance?

Roadside Assistance includes 24X7 helpline support, on-site repairs for minor issues like flat tires or dead batteries, towing to authorised workshops for major problems, customer conference call, taxi services for up to 50 km, fuel delivery of up to 5 litres, retrieval of spare keys, custody services for vehicles and vehicle repatriation for repairs taking more than two days. To know more about roadside side assistance service and applicable terms and conditions, please 
click here (PDF, 213 KB)
 .

What is the towing benefit under Roadside Assistance?

If your vehicle is immobilised due to electrical or mechanical failure, accident or wrong fuelling, the service provider will arrange for your vehicle to be towed to the nearest authorised OEM workshop. The towing service ensures that your vehicle is safely handled and reaches the appropriate repair facility.

How does the Locked / Lost Key benefit work?

If you are locked out of your vehicle or your key is lost, the service provider will arrange for the retrieval of your spare key from your residence. This ensures that you can regain access to your vehicle without undue delay or hassle.

What is the procedure for using the Roadside Assistance service?

Customers must pay the joining/annual fee to activate Roadside Assistance. After the eligibility is confirmed, your contact details are sent to the service provider, who will then send a confirmation SMS with instructions for availing the services.

What is the Fuel Delivery benefit?

If your vehicle is immobilised due to an empty fuel tank, Roadside Assistance will arrange for the delivery of up to 5 litres of fuel as per actual cost, ensuring you can continue your journey without significant disruption.

What happens if vehicle repairs exceed two days?

If vehicle repairs take more than two days, you can opt for vehicle repatriation to your hometown for up to 100 km, free of cost. For distances beyond 100 km, repatriation services are available on a chargeable basis, ensuring flexibility for long-term repairs.

What is the Replacement / Courtesy Car benefit?

If your vehicle is immobilised and you need local mobility, a replacement or courtesy car of a higher category or the best available vehicle will be arranged at prevailing market rates.

What emergency accommodation is offered?

If your vehicle is immobilised while traveling outstation, Roadside Assistance can help arrange emergency hotel accommodations or medical services near the breakdown location, ensuring your safety and comfort during unexpected incidents.

What are the benefits of accelerated reward points on essential daily spends with ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card?

Now earn reward points on spends for all your daily essentials like utility, groceries and department store purchases. You get 5% cashback on spends across these categories. For every ₹100 spent, you earn 20 ICICI Bank Reward Points, capped at 400 ICICI Bank Reward points per month.

How can I earn cashback on fuel purchases with my ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card?

Save upto 5% on fuel purchases when the Card is swiped at any HPCL fuel pump on any bank’s POS machine or by using the HP Pay app.

You also get an additional 1.5% cashback (Happy Coins) on all fuel purchases through the HP Pay app at HPCL outlets.

The fuel savings of 5% comprises of 4% cashback + 1% fuel surcharge waiver (The 4% cashback is capped at ₹200 per month).

Why is the ICICI Bank HPCL Credit Card a good choice for fuel savings and daily expenses?

The ICICI Bank HPCL Super Saver Credit Card offers 5% savings on fuel spends at HPCL pumps and HP Pay, including a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions between ₹400 and ₹4,000. Cardholders also earn reward points on daily and retail spends, along with movie offers and roadside assistance benefits.

Image upload guidelines

Personalise your Credit Card as you like. Pick and choose from a gallery of 175+ awesome designs and flaunt it all the way! As per the guidelines, the following images will not be allowed for ICICI Bank Expressions Credit Card.

APPLY NOW

Trademarks or copyright material that is famous or recognised, including images marked with ©, ® or ™ signs

 that are famous or recognised

Violent or offensive racist images including any images in which weapons or fire arms are shown

Any religious or political images, including images that portray socially unacceptable groups or political statements

Text unless benign and in the English language

Subject matter of any nature that might result in confusion at point of sale or that might result in card fraud.

Any image that might reflect poorly or might engender hostility toward the MasterCard ® or Visa ® brands or any other network partner

Images where money or currency is focus

Any reference to the Olympic Games

FAQs

What is ICICI Bank Instant EMI?

ICICI Bank Instant EMI allows you to convert eligible Credit Card purchases into easy monthly instalments. You can shop in full and repay in parts, choosing from flexible tenure options ranging from 3 to 24 months.

What is the minimum and maximum transaction amount eligible for Instant EMI?

You can convert transactions starting from as low as ₹1,500 up to ₹10 lakh into Instant EMI, provided your ICICI Bank Credit Card has sufficient available credit at the time of the request.

Is any documentation required to avail Instant EMI?

No additional paperwork is needed! Instant EMI conversion is completely hassle-free and paperless. Just request EMI at the time of transaction, and if your card account has a sufficient credit limit, it will be approved instantly.

What are the tenure and interest rate options under Instant EMI?

ICICI Bank offers flexible tenures of 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, or 24 months. An interest rate of 15.99% p.a. is applicable across these tenures. For selected merchants, No Extra Cost EMI options are also available — the extra cost is borne by the merchant or brand, not by ICICI Bank.

How can I check and track my Instant EMI transactions?

Once your transaction is converted into Instant EMI, the details will appear clearly in your monthly Credit Card statement. You can also use the 
EMI Calculator
 on the ICICI Bank website to view and plan your repayment schedule.

Credit Cards

What is a Credit Card: Meaning, Uses and How It Works

2 mins Read

               | 2 Years 7 Months Ago

Apply Now

Know More

A Credit Card is more than just a convenient payment tool; it allows you to manage your cash flow, earn rewards, and enjoy lifestyle privileges. But alongside these benefits, there is also an important responsibility: paying your bills on time. If you do not clear your dues in full, you may have to pay 
Credit Card interest
.

Understanding how credit card interest rates in India work can help you plan your spending better, avoid unnecessary charges, and make the most of your
 ICICI Bank Credit Card
.

What is Credit Card interest?

Every time you use your Credit Card, you are essentially borrowing money from the bank until you repay it. If you clear the entire statement amount by the due date, ICICI Bank does not charge interest on your purchases. However, when you carry forward a balance, whether by paying only the minimum due or missing the due date, an interest charge is applied on the outstanding balance.

This charge is commonly referred to as the finance charge or 
Credit Card interest rate or 
Annual Percentage Rate (APR)
. The applicable rate depends on your specific ICICI Bank Credit Card and is always mentioned in the card’s Fees & Charges document and the Most Important Terms & Conditions (MITC).

When is interest charged on a Credit Card?

Credit Card interest usually comes into play in the following scenarios:

You do not pay the full outstanding balance by the due date.
You pay only the minimum amount due. The remaining balance continues to attract interest.
You withdraw cash using your Credit Card. Unlike purchases, cash advances typically attract interest from the date of withdrawal, along with a cash advance fee.
You convert purchases into EMIs. In such cases, specific interest rates and processing fees apply as per the EMI plan.

As long as you clear your statement in full every billing cycle, you can continue enjoying interest/free credit on your purchases.

ICICI Bank Credit Card interest rates

ICICI Bank levy interest rate of 3.75% per month i.e. 45% per annum for all transactions such as retail purchases, balance transfer, cash advances etc. if Total Amount Due (TAD) has not paid within Payment Due Date (PDD) as mentioned in the statement.

How is Credit Card interest calculated?

Please find below the interest levy process for Credit Card:

Interest free period is cancelled in the event customer does not pay the Total Amount Due (TAD) by the Payment Due Date (PDD)
Interest is charged if the TAD is not paid by the Payment Due Date (PDD).
In the event customer does not make any payment then Interest will be charged on:
TAD and
On all new transactions (from the transaction date) till such time as the previous outstanding amounts are paid in full.

In the event customer makes partial payment then Interest will be charged on:

Amount paid by the Customer (from Transaction Date to the Payment Received Date), and
On the Residual Amount (from Transaction Date to the Payment Received Date, whenever received in full)
On all new transactions (from the transaction date) till such time as the previous outstanding amounts are paid in full

How to reduce or avoid paying Credit Card interest

The good news is that avoiding Credit Card interest is simple. Here are a few effective practices:

Pay the full statement balance by the due date each month.
Avoid cash advances unless absolutely necessary, as they attract immediate charges.
Use your Credit Card wisely by keeping your credit utilisation ratio low.
If you need more time to repay, consider balance transfer options or EMI conversions after reviewing the applicable terms.

Building a consistent repayment record not only saves you from extra charges but also strengthens your credit profile.

Final thoughts

Credit Card interest rates may appear complex at first, but once you understand how they work, you can manage your spending more confidently. With ICICI Bank’s wide range of Credit Cards, the key is to always stay on top of your dues, review your statements carefully, and check the Fees & Charges and MITC documents for card/specific details.

By paying your bills in full and on time, you can enjoy the benefits of your ICICI Bank Credit Card without worrying about interest charges.

FAQs on Credit Card Interest Rates

1. How can I completely avoid paying Credit Card interest?

By paying your total outstanding amount on or before the due date every month. This ensures no interest is charged on your purchases.

2. Does paying only the minimum due help me avoid late fees?

Yes, paying the minimum due on time helps you avoid late payment charges (LPC). However, if you don’t pay the total outstanding amount, interest will be charged not only on the remaining balance but also on new purchases from the date of each transaction until the entire dues are cleared.

3. Why is Credit Card interest shown as both monthly and annualised?

The monthly rate is what you see on your statement. The annualised rate, called APR (Annual Percentage Rate), reflects the total yearly cost if the monthly charges are carried forward.

4. Do cash advances work differently from purchases?

Yes. Cash advances do not come with an interest/free period. Interest begins from the date of withdrawal, and a cash advance fee may also apply.

5. Where can I see the exact interest rate for my card?

You can view the Fees & Charges and the MITC for your card on the ICICI Bank website. These documents contain the exact rate and calculation method applicable to your Credit Card.

6. What is the difference between Annual Percentage Rate(APR) and monthly interest rate?

APR, or Annual Percentage Rate, is the annualised interest rate charged on unpaid Credit Card dues. It reflects the cost of borrowing if you carry forward an outstanding balance.

APR can apply to different types of transactions and related charges, including:

Purchase APR: Interest on retail purchases if the total outstanding is not paid within the due date
Cash Advance APR: Higher interest on cash withdrawals, usually without a grace period
Balance Transfer APR: Interest on transferred outstanding amounts
Penalty APR: Higher rate applicable in case of missed or delayed payments

APR generally covers the interest component on unpaid balances. However, other charges such as late payment fees, cash advance fees, overlimit fees, GST, and processing fees may be levied separately as per the card’s terms and conditions.

Paying your full outstanding amount on or before the due date can help you avoid APR related interest charges.

The monthly interest rate on a Credit Card is the interest charged on your unpaid balance each month when you do not pay the total amount due by the due date.

Credit Cards usually disclose interest as an APR, or Annual Percentage Rate. The monthly interest rate is derived from the APR.

Formula: Monthly Interest Rate = APR ÷ 12

For example, if the APR is 48% per annum, the monthly interest rate would be 4%.

Interest is generally calculated on the outstanding balance and may compound daily, depending on the issuer’s policy. In addition to interest, other charges such as late payment fees, cash advance fees, overlimit charges and applicable taxes may also apply separately as per the card’s terms and conditions.
