What is a Credit Card: Meaning, Uses and How It Works

2 mins Read

               | 2 Years 7 Months Ago

Apply Now

Know More

A Credit Card is more than just a convenient payment tool; it allows you to manage your cash flow, earn rewards, and enjoy lifestyle privileges. But alongside these benefits, there is also an important responsibility: paying your bills on time. If you do not clear your dues in full, you may have to pay 
Credit Card interest
.

Understanding how credit card interest rates in India work can help you plan your spending better, avoid unnecessary charges, and make the most of your
 ICICI Bank Credit Card
.

What is Credit Card interest?

Every time you use your Credit Card, you are essentially borrowing money from the bank until you repay it. If you clear the entire statement amount by the due date, ICICI Bank does not charge interest on your purchases. However, when you carry forward a balance, whether by paying only the minimum due or missing the due date, an interest charge is applied on the outstanding balance.

This charge is commonly referred to as the finance charge or 
Credit Card interest rate or 
Annual Percentage Rate (APR)
. The applicable rate depends on your specific ICICI Bank Credit Card and is always mentioned in the card’s Fees & Charges document and the Most Important Terms & Conditions (MITC).

When is interest charged on a Credit Card?

Credit Card interest usually comes into play in the following scenarios:

You do not pay the full outstanding balance by the due date.
You pay only the minimum amount due. The remaining balance continues to attract interest.
You withdraw cash using your Credit Card. Unlike purchases, cash advances typically attract interest from the date of withdrawal, along with a cash advance fee.
You convert purchases into EMIs. In such cases, specific interest rates and processing fees apply as per the EMI plan.

As long as you clear your statement in full every billing cycle, you can continue enjoying interest/free credit on your purchases.

ICICI Bank Credit Card interest rates

ICICI Bank levy interest rate of 3.75% per month i.e. 45% per annum for all transactions such as retail purchases, balance transfer, cash advances etc. if Total Amount Due (TAD) has not paid within Payment Due Date (PDD) as mentioned in the statement.

How is Credit Card interest calculated?

Please find below the interest levy process for Credit Card:

Interest free period is cancelled in the event customer does not pay the Total Amount Due (TAD) by the Payment Due Date (PDD)
Interest is charged if the TAD is not paid by the Payment Due Date (PDD).
In the event customer does not make any payment then Interest will be charged on:
TAD and
On all new transactions (from the transaction date) till such time as the previous outstanding amounts are paid in full.

In the event customer makes partial payment then Interest will be charged on:

Amount paid by the Customer (from Transaction Date to the Payment Received Date), and
On the Residual Amount (from Transaction Date to the Payment Received Date, whenever received in full)
On all new transactions (from the transaction date) till such time as the previous outstanding amounts are paid in full

Credit Cards usually disclose interest as an APR, or Annual Percentage Rate. The monthly interest rate is derived from the APR.

Formula: Monthly Interest Rate = APR ÷ 12

For example, if the APR is 48% per annum, the monthly interest rate would be 4%.

Interest is generally calculated on the outstanding balance and may compound daily, depending on the issuer’s policy. In addition to interest, other charges such as late payment fees, cash advance fees, overlimit charges and applicable taxes may also apply separately as per the card’s terms and conditions.

MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card FAQs

Are there any foreign transaction fees on the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, foreign transaction fees may apply when you use the Card for international purchases. However, the forex markup is only 0.99% + GST.

Which transactions do not qualify for earning myCash on the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Rent payments, cash advances, late payment costs, joining / annual fees, EMI transactions, Balance Transfers and Personal Loan transactions on the Card are not eligible for myCash Rewards.

How to avail Complimentary International Airport lounge access?

Enjoy 1 complimentary accesses to international airport lounges with MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card. Complimentary benefits are applicable only for the primary cardholder.

Priority Pass Membership

Complimentary Priority Pass Membership for the primary cardholder with MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card

Access 1,400+ lounges in 145+ countries worldwide

Present your Priority Pass Membership Card at the participating international lounges.

For complete list of international airport lounges visit 
https://www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges

How can I redeem myCash earned through the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can redeem your myCash on the MakeMyTrip website, mobile site or app during checkout. Select 'myCash & Gift Cards' on the payments page, choose the ‘myCash’ option, enter the amount to redeem, click 'Use & Apply' and then click 'Complete Payment' to complete the transaction.

Can I encash or transfer myCash earned through the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card to my bank account?

No, myCash earned through the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card cannot be encashed or transferred to a bank account.

How to apply for an MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Click here
 to visit the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card page

Scan the QR code on your mobile phone

Download the MakeMyTrip app and apply for the Card.

Who can claim the lounge access benefit of the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card?

The MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card lounge access benefit is available to the primary Cardholder. With this benefit, you can enjoy complimentary entry to select airport lounges, offering a premium travel experience before your flight.

What are some of the most attractive benefits of the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Some of the most attractive benefits of the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card are unlimited myCash Rewards that never expire, exclusive MakeMyTrip vouchers and complimentary lounge access for the primary Cardholder. You’ll also enjoy the flexibility of two payment networks - MasterCard and RuPay, making this Card a versatile and rewarding choice for frequent travellers.

Is DigiLocker sufficient for applying for the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, DigiLocker can be used to submit your documents when applying for the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card. It provides a secure and digital platform to store and share essential documents, such as proofs of identity, address and income, making the application process faster and more convenient. Simply upload the required documents to DigiLocker and share them during your application.

MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card FAQs

What are the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card benefits for new and renewal cardholders? 

When you pay the joining fee of the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card, you receive a MakeMyTrip voucher worth ₹1,000 that is valid for one year. Upon renewal, you get a ₹1,000 MakeMyTrip hotel voucher that is valid for three months. Finally, you also receive a complimentary one-year MMTBLACK Gold membership with added benefits and discounts. These benefits make your travel bookings even more rewarding.

Why have I received two MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

The MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card is offered as a dual proposition with both Mastercard and RuPay variants. You receive both Cards to provide enhanced network flexibility, ensuring seamless usage across a wider range of merchants and platforms.

How do I complete the KYC verification for my MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Provide your PAN and Aadhaar details and then complete video KYC with an ICICI Bank employee by answering a few questions and showing your original PAN card. The Video KYC process is available 24/7 for your convenience.

Does the myCash earned through MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Cards expire?

The myCash earned through the new MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Cards does not expire once credited to the primary Cardholder's MakeMyTrip wallet. However, myCash earned through the older MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Signature and Platinum Credit Cards expires within 12 months of the credit date

Can I apply for a MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card if I already have an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Yes, you can apply for a MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card even if you already hold another ICICI Bank Credit Card. Your application will be processed based on the bank's internal policies. If approved, you will retain ownership of your existing ICICI Bank Credit Card and also get the new Credit Card.

What benefits does the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card offer?

The MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Signature Credit Card offers several exclusive benefits including the MMTBLACK Platinum membership, savings of up to ₹3,600 annually on movie tickets booked on BookMyShow and the opportunity to earn 40,000 myCash points during travel. You will also receive MakeMyTrip holiday vouchers worth ₹2,500 and 1,500 myCash points on paying the joining fee. The joining fee for this Card is ₹2,500.

What are the features of the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?

The MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card offers a range of travel benefits, including a myCash benefit worth ₹500. Cardholders receive a holiday voucher worth ₹3,000 and complimentary domestic airport and railway lounge access. The nominal joining fee for this Card is ₹500 and you can avail benefits worth up to ₹20,000 (T&Cs apply).

What makes the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card unique?

The MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card stands out with its unlimited myCash rewards that never expire and the ability to earn up to 6% myCash on MakeMyTrip bookings and 1% myCash on other retail purchases. It also provides complimentary lounge access at both domestic and international airports. The Card includes benefits like discounted movie tickets, a minimal joining fee of ₹999, and a one-year MMTBLACK Gold Membership, among other perks.

Manchester United Platinum Credit Card FAQs

What is the ICICI Bank Manchester United Platinum Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Manchester United Platinum Credit Card is a Credit Card created specifically for football enthusiasts.

What are the benefits of the ICICI Bank Manchester United Platinum Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Manchester United Platinum Credit Card offers benefits such as fuel surcharge waivers, complimentary airport lounge access and movie discounts. In addition, top spenders get Manchester United merchandise and a fully-paid Manchester United Experience.

How can I apply online for the ICICI Bank Manchester United Platinum Credit Card?

You can visit the ICICI Bank website and select the Manchester United Platinum Credit Card. After completing the application process, the card will be issued within a few working days if all the eligibility criteria are met.

What is the joining fee for this Credit Card?

The joining fee for the ICICI Bank Manchester United Platinum Credit Card is ₹499 + GST.

What are the travel benefits of the ICICI Bank Manchester United Platinum Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Manchester United Platinum Credit Card offers complimentary airport lounge access four times annually.

What are the annual benefits of the ICICI Bank Manchester United Platinum Credit Card?

You can get a waiver on your annual fee if you have spent more than ₹1,25,000 in the previous year.

What are the exclusive Manchester United benefits that I can get with this card?

Top spenders every month get a signed Manchester United jersey, a fully-paid Manchester United Experience which includes a private tour of the Old Trafford stadium, a visit to the Manchester United megastore and more.

What is the welcome gift for Manchester United Cardholders?

As a welcome gift, Manchester United Credit Cardholders receive a Manchester United-branded football. This exclusive merchandise adds to the excitement for fans of the club.

What does the top monthly spender receive?

The top spender (across all Cardholders) every month receives a signed Manchester United jersey, branded football or t-shirt.

What benefits do the top 18 spenders receive?

The top 18 spenders across Cardholders are rewarded with an exclusive fully-paid Manchester United Experience. This includes a private stadium and museum tour in Manchester, England, an opportunity to watch part of a First Team squad training session and a visit to the Manchester United megastore.

What is included in the private stadium tour?

The private stadium tour includes a guided visit to the historic Manchester United stadium and museum, offering an immersive experience of the club's legacy and achievements.

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

To enjoy domestic lounge access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your Manchester United Platinum Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.

Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria,

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your Manchester United Platinum Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period.

Spends period offer -  eligibility period

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section 

 Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking 

 Choose ICICI Bank Credit Card 25% Discount Offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards 

 Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’ 

 Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page. 

What are the movie ticket benefits available?

Cardholders are eligible for a 25% off on movie ticket offer worth up to ₹100 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets through BookMyShow and INOX. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here
.

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders receive a 1% surcharge waiver on fuel purchases (applicable to transactions up to ₹4,000) when the card is swiped at an HPCL fuel pump using an ICICI Bank Point of Sale (POS) terminal.

Manchester United Signature Credit Card FAQs

Who should use the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card? 

The ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card is an ideal Credit Card for football enthusiasts. You can get a Manchester United-Branded Holdall and Football, a signed Manchester United Jersey and many other discounts on ManU experiences.

Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card? 

Yes, you can easily make online purchases across India and at select overseas stores using the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card.

What are the benefits that I can get with the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card?

With the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card, you get discounts and Rewards on your ManU experiences. You also get complimentary airport lounge access, monthly discounts at BookMyShow, INOX and many more benefits.

What is the age limit for the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card? 

You must be between the age group of 21 to 65 years to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card. 

What are the key variants of ICICI Bank Credit Cards? 

The key variants of ICICI Bank Credit Cards are Platinum, Coral, Rubyx, Sapphiro and Emeralde. You can know more about several other Credit Cards tailored for specific needs like travel, lifestyle, shopping and more, like Amazon Pay Credit Card, MakeMyTrip Credit Card, Adani One Credit Card and Emirates Skywards Credit Card by exploring the ICICI Bank website. 

How can I see my Credit Card number online?  

You can see your ICICI Bank Credit Card number by logging into the ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

How can I redeem my Credit Card points?  

You can experience seamless redemption of your Rewards with ICICI Bank. First, log into ICICI Bank Net Banking or ICICI Bank's iMobile app. In the Rewards section, you can redeem your ICICI Bank Rewards across multiple categories such as electronics, lifestyle, luxury, shopping and travel.  

How can I apply for a Credit Card online?  

You can apply online by visiting the ICICI Bank website and selecting a Credit Card that best suits your needs. Make sure to check the eligibility criteria. Fill out the application form with your details. You can also visit any ICICI Bank branch, where our team will help you with the application process. Remember to keep your documents like Identity Proof, Address Proof and Income Statements ready with you.  

What is the welcome gift for Manchester United Cardholders?

As a welcome gift, Manchester United Credit Cardholders receive a Manchester United-Branded Holdall and Football. This exclusive merchandise adds to the excitement for fans of the club.

What does the top monthly spender receive?

The top spender (across all Cardholders) every month receives a signed Manchester United jersey, branded football or t-shirt.

What benefits do the top 18 spenders receive?

The top 18 spenders across Cardholders are rewarded with an exclusive fully-paid Manchester United Experience. This includes a private stadium and museum tour in Manchester, England, an opportunity to watch part of a First Team squad training session and a visit to the Manchester United megastore.

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your Manchester United Signature Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period.

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow?

What is included in the private stadium tour?

The private stadium tour includes a guided visit to the historic Manchester United stadium and museum, offering an immersive experience of the club's legacy and achievements.

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

Parakram Credit Card FAQs

Who should use the Parakram Credit Card from ICICI Bank?

The Parakram Credit Card from ICICI Bank is best suited for Defence personnel.

What are the benefits of the ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card comes with benefits such as reward points on CSD purchases, airport lounge access, insurance benefits and fuel surcharge waiver.

How many reward points can be earned on everyday purchases with the Parakram Credit Card?

Earn 1 reward point for every ₹100 spent and 5 accelerated reward points for every ₹100 spent at grocery stores, department stores and Canteen Stores Departments (CSD), with a maximum of 1,000 reward points earned per month.

Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card?

Yes. You can easily make online purchases in India as well as at select overseas online stores using the ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card.

What are the lounge benefits that the Parakram Credit Card offers?

The Parakram Credit Card comes with 1 airport lounge access per quarter.

To enjoy domestic lounge access, you must spend ₹ 75,000 or more on your Parakram Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.

Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria, click here. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here.

Which Credit Card is ideal for Defence personnel?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card is an excellent choice for Defence personnel. It offers reward points on almost every purchase.

What are the insurance benefits of the Parakram Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card has personal insurance cover of ₹2 lakh and air accident insurance cover of ₹20 lakh.

They offer exclusive benefits like complimentary Domestic lounge access, Personal and Air Accident Insurance and a fuel surcharge waiver. Reward Points accumulated can be used for groceries, department stores and Canteen Stores Department (CSD) purchases.

Parakram Credit Cards FAQs

Who should use the Parakram Select Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Select Credit Card is best suited for Defence Personnel and Paramilitary Personnel.

Who should use the Parakram Credit Card from ICICI Bank?

The Parakram Credit Card from ICICI Bank is best suited for Defence Personnel.

What rewards can be earned through everyday purchases with the Parakram Select Credit Card?

Earn 2 ICICI Bank Reward Points for every ₹100 spent and 10X Reward Points on grocery stores, department stores and Canteen Stores Department (CSD), with a maximum of 1000 Reward Points per month.

What rewards can be earned through everyday purchases with the Parakram Credit Card?

Earn 2 ICICI Bank Reward Points for every ₹100 spent and 5X Reward Points on grocery stores, department stores and Canteen Stores Department (CSD), with a maximum of 1000 Reward Points per month.

Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card? 

Yes. You can easily make online purchases PAN India as well as select overseas stores using the ICICI Bank Parakram Select Credit Card.

What are the main types of Credit Cards? 

The main Credit Card types are Platinum, Coral, Rubyx, Sapphiro and Emeralde. You can learn more about several other Credit Cards for travel, lifestyle, shopping and more, such as the Amazon Pay Credit Card, MakeMyTrip Credit Card, Adani One Credit Card and Emirates Skywards Credit Card, by exploring the ICICI Bank website. 

What is the lowest Credit Card limit? 

The lowest Credit Card limit varies depending on the card issuer. Call ICICI Bank’s Customer Service at 1800 1080 to get your queries resolved. 

How to check my Credit Card number online? 

To find your ICICI Bank Credit Card number, log in to the iMobile app or Internet Banking and view your details. 

How to redeem Credit Card points for rewards? 

You can experience seamless redemption of Rewards Points with ICICI Bank. First, log in to ICICI Bank Internet Banking or the iMobile app. In the ‘Rewards’ section, you can redeem your ICICI Bank Reward Points across multiple categories such as Electronics, Lifestyle, Luxury, Shopping and Travel. 

How to apply for a Credit Card online? 

You can do it online by visiting ICICI Bank’s website and selecting a card that best suits your needs. Make sure to check the eligibility criteria. Fill out the application form with your details. You can also visit any ICICI Bank branch in person, where a representative will help you throughout the process. Don't forget to keep your documents like ID proof, address proof and income statements handy.

Parakram Select Credit Card FAQs

Who should use the Parakram Select Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Select Credit Card is designed for Indian Defence and Paramilitary personnel.

What are the benefits of the Parakram Select Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Select Credit Card gives benefits like reward points on CSD purchases, complimentary golf access & airport lounge access, insurance benefits and fuel surcharge waiver, specially for Defence personnel.

How to avail Complimentary International Airport lounge access?

Enjoy 2 complimentary accesses to international airport lounges with ICICI Bank Emeralde Metal Credit Card. Complimentary benefits are applicable only for the primary cardholder.

Priority Pass Membership

Complimentary Priority Pass Membership for the primary cardholder with ICICI Bank Parakram Select Credit Card

Access 1,400+ lounges in 145+ countries worldwide

Present your Priority Pass Membership Card at the participating international lounges.

For complete list of international airport lounges visit 
https://www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges

What rewards can be earned on everyday purchases with the Parakram Select Credit Card?

Earn 2 ICICI Bank Reward Points for every ₹100 spent using the Card on certain categories of spends. Also earn 10 ICICI Bank Reward Points per ₹100 spent at grocery stores, department stores and CSDs, with maximum 1,000 reward points earned per month.

Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank Parakram Select Credit Card?

Yes. You can easily make online purchases across India and in select overseas stores using the ICICI Bank Parakram Select Credit Card.

What are the lounge benefits that the Parakram Select Credit Card offers?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Select Credit Card gives 2 complimentary lounge accesses at international airports every year and 2 lounge accesses at domestic airports every quarter. 

What are the golf round benefits?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Select Credit Card offers a complimentary golf round every month on spends of

₹50,000 the previous month.

What are the insurance benefits of the Parakram Select Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Select Credit Card gives personal accident insurance cover of ₹2 lakh and Air Accident cover of ₹20 lakh to the Cardholder.

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

To enjoy domestic lounge access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your Parakram Select Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.

Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria, 
click here
. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here
.

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please 
click here

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

What are the golf privileges and eligibility criteria?

As a Parakram Select Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for a round or lesson of golf for every ₹50,000 spent on retail purchases in the previous calendar month. You can avail of a maximum of 1 rounds per month. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit 
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered against your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months.

To view the updated list of golf courses, please 
click here
. For complete details on the Golf programme and the associated terms and conditions, please 
click here
. You may also call iAssist, the 24x7 concierge service on 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL/ BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking.

How do I make the booking for Golf Rounds?

Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps:

Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform 
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 with your registered mobile number.

Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.

Submit your booking request and await confirmation.

Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details.

You may also call i-Assist, our 24X7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable), for assistance with online booking. An authorisation amount of ₹2 shall be taken for each eligible Card.

Parakram Credit Card FAQs

Who should use the Parakram Credit Card from ICICI Bank?

The Parakram Credit Card from ICICI Bank is best suited for Defence personnel.

What are the benefits of the ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card comes with benefits such as reward points on CSD purchases, airport lounge access, insurance benefits and fuel surcharge waiver.

How many reward points can be earned on everyday purchases with the Parakram Credit Card?

Earn 1 reward point for every ₹100 spent and 5 accelerated reward points for every ₹100 spent at grocery stores, department stores and Canteen Stores Departments (CSD), with a maximum of 1,000 reward points earned per month.

Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card?

Yes. You can easily make online purchases in India as well as at select overseas online stores using the ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card.

What are the lounge benefits that the Parakram Credit Card offers?

The Parakram Credit Card comes with 1 airport lounge access per quarter.

To enjoy domestic lounge access, you must spend ₹ 75,000 or more on your Parakram Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.

Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria, click here. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here.

Which Credit Card is ideal for Defence personnel?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card is an excellent choice for Defence personnel. It offers reward points on almost every purchase.

What are the insurance benefits of the Parakram Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank Parakram Credit Card has personal insurance cover of ₹2 lakh and air accident insurance cover of ₹20 lakh.

Personal Loan on Credit Card FAQs

What is loan on a Credit Card?

A Loan on a Credit Card, often known as a Credit Card Loan, permits cardholders to access a portion of their card's credit limit as a loan, which can be repaid in instalments, making it a convenient financial solution.

What are the interest rates and tenures for Credit Card Loans?

Credit Card Loan interest rates and tenures can vary but they generally have shorter tenures and somewhat higher interest rates compared to traditional 
Personal Loans
.

Can I get a loan on my credit card?

Yes, you can get a personal loan on your 
credit card
, subject to certain terms and conditions.

Is it good to take out a credit card loan?

A credit card loan can be helpful for short-term financial needs, but managing repayments responsibly is essential.

What are the risks of a credit card loan?

A credit card loan's risks include high-interest rates, potential debt accumulation, and adverse impacts on credit score if not repaid promptly.

What are the different types of loans on Credit Card?

There are two types of loans on credit cards:

1. Personal Loan on Credit Card Within the Limit (PLCC WTL): In this variant, the loan amount offered will be within your Credit Card limit and you may avail up to 90% of the unused credit limit. The loan amount will be blocked from your available Credit Card limit.

2. Personal Loan on Credit Card Over the Limit (PLCC OTL): In this type of loan, the loan amount offered can be above or below your Credit Card limit. The loan amount will not be blocked from your available Credit Card limit.

Note:

The type of loan offered on Credit Card is as per the Bank’s policy and discretion.

EMIs and applicable taxes will be billed monthly for both types of Loans on Credit Card.

A one-time processing fee and applicable taxes will be billed along with the first month’s EMI.

Which is better: a credit card loan or personal loan?

When comparing a credit-card loan and a personal loan, the better option depends on your needs. A credit card loan is ideal for short-term, quick access to funds, often with pre-approved limits. However, personal loans usually offer lower interest rates and higher amounts. Choose wisely based on repayment capacity, urgency and total cost of borrowing.

What are the other loan types that ICICI Bank offers, besides loan on credit card?

Besides Loan on Credit Card, ICICI Bank offers a wide range of financial solutions to meet diverse needs. These include car loan options for new or used vehicles, personal loan for urgent financial needs, Two - Wheeler Loan for purchasing bikes or scooters, and Education Loan to support academic pursuits in India or abroad.

What is the interest rate and tenure for this loan?

The interest rate and tenure for a loan on a credit card vary based on your spending habits, repayment history, and overall credit profile. Banks assess these factors to offer personalized rates and flexible.

What is loan on a Credit Card?

What are the interest rates and tenures for Credit Card Loans?

Personal Loans
.

Can I get a loan on my credit card?

Yes, you can get a personal loan on your 
credit card
, subject to certain terms and conditions.

Is it good to take out a credit card loan?

A credit card loan can be helpful for short-term financial needs, but managing repayments responsibly is essential.

What are the risks of a credit card loan?

A credit card loan's risks include high-interest rates, potential debt accumulation, and adverse impacts on credit score if not repaid promptly.

What are the different types of loans on Credit Card?

There are two types of loans on credit cards:

1. Personal Loan on Credit Card Within the Limit (PLCC WTL): In this variant, the loan amount offered will be within your Credit Card limit and you may avail up to 90% of the unused credit limit. The loan amount will be blocked from your available Credit Card limit.

2. Personal Loan on Credit Card Over the Limit (PLCC OTL): In this type of loan, the loan amount offered can be above or below your Credit Card limit. The loan amount will not be blocked from your available Credit Card limit.

Note:

The type of loan offered on Credit Card is as per the Bank’s policy and discretion.

EMIs and applicable taxes will be billed monthly for both types of Loans on Credit Card.

A one-time processing fee and applicable taxes will be billed along with the first month’s EMI.

Adani One ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card FAQs

How can I apply for an Adani One ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?

To apply, visit ICICI Bank’s website, complete the application process by entering your details and following the prompts or visit any branch.

What is the minimum spending requirement for the Adani One ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card to enjoy benefits?

To enjoy annual fee waiver and other benefits, you need to meet a minimum spending requirement of ₹3 lakh in a calendar year.

What are the types of rewards that I can earn with the Adani One ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?

Earn Adani Reward Points on various spends including domestic, international and utility expenses, allowing you to maximise your rewards.

Is there a joining fee for the Adani One ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?

Yes, joining fee of ₹750 plus GST.

How do I activate my Adani One ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?

Activate your card by following the instructions provided in the welcome kit, by logging into the ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

How to apply for a Credit Card online?

Visit ICICI Bank’s website, go to Credit Cards and select your preferred Card. After submitting the application, complete the KYC verification and get your card.

Adani One ICICI Bank Credit Card benefits include discounts on fuel purchases, access to airport lounges and exclusive offers on movie tickets, enhancing your overall experience.

Can I apply for an Adani One ICICI Bank Credit Card online?

Who is eligible for Flight Voucher?

A customer who has paid their joining or annual fee and completed spends of  ₹10,000 (not including joining/annual fee, interest or bank levies) within 60 days of card activation. Customers who have availed card without joining or annual fee shall be ineligible for flight voucher.

Platinum Chip Credit Card FAQs

Is there a joining fee or annual fee for Platinum Chip Credit Card?

The Platinum Chip Credit Card has no joining fee or annual fee.

What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it on my ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card?

Flip your Platinum Chip Credit Card. The three-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging in to your iMobile app or Net Banking.

Which bank’s Credit Card should I opt for?

The ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card is an excellent choice. It has no joining fee or annual fee.

What is the age limit to apply for a Platinum Chip Credit Card?

You must be between the ages of 21-65 years to be eligible to apply for an ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card.

How to know the payment due date of the Platinum Chip Credit Card?

You can know the payment due date of your Platinum Chip Credit Card through the monthly statement, iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling our Customer Care on 1800 1080.

Which Bank issues a Credit Card at no cost?

ICICI Bank issues the Platinum Chip Credit Card without any joining fee and annual fee. For more information, call on 1800 1080.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The 
Credit Card
 comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please 
click here
 .

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of ₹400 to ₹4,000 at HPCL fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

How do the chip and PIN improve security?

The chip and PIN provide robust protection against Card misuse by requiring a PIN for in-person transactions. This prevents unauthorized access even if the card is lost or stolen, significantly reducing the risk of fraudulent use.

When is the PIN required for transactions?

The PIN is required for transactions made on POS terminals (swipe machines) at merchant outlets in physical locations. Customers must enter their PIN on the terminal to complete the transaction securely.

Is PIN required for online transactions?

No, the PIN is not required for online transactions. Online payments can be completed without entering the PIN, but other security measures may still apply, such as OTP verification.

Does the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card provide any offers on MakeMyTrip?

Is the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card free?

No. The Credit Card has a one-time joining fee of ₹500+ GST.

What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it for my MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?

Flip your Credit Card. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your CVV. You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app.

How can I know the due date of my MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?

You can check the due date of your Credit Card through your monthly statements, ICICI Bank's iMobile app, iMobile, Net Banking or by calling 1800 1080.

If you hold the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card, you will earn MakeMyTrip myCash on certain transactions. These rewards can be redeemed through the MakeMyTrip platform against bookings made on the MakeMyTrip platform

What are the criteria for availing domestic airport lounge access?

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplemental) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card FAQs

Does the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card provide any offers on MakeMyTrip?

Yes. It does. The Credit Card offers a MakeMyTrip holiday voucher of up to ₹3,000.

Is the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card free?

No. The Credit Card has a one-time joining fee of ₹500+ GST.

What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it for my MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?

Flip your Credit Card. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your CVV. You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app.

How can I know the due date of my MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card?

You can check the due date of your Credit Card through your monthly statements, ICICI Bank's iMobile app, iMobile, Net Banking or by calling 1800 1080.

What is myCash?

If you hold the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card, you will earn MakeMyTrip myCash on certain transactions. These rewards can be redeemed through the MakeMyTrip platform against bookings made on the MakeMyTrip platform

What are the criteria for availing domestic airport lounge access?

To enjoy domestic airport lounge access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your MakeMyTrip Platinum Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. 

Please note that the 
airport lounge access credit card
 benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria, 
click here
. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here (PDF, 452 KB)
.

What are the criteria for availing railway lounge access?

Enjoy 1 complimentary railway lounge access in a quarter to participating lounges in India

Please note that the railway lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. To view the complete list of lounges,  
Click here (PDF, 95.3 KB)

What are the movie ticket benefits available?

Cardholders are eligible for a 25% off on movie ticket offer worth up to ₹100 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider.

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of ₹400 to ₹4,000 at HPCL fuel outlet when the Card is swiped on ICICI Merchant Services swipe machines in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplemental) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The 
Credit Card
 comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please 
click here

What are the criteria for availing domestic railway lounge access?

Upgrade your travel experience with complimentary access to railway with your MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card. Get 1 complimentary access to select railway lounges in India every quarter. Simply present MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card to enjoy the privileges

Over and above the permitted number of complimentary access, each subsequent access will be charged as per rates laid out by each lounge service provider.

The access to railway lounges will be applicable only for primary cardholders.

Click here (PDF, 95.3KB)
 for a complete list of lounges.

Where can I find the list of lounges available for MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card Holders?

You can check participating lounge websites to clarify if the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card is accepted.

Where can I find the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card lounge access list?

You can find the 
MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card lounge access list
 on the official MakeMyTrip website page dedicated to the card. The complete list of eligible lounges is also available in the downloadable document in the tabs ‘Domestic lounges’ and ‘International lounges’ provided on the page.

What are the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card charges?

The charges for the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card are detailed in the Fees and Charges section. Applicable charges may vary based on card usage and the specific 
terms and conditions.

ICICI Bank Plus Card FAQs

What is the ICICI Bank Plus Card?

The ICICI Bank Plus Card is an add-on Credit Card linked to a primary 
ICICI Bank Credit Card
, designed to provide flexibility and benefits to family members of the primary cardholder.

Who is the ICICI Bank Plus Card suitable for?

This card is ideal for families who want to share a single credit line while giving individual members the convenience and freedom of using their own card.

Are transactions on the Plus Card secure?

Yes, the card uses advanced encryption technology to ensure secure transactions. Additionally, Plus Cardholders can authenticate transactions with OTPs and transaction alerts are sent to their registered mobile numbers. Cardholders also receive transaction details in the consolidated monthly statements, offering complete peace of mind.

How are reward points managed for the ICICI Bank Plus Card?

All reward points earned through transactions on the Plus Card are consolidated into the primary cardholder's reward points account.

What can I redeem my reward points for?

You can redeem your reward points across a variety of categories, including vouchers, travel, electronics and lifestyle products, through the ICICI Bank rewards portal.

How many Plus Cards can I apply for under one Credit Card?

You can apply for up to 3 Plus Cards under a single primary Credit Card. This allows you to share your credit line with up to three family members while keeping expenses consolidated in one statement.

How do I apply for the ICICI Bank Plus Card?

You can apply online through the ICICI Bank website or visit any ICICI Bank branch. Ensure that you have the required documents like proof of identity, proof of income and proof of address for a smooth application process.

How does the ICICI Bank Credit Card shared limit work for multiple cards?

The ICICI Bank Credit Card shared limit applies when a primary cardholder adds a Plus (Add-on) Card. The add-on card shares the primary card’s approved credit limit. Both cards can be used separately, but all transactions are adjusted against the same combined limit.

Pre-Approved Credit Card FAQs

What is a Pre-Approved ICICI Bank Credit Card?

A Pre-Approved ICICI Bank Credit Card is an offer provided by ICICI Bank to eligible customers based on their creditworthiness and banking history. It does not require additional documentation or credit checks, making the approval process faster and easier.

Does a Pre-Approved Credit Card offer affect credit score?

A Pre-Approved Credit Card offer does not affect your credit score unless you choose to accept the offer and activate the card. 

How can I redeem a Pre-Approved Credit Card offer on the ICICI Bank's iMobile app?

To redeem your Pre-Approved Credit Card offer, log in to the ICICI Bank's iMobile app, navigate to the Credit Card section and check for available offers. You can then click on the offer, fill in any required details and submit your request for activating the offer.

Benefits of a Pre-Approved ICICI Bank Credit Card?

A Pre-Approved ICICI Bank Credit Card offers a range of lifestyle, travel and security benefits, from attractive discounts on shopping, dining and movies, to complimentary airport lounge access and fuel surcharge waivers. The card also allows you to earn ICICI Bank Reward Points and access 24/7 concierge services. Additionally, the card’s advanced chip technology ensures enhanced security, protecting you against fraud and unauthorised transactions.

Priority Pass Terms and Conditions

Priority Pass ICICI Bank Terms & Conditions.

The International Lounge Access Programme is an airport lounge access programme that allows access to affiliated airport lounges globally with a valid Membership Card.
Membership to the International Lounge Access Programme is provided on select ICICI Bank Credit Cards on a complimentary basis as specified.
Present your Membership Card at the participating lounge to avail complimentary international lounge access benefit.
Except ICICI Bank Diamant, Times Black, Emeralde Private Metal, Emeralde, and Emirates Emeralde Credit Cards all other applicable ICICI Bank Credit Cards shall be liable to pay for each lounge visit over and above the complimentary visits subject to per person, per visit charge.
Additional visits, including those by accompanying guests, shall be debited to the member’s Credit Card by ICICI Bank within 60 days from the month of usage and will be reflected in the subsequent month.
Member’s additional lounge visit charges will be debited after converting the charges in Indian Rupees. The foreign exchange rate applicable will be the rate prevailing on the date of debit plus applicable GST.
Guest visits are complimentary for ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card members.
ICICI Bank will be able to provide a proof of the lounge visit only if received from the partner.
Usage of each individual lounge shall be governed by its own Terms & Conditions.
The Bank is not responsible for the quality of service provided within any of the lounges.
The lounge access shall be available to the Card members on the condition that the said ICICI Bank Credit Card continues to remain valid and in good standing.
The Membership Card will be blocked if the ICICI Bank Credit Card is blocked on account of any fraud/default.
Presentation of a blocked Membership Card at the lounge shall not be entertained.
The Membership Card is not a payment Card nor a proof of creditworthiness and attempts to use it as such could constitute fraud.
Lost, stolen or damaged Membership Cards are to be notified immediately to ICICI Bank.
The Card member should intimate ICICI Bank immediately upon loss of the Membership Card, to facilitate blocking of the same and ICICI Bank is not liable for any charges on the Membership Card between the time of loss of the Membership Card and reporting of the same to ICICI Bank.
The officials are not bound to announce flights and ICICI Bank shall not be held liable for any Card member / accompanying guests missing flights while in the lounge.
ICICI Bank shall not be held liable for any loss of possessions by the Card member while within the lounge.
The Membership Card is not transferable and is valid up to the date of expiry mentioned on the Card or until such time as the said ICICI Bank Credit Card is valid. Any lounge visits made by the Card member, including any guests, using an invalid Card, shall be charged to the Card member.
The Card member must abide by the rules & regulations of each participating lounge.
Access to the lounge may be restricted on account of space constraints and will be at the discretion of the lounge operator.
The participating lounges may choose to enforce a maximum stay period, beyond which the Card member may be charged. Participating lounges may reserve the right to enforce a maximum stay policy (usually 3-4 hours) to prevent overcrowding. This is at the discretion of the individual lounge operator who may impose a charge for extended stays.
The provision of free alcoholic drinks (where local law permits) is at the discretion of each lounge operator and in some cases may be limited. In such cases the Card member is responsible for paying any charges for additional consumption directly to the lounge staff.
Telephone facilities (where available) vary from lounge to lounge and are provided at the lounge operator's discretion. Free usage is normally limited to local calls only. Fax, shower, internet, and WiFi charges (where applicable) are at the discretion of each lounge operator and the card member is responsible for paying these directly to the lounge staff.
Entry to lounges is strictly subject to Card members and any guests being in possession of a valid flight ticket for the same day of travel. Airline, airport and other travel industry employees travelling on reduced-rate tickets may not be eligible for lounge access. Outside the US, flight tickets must be accompanied by a valid boarding pass for a departing flight, i.e., outbound passengers only. Please note some lounges in Europe are located within designated Schengen areas of the airport which means that access is only provided to these lounges if members are travelling between Schengen countries. (Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland).
Entry to lounges is subject to Card members and any guests (including children) behaving and dressing in an orderly and correct manner. Any infants or children causing discomfort to other members may be asked to vacate the lounge facilities. The partner is not liable for any loss suffered by the Card member and any guests, where a lounge operator has refused admission because the Card member and/or guests have not complied with these conditions.
All participating lounges are owned and operated by third party organisations. The Card member and accompanying guests must abide by the rules and policies of each participating lounge/club. Access may be restricted due to space constraints, but this will be wholly at the discretion of each individual lounge operator. The partner has no control over the facilities offered, the opening / closing times or the personnel employed by the lounges. The administrators will use every endeavour to ensure the benefits and facilities are available as advertised but do not warrant nor guarantee in any way that said benefits and facilities will be available at the time of the Card member’s visit.

The partner will not be liable for any loss to the Card member or any accompanying guests, arising from the provision or non-provision (whether in whole or in part) of any of the advertised benefits and facilities. All children accompanying the Card member (where permitted) will be subject to the full guest fee unless otherwise stated in the lounge listing.

ICICI Bank shall remain indemnified from any liabilities / damages / costs associated with the injury / death of any member or damage / destruction of any property arising out of use of any lounge.
ICICI Bank is not responsible for the goods / services obtained / availed at the airport lounges.
Any dispute or claim regarding the goods and services or offers must be resolved by the Card members with the partner directly without any reference to ICICI Bank.
In addition to these rules and regulations, the Card member shall be bound by the Terms & Conditions prescribed by the respective lounge operators and partners.

Priority Pass Terms and Conditions

Priority Pass ICICI Bank Terms & Conditions.

The International Lounge Access Programme is an airport lounge access programme that allows access to affiliated airport lounges globally with a valid Membership Card.
Membership to the International Lounge Access Programme is provided on select ICICI Bank Credit Cards on a complimentary basis as specified.
Present your Membership Card at the participating lounge to avail complimentary international lounge access benefit.
Except ICICI Bank Diamant, Times Black, Emeralde Private Metal, Emeralde, and Emirates Emeralde Credit Cards all other applicable ICICI Bank Credit Cards shall be liable to pay for each lounge visit over and above the complimentary visits subject to per person, per visit charge.
Additional visits, including those by accompanying guests, shall be debited to the member’s Credit Card by ICICI Bank within 60 days from the month of usage and will be reflected in the subsequent month.
Member’s additional lounge visit charges will be debited after converting the charges in Indian Rupees. The foreign exchange rate applicable will be the rate prevailing on the date of debit plus applicable GST.
Guest visits are complimentary for ICICI Bank Diamant Credit Card members.
ICICI Bank will be able to provide a proof of the lounge visit only if received from the partner.
Usage of each individual lounge shall be governed by its own Terms & Conditions.
The Bank is not responsible for the quality of service provided within any of the lounges.
The lounge access shall be available to the Card members on the condition that the said ICICI Bank Credit Card continues to remain valid and in good standing.
The Membership Card will be blocked if the ICICI Bank Credit Card is blocked on account of any fraud/default.
Presentation of a blocked Membership Card at the lounge shall not be entertained.
The Membership Card is not a payment Card nor a proof of creditworthiness and attempts to use it as such could constitute fraud.
Lost, stolen or damaged Membership Cards are to be notified immediately to ICICI Bank.
The Card member should intimate ICICI Bank immediately upon loss of the Membership Card, to facilitate blocking of the same and ICICI Bank is not liable for any charges on the Membership Card between the time of loss of the Membership Card and reporting of the same to ICICI Bank.
The officials are not bound to announce flights and ICICI Bank shall not be held liable for any Card member / accompanying guests missing flights while in the lounge.
ICICI Bank shall not be held liable for any loss of possessions by the Card member while within the lounge.
The Membership Card is not transferable and is valid up to the date of expiry mentioned on the Card or until such time as the said ICICI Bank Credit Card is valid. Any lounge visits made by the Card member, including any guests, using an invalid Card, shall be charged to the Card member.
The Card member must abide by the rules & regulations of each participating lounge.
Access to the lounge may be restricted on account of space constraints and will be at the discretion of the lounge operator.
The participating lounges may choose to enforce a maximum stay period, beyond which the Card member may be charged. Participating lounges may reserve the right to enforce a maximum stay policy (usually 3-4 hours) to prevent overcrowding. This is at the discretion of the individual lounge operator who may impose a charge for extended stays.
The provision of free alcoholic drinks (where local law permits) is at the discretion of each lounge operator and in some cases may be limited. In such cases the Card member is responsible for paying any charges for additional consumption directly to the lounge staff.
Telephone facilities (where available) vary from lounge to lounge and are provided at the lounge operator's discretion. Free usage is normally limited to local calls only. Fax, shower, internet, and WiFi charges (where applicable) are at the discretion of each lounge operator and the card member is responsible for paying these directly to the lounge staff.
Entry to lounges is strictly subject to Card members and any guests being in possession of a valid flight ticket for the same day of travel. Airline, airport and other travel industry employees travelling on reduced-rate tickets may not be eligible for lounge access. Outside the US, flight tickets must be accompanied by a valid boarding pass for a departing flight, i.e., outbound passengers only. Please note some lounges in Europe are located within designated Schengen areas of the airport which means that access is only provided to these lounges if members are travelling between Schengen countries. (Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland).
Entry to lounges is subject to Card members and any guests (including children) behaving and dressing in an orderly and correct manner. Any infants or children causing discomfort to other members may be asked to vacate the lounge facilities. The partner is not liable for any loss suffered by the Card member and any guests, where a lounge operator has refused admission because the Card member and/or guests have not complied with these conditions.
All participating lounges are owned and operated by third party organisations. The Card member and accompanying guests must abide by the rules and policies of each participating lounge/club. Access may be restricted due to space constraints, but this will be wholly at the discretion of each individual lounge operator. The partner has no control over the facilities offered, the opening / closing times or the personnel employed by the lounges. The administrators will use every endeavour to ensure the benefits and facilities are available as advertised but do not warrant nor guarantee in any way that said benefits and facilities will be available at the time of the Card member’s visit.

The partner will not be liable for any loss to the Card member or any accompanying guests, arising from the provision or non-provision (whether in whole or in part) of any of the advertised benefits and facilities. All children accompanying the Card member (where permitted) will be subject to the full guest fee unless otherwise stated in the lounge listing.

ICICI Bank shall remain indemnified from any liabilities / damages / costs associated with the injury / death of any member or damage / destruction of any property arising out of use of any lounge.
ICICI Bank is not responsible for the goods / services obtained / availed at the airport lounges.
Any dispute or claim regarding the goods and services or offers must be resolved by the Card members with the partner directly without any reference to ICICI Bank.
In addition to these rules and regulations, the Card member shall be bound by the Terms & Conditions prescribed by the respective lounge operators and partners.

Rewards Programme FAQs

What is the new ICICI Bank Rewards program?

ICICI Bank Credit and Debit Cards is launching a new exciting, state of the art ”ICICI Rewards Program’ on 1st April 2022 with a bundle of new offers. The points earned on ICICI Bank Credit Card or Debit Cards from 1 April 2022 will be accrued as a part of the new ICICI Rewards Programme. You will be able to redeem your ICICI Bank Reward Points through ICICI Bank channels from 15 August 2022.

Where can I see points accrued on my cards under the ICICI Bank Rewards Program?

Reward points will be seamlessly accrued into your ICICI Bank Rewards account from 1st April 2022. You will be able to view your ICICI Bank Reward Points on your ICICI Bank Credit and Debit Cards through ICICI Bank channels from 31 August 2022.

All your points accrued under the new ICICI Rewards Program will be available for redemption from 15 August 2022. via ICICI Bank channels.

How can I redeem new ICICI Bank Reward Points which are earned from 1 April 2022?

Redemption of your ICICI Bank Rewards will be enabled from 15 August 2022 through the ICICI Bank channels.

You will receive ongoing communication on this in the next few months

I cannot see any pointsaccrued on my ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking even though I have spent on my ICICI Bank Card. Where are my points?

Reward points earned from 1st April 2022 are transferred to your ICICI Rewards account. You will be able to view your ICICI Reward Points earned on your ICICI Bank Credit and Debit Cards from 31st May 2022 on ICICI Bank channels.

When can I see my reward points earned for using my ICICI Bank Card on iMobile?

Your ICICI Rewards points earned on your ICICI Bank Credit Card will be credited to the ICICI Rewards account on the next date of your upcoming statement date. The new balance can be viewed on ICICI Bank's iMobile app. For example, if your statement date is on 25th of every month, all reward points earned post the last statement date will be visible on 26th of the current month.

Your ICICI Rewards points earned on your ICICI Bank Debit Card will be credited to the ICICI Rewards account on or before the last day of the next month. For example, points earned in the month of April 2022, will be credited to the Rewards account by 31 May 2022.

Please note, the reward points will reflect as zero from 1st April to above mentioned dates for credit card and debit card respectively.

What will be the validity of my new ICICI Bank rewards point?

Validity of ICICI Reward points will be 36 months or  3years from the date of point issuance.

What are ICICI Bank Payback (is now Zillion) Rewards points?

The points earned on your ICICI Bank Credit Card or Debit Card under the PAYBACK program are called ICICI Payback (is now Zillion) points.

Until when will I earn ICICI Payback (is now Zillion) Rewards points?

You will earn Payback (is now Zillion) Reward Points for spends on your ICICI Bank Credit and Debit Card till 31st March 2022. From 1st April 2022, points on spends on your ICICI Bank Credit and Debit Card will accrue under the new ICICI Rewards program.

What happens to my Payback (is now Zillion) points post 31 March 2022? How and until when can I redeem/access my Payback (is now Zillion) Points?

You will be able to seamlessly redeem/access your  Payback (is now Zillion) reward points that have been accrued until 31st March 2022 like earlier through all PAYBACK channels until the expiry of your PAYBACK Reward Points (After normal expiry of the points, these points will not be renewed): o To redeem through PAYBCAK website, please visit: 
https://www.payback.in/

Customer call centre: 1860 258 5000 (Local call charges apply), which is operational every day from 10:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.

 You can redeem via Payback (is now Zillion) application

 Payback (is now Zillion) points can also be redeemed through PAYBACK partners

Payback (is now Zillion) points earned has an expiry of 36 months/3years.

Will I be able to redeem my Payback (is now Zillion) reward points through ICICI Bank channels – customer call centre/i-Mobile/internet banking etc.

Post 31st March, you will be able to redeem or access your points through only Payback (is now Zillion) website or call centre or app or Payback (is now Zillion) partners.

ICICI Bank channels like customer call centre or ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking will not be accessible for redemption of Payback (is now Zillion) points post 31st March 2022.

What will be the validity of my Payback (is now Zillion) points?

The validity of your Payback (is now Zillion) Points earned till 31 March 2022 remains unchanged. Points will be valid for 36 months/ 3years from the date of issuance of the points.

What happens to my reward points earned but not transferred to Payback (is now Zillion)?

All the points earned till 31 March 2022 will be transferred to Payback (is now Zillion) as usual. You will be able to redeem the same through Payback (is now Zillion) as detailed in Question 10.

How do I resolve any disputes related to my Payback (is now Zillion) points?

To resolve any dispute related to Payback (is now Zillion) points please connect with Payback (is now Zillion) customer call centre: 1860 258 5000 (Local call charges apply), which is operational every day from 10:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.

ICICI Bank Credit Card Rewards FAQs

What is the ICICI Bank Credit Card Rewards Programme?

The ICICI Bank 
Rewards Programme
 is the new platform launched by ICICI Bank in August 2022. Under this new programme, you can earn ICICI Bank Reward Points on Credit Card purchases and redeem points against a variety of products on the new ICICI Bank Rewards platform. This programme gives you an easier way to earn, track and redeem your Reward Points.

Do ICICI Bank Reward Points expire?

Yes, you need to use Reward Points earned on ICICI Bank Credit Card purchases within 36 months since they have a lifespan of 3 years from the date of issuance.

What is covered under 'View Rewards'?

In this section, the reward options are separated into different categories for your easy reference. Just select the type of category you wish to redeem from and you will be able to browse through all the relevant offers in that category.

How can I earn Reward Points on my ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can easily earn Reward Points on your ICICI Bank Credit Card. All you have to do is use your eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card for your everyday purchases and watch your Reward Points add up.

To understand the exact mechanism of earning Reward Points on your card, please refer to your Card page at 
Click here
 or call our 24-hour Customer Care at 1800 1080. 

You can also increase your points balance by giving Plus Credit Cards to your loved ones. All transactions made on the Plus Cards add to your rewards tally. You can gift a Plus Card to 3 family members above 18 years of age by paying a minimal fee of ₹199+Goods and Services Tax (GST).

How can I view my Credit Card reward points summary?

Through Net Banking:

Step 1: Login into Net Banking

Step 2: Go to Cards & Loans

Step 3: Click on ICICI Bank Rewards

Points will be visible against the card number

Through ICICI Bank's iMobile app:

Step 1: Login into ICICI Bank's iMobile app

Step 2: Go to Cards & Forex

Step 3: Select your card

Points will be visible above the Redeem Now option.

What are the Terms and Conditions for redeeming products?

Click here
 to view the Programme Terms and Conditions.

How long does it take to process my redemption request?

The e-voucher or gift cards are delivered within a TAT of 30 minutes on your registered email address. The physical products are delivered to the shared communication address within a TAT of 15-20 working days.

Can I request for my gift to be delivered to another address?

Yes, you can enter the communication address manually while placing the redemption order through ICICI Bank Rewards Portal.

What happens if ICICI Bank is unable to deliver the gift?

The product is returned to the origin and points are reversed within 7 working days.

What are the benefits of registering for ICICI Bank Net Banking for rewards programme?

This site helps you to:

Check your points balance

Browse through all the reward redemption options

Redeem rewards instantly

You can use your existing Net Banking Username and Password to log in. 
Login now!

How do I resolve a query regarding the rewards programme?

The site has a detailed FAQs section to address your queries. If there are any specific queries that you have, please write to us through the '
Email Us
' option at www.icicibank.com or call our 
24-hour Customer Care
. We will be happy to attend to your queries.

How do I return unwanted items?

Please note that rewards are not exchangeable, replaceable, transferable or refundable for cash or credit.

Are all my ICICI Bank Credit Cards eligible for redeeming points via Net Banking?

All the cards under ICICI Bank Rewards program are eligible for redeeming points via Net Banking or ICICI Bank's iMobile app.

How do I find out the status of the gifts I have ordered?

We request you to call our Customer Care on 1800 1080 between 7:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m. from your registered mobile number.

To know the Customer Care numbers, we request you to 
click here
 .

Alternatively, you may write to us through the 
'Email Us'
 link at www.icicibank.com at any time to find out the status of your shipment.

Can I change the item I have ordered if the number of reward points being redeemed are the same?

Sorry. You cannot change the item you have selected after the order has been placed.

Does the Points Summary display the points that I have across all my credit cards with the Bank?

The Points Summary displays the points available for redemption in your consolidated rewards account. The card numbers for which the points are displayed are indicated next to the points.

How do I redeem my ICICI Bank Rewards?
