Rubyx Credit Card FAQs

Is the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card free?

No, the card has a joining fee of ₹3,000 and an annual fee of ₹2,000.

When will I get my Joining Benefits for the Rubyx Credit Card?

You will receive an e-mail regarding the same within 45 business days after the payment of the Joining Fee.

What is included in the joining benefit vouchers?

Upon payment of the joining fee, Credit Cardholders will receive welcome vouchers worth over ₹5,000 on their registered e-mail ID within 45 days. There are vouchers worth ₹2,000 from Tata CLiQ, ₹2,000 from EaseMyTrip (2 vouchers of ₹1,000 each for domestic flight bookings), ₹1,000 from Croma (2 vouchers of ₹500 each), ₹3,000 from EaseMyTrip for holiday packages.

To know more about redemption of vouchers, 
click here

For other Terms and Conditions,  
click here

How can Cardholders claim their joining vouchers?

Step 1: Log in to ICICI Bank Rewards

•   iMobile App:

Open iMobile 🡪 Cards & Forex 🡪  Select Credit Card 🡪 Redeem 🡪 Joining Benefit

•   Internet Banking:

Log in 🡪 Cards 🡪 Credit cards 🡪 Select Credit Card 🡪 Redeem 🡪 Joining Benefit

Step 2: On the Rewards site, click the Rubyx Welcome Benefit tab to open the Benefits Page.

Step 3: Select Your Vouchers

    • Tap ADD on any voucher

    • Choose the quantity

    • Tap CLAIM NOW

    • Verify with OTP (Choose SMS or E-Mail)

    • Tick consent and tap Generate OTP

    • Enter the OTP received and tap SUBMIT and full voucher code and PIN will be shared on your register mail ID.

• View claimed vouchers in Order History → Tap voucher → Show Code (OTP required again) → View your voucher code & PIN

For details and T&Cs, 
click here (PDF, 1.89 MB)
 .

How can I get the annual fee waived off for the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card?

If you spend over ₹3 lakh, you can get your annual fee waived off for the next year.

Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card?

Yes. You can easily make online purchases across India and in select overseas stores using the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card.

What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it in my ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card?

Flip your Rubyx Credit Card. The three-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

Which Credit Card should I opt for to get benefits on shopping?

ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card is one of the best choices. It offers several benefits for shopping enthusiasts.

What is the age limit to apply for a Rubyx Credit Card?

You must be between the age of 21 and 65 years to be eligible to apply for the Rubyx Credit Card.

How do I know the payment due date of my ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card?

You can know the payment due date of your ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card through the monthly statement, ICICI Bank's iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling our Customer Care on 1800 1080.

What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

To enjoy domestic lounge access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your Rubyx Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.

Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria, 
click here (PDF, 452 KB)
.

What is the criteria for being eligible for the movie benefits offer with BookMyShow?

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. This entitles you to avail the offer in the following calendar quarter. Please go through the illustration below to understand spends and offer eligibility period. 

Please go through the below illustration to understand the spends period along with the lounge eligibility period:

Spends period offer -  eligibility period

Spend ₹25,000 between Dec 26, 2025 and Mar 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between Apr 01, 2026 and June 30, 2026. 

 Spend ₹25,000 between Mar 26, 2026 and June 25, 2026 - Get movie offer benefit between July 01, 2026 and Sep 30, 2026.

Customers with Credit Card on dual networks (Mastercard & Amex | Visa & RuPay) can avail one movie offer per month, per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please 
click here 
.

Add-on/Plus card members need to individually spend ₹25,000 in the preceding spends quarter, to be eligible for the offer in the subsequent calendar quarter

Is there any cashback offer on American Express Credit Card variant while booking movie tickets on BookMyShow? 

Cashback offers on the Amex variant have been revoked effective from 01 Jan 2025.

Customers can avail upfront offers while booking tickets on BookMyShow by following the steps below-

Navigate to ‘Apply Offers’ section 

 Click on the tab - Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking 

 Choose ICICI Bank Credit Card 25% Discount Offer on selected ICICI Bank Credit Cards 

 Enter the Card Number and click ‘Apply Offer’ 

 Once the success message shows up, the offer will be applied on the billing page. 

What are the movie ticket benefits available?

Cardholders are eligible for a 25% off on movie ticket offer worth up to ₹150 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets. Customers with dual Credit Card variants can avail one offer per month per variant. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed Terms & Conditions, please 
click here (PDF, 24.4 KB)

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please 
click here

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transaction from ₹400 - ₹4000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

What are the golf privileges and eligibility criteria?

As a Rubyx Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for a round or lesson of golf for every ₹50,000 spent on retail purchases in the previous calendar month. You can avail of a maximum of 2 rounds per month. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit 
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered against your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months.

To view the updated list of golf courses, please 
click here (PDF, 315 KB)
. For complete details on the Golf programme and the associated terms and conditions, please 
click here (PDF, 216 KB)
. You may also call iAssist, the 24/7 concierge service on 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL or BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking.

How do I make the booking for Golf Rounds?

Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps:

Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform 
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 with your registered mobile number.

Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.

Submit your booking request and await confirmation.

Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details.

You may also call i-Assist, our 24X7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable), for assistance with online booking. An authorisation amount of ₹2 shall be taken for each eligible Card.

What are the key features of the concierge services offered?

The concierge services provide 24X7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower & gift deliveries, hotel & flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable).

What Air Accident Insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?

The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident Insurance coverage of ₹1 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the event. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplementary Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards, please 
click here (PDF, 225 KB)
.

What are the criteria for availing domestic railway lounge access?

Upgrade your travel experience with complimentary access to railway with your ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card. Get 2 complementary access to select railway lounges in India every quarter. Simply present your ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card to enjoy the privileges

Over and above the permitted number of complimentary access, each subsequent access will be charged as per rates laid out by each lounge service provider.

The access to railway lounges will be applicable only for primary cardholders.

Click here (PDF, 293 KB)
 for a complete list of lounges.

Do I get reward points on Fuel transactions?

No, you do not get reward points on Fuel transactions. 1% fuel surcharge waiver is applicable on all fuel transactions from ₹400 - ₹4000 at any fuel outlet in India.

ICICI Bank Rupay Credit Card FAQs

Does the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card provide discounts on movie tickets?

Yes, the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card does provide discounts on movie tickets.

What is the benefit of using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card offers seamless savings and convenience. Easily link it to UPI for quick and secure payments to merchants, with wide acceptance nationwide and hassle-free transactions.

Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

Yes. You can easily make online purchases across India and in select overseas stores using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card.

What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find it in my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

Flip your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card. The 3-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV (Card Verification Value). You can also check it by logging in to your iMobile app or Net Banking.

What is the age limit to apply for a RuPay Credit Card?

You must be between the age of 21 and 65 years to be eligible to apply for the RuPay Credit Card.

How do I know the payment due date of the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

You can find the payment due date of your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card either through the monthly statement, iMobile app, Net Banking or by calling Customer Care on 1800 1080.

How do I link the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with iMobile for UPI payments?

Please follow the steps below to link your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with iMobile:

Step 1: Download and log into the iMobile app

Step 2: Select ‘UPI Payments’

Step 3: Click on ‘UPI Settings

Step 4: Select ‘RuPay Credit Card’

Step 5: Click on ‘Enter Last 6 digits of Credit Card’ and enter the corresponding digits of the Credit Card Number

Step 6: Enter your 4-digit PIN

Step 7: Click on ‘Confirm’.

Will I need a separate UPI PIN for my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card for payments?

Please find the details below:

iMobile: No separate UPI PIN needs to be created, existing UPI PIN will suffice. Third-Party Apps: A separate UPI PIN needs to be created for ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card when linking it to carry out UPI payments on other UPI apps

What are the pre-requisites for linking the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card on iMobile?

The ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card can be linked on the iMobile app post 1 hour of the RuPay Credit Card creation. For non-QR code UPI transactions (e.g. online payments), online transactions must be enabled for your Credit Card. QR code-based iMobile UPI transactions can be initiated after the RuPay Credit Card is successfully linked to UPI.

How can I pay a merchant using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card on UPI?

You can make payments using the iMobile app by following the path below: Open iMobile > Scan any QR > Select ‘Pay with RuPay Credit Card > Enter UPI PIN > Confirm 

Payments can also be made using your UPI ID payments by entering your UPI OD at merchant apps/ websites and then approving the request on iMobile at the path below: Log into iMobile > UPI Payments > Payment Requests > Accept.

Do I need to have the same mobile number linked to my UPI app as well as my RuPay Credit Card?

Yes, the mobile number used on UPI apps should be same as the mobile number linked to your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card. If you have changed your mobile number, please update the same for your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card as well. After updating, you will need to re-register the Credit Card on the UPI app.

What are the pre-requisites for linking the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with third-party UPI payment apps, i.e. UPI apps other than iMobile?

ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card expiry details need to be entered for the Card to be linked to third-party UPI apps.

Can I make a UPI payment to any person or other Credit Card using my linked ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

No, only Person to Merchant (P2M) (e.g. payments at stores, websites etc.) are allowed from the linked Credit Card. Other types of payments are not allowed.

Can I link my Visa/ MasterCard/ Diners Credit Card on UPI?

Currently, as per RBI guidelines, only RuPay Credit Cards can be linked on UPI.

What are the limits on transactions allowed from a linked Credit Card on UPI?

There is no limit for the number of transactions carried out from a linked Credit Card on UPI. However, the limit on the transaction amount allowed from linked Credit Cards on UPI is governed by the UPI transaction limits set by the National Payments corporation of India (NPCI) and the Credit Limit provided to you on your Credit Card (whichever is lower).

What are the restricted merchant categories on which customers are not allowed to make UPI payments, using the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

Customers are not allowed to make the following UPI payments using the linked Credit Card:

P2P: Person-to-Person, e.g. paying an individual 

P2PM: Person-to-Person Merchant, i.e. paying an individual who is acting like a business

and any other categories, as restricted by ICICI Bank from time to time.

Can I make my linked Credit Card as a default account to receive funds?

No, funds cannot be received on a linked Credit Card through UPI.

Do I need to enable Card controls on the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card for online transactions?

Yes, you need to enable online transactions on your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card using iMobile/ Net Banking to use Credit Cards for regular online purchases as well as online UPI transactions.

If my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card is renewed, do I need to link it again to UPI?

Yes, in case the ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card is renewed or replaced, you have to re-register the Credit Card in the UPI apps you use.

Where can I see the UPI transactions on my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

ICICI Bank Credit Card transactions through UPI will be available in your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card statement every month. The statement can be checked on iMobile at Credit Cards > View Statement and on Net Banking at Cards > Credit Cards > Statement.

Will I earn any reward points for UPI spends using ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card?

Yes, UPI spends using Credit Card will earn reward points as per the reward point structure of the respective Credit Card.

Will I get any surcharge waiver on fuel purchases made using RuPay Credit Card via UPI mode?

Fuel surcharge waiver will be applicable as per the respective Credit Card features. For more details about UPI transactions using the RuPay Credit Card, 
click here
 .

How do I see my Credit Card Number online?

To view your ICICI Bank Credit Card Number online, log into iMobile or Net Banking and view your Credit Card details.

How do I link my ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with UPI to make payments?

You can link your ICICI Bank RuPay Credit Card with UPI using the iMobile app. Please follow the steps below:

Log into iMobile

Click on the 'UPI Payments' tab

Click on 'UPI Settings'

Click on the button at the bottom-right side of the screen

Select 'RuPay Credit Card'

Select the desired bank whose Credit Card you want to link

Verify the Card details, set the UPI PIN and you are ready to go!

You can now use your RuPay Credit Card for UPI payments at merchant outlets which support the same.

Sapphiro Credit Card FAQs

When will I get the joining benefits for the Sapphiro Credit Card?

You will receive an e-mail regarding the same within 45 business days after the payment of the joining fee.

What is included in the joining benefit vouchers?

Upon payment of the joining fee, Cardholders will receive welcome vouchers worth over ₹13,000 within 45 days. There are vouchers worth ₹3,000 from Tata CliQ, ₹4,000 from EaseMyTrip (4 vouchers of ₹1,000 each), ₹5,000 from Da Milano, ₹1,500 from Croma (3 vouchers of ₹500 each) and an EazyDiner Prime Membership (3 months’ subscription) worth ₹1,095.

How can I avoid the annual fee of the ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card?

If you spend over ₹6 lakh, you can get your annual fee waived off for the next year.

What is CVV in a Credit Card? How do I find the CVV in my Sapphiro Credit Card?

Flip your Sapphiro Credit Card. The three-digit security code next to the signature panel is your CVV. You can also check it by logging in to your ICICI Bank's iMobile app or Net Banking.

Which bank’s Credit Card should I opt for?

The ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card is an excellent choice. It offers premium perks like Reward Points, complimentary airport lounge access, buy one get one offer on BookMyShow and welcome offers from Uber, EaseMyTrip, Croma, Tata CLiQ and more. 

What is the age limit to apply for Sapphiro Credit Card?

You must be between the ages of 21 and 65 years to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card.

How do I know the Due Date of an ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You can find your ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card’s Due Date on your monthly statement, on the ICICI Bank's iMobile app, through Net Banking or by calling our Customer Care on

1800 1080.

What is the ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card best used for?

The ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card is best used for travel and lifestyle expenses. It has a wide range of offers like complimentary Airport Lounge access, BookMyShow offers, Welcome Vouchers and much more!

What are the criteria for availing domestic airport lounge access?

To enjoy domestic airport lounge access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your Sapphiro Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. The benefit is exclusively applicable to the primary Cardholder.

For customers with dual Credit Card variants (MasterCard and Amex), the entitlement includes 2 domestic lounge visits per quarter for each variant.

Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria,

. To view the complete list of lounges, 
click here

What are the golf privileges and eligibility criteria?

As a Sapphiro Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for a round or lesson of golf for every ₹50,000 spent on retail purchases in the previous calendar month. You can avail of a maximum of 4 rounds per month. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit 
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered against your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months. 

To view the updated list of golf courses, please 
click here
. For complete details on the Golf programme and the associated terms and conditions, please 
click here
. You may also call iAssist, the 24/7 concierge service on 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL or BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking.

How do I make the booking for Golf Rounds?

Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps:

Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform 
https://teetimes.truztee.com/
 with your registered mobile number.

Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time.

Submit your booking request and await confirmation.

Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details.

You may also call i-Assist, our 24X7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable), for assistance with online booking. An authorisation amount of ₹2 shall be taken for each eligible Card.

Starting Apr 1, 2026, to be eligible for availing complimentary tickets offer on movie/ events tickets with BookMyShow, you must spend ₹25,000 or more on your Sapphiro Credit Card within the preceding spends quarter. What are the key features of the concierge services offered?

The concierge services provide 24/7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower and gift deliveries, hotel and flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable).

What Air Accident Insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders?

The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident Insurance coverage of ₹3 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the event. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplementary Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards, please 
click here
. 

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please 
click here
 .

What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

What are the differences between the ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card’s Amex and Mastercard variants?

The core benefits remain the same. Differences are mainly in card network acceptance, lounge access allocation per variant, and select merchant offers based on Amex or Mastercard.

reward points

Scan and Pay Credit Card Bill

Scan and Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card Bill

You can now pay your 
ICICI Bank Credit Card bill
 with ease by simply scanning a QR code using any UPI enabled app or BHIM app.

To make the payment, follow the simple steps:

1. Click on ‘Proceed’ and enter your credit card number, as required.

2. Check and verify the details displayed.

3. Enter the amount you wish to pay (we recommend that you clear the entire overdue amount to avoid any future late payment charges).

4. Click on ‘Generate QR Code’.

5. Log in to any UPI enabled app or BHIM app on your phone and scan the generated QR code.

6. Proceed with making the payment.

7. Once the payment is processed, you will receive a success confirmation along with the transaction number.

ICICI Bank Personal Loan on Credit Card – Detailed Charges and Fees

Service Charges and Fees for Personal Loans on Credit Card

You can avail a Personal 
Loan on Credit Card
 of up to ₹20 lakh at a lower interest rate, starting from 13% per annum and flexible tenure of up to 60 months.

The interest shall be at such a rate which has been indicated by ICICI Bank to the Card Member at the time of making the offer for the Facility. The interest calculation will start from the time the request regarding the Facility has been confirmed by the Card Member.

Goods and Services Tax (GST) will be applicable on the interest component of the EMI every month.

Details about Contingent Charges

I

Rate of annualised penal charges in case of delayed payments*

Interest will be charged if the Total Amount Due is not paid by the payment due date. Interest will be charged on the Total Amount Due and on all new transactions (from the transaction date) till the time the previous outstanding amounts are paid in full. The rate of interest may be changed at the sole discretion of ICICI Bank. It ranges between 1.25% (15% p.a.) to 3.75% per month (45% p.a). GST charges will be applicable.

Late Payment charges on your Card will be a function of the Total Amount Due and will be as follows

II

Rate of annualised other penal charges*

Auto-debit return charges: The charges could be applicable in case of auto-debit failure i.e. 2% of the Total Amount Due (subject to a minimum of ₹500). GST will be applicable on the auto-debit failure fee.

Over-limit Fee: The fee could be applicable in case the credit limit on the Card is breached while availing Personal Loan on Credit Card (PLCC).

2.5% of the over-limit amount (subject to a minimum of ₹550) will be levied, except for ICICI Bank's Emeralde Credit Card. GST will be applicable on the over-limit fee.

Foreclosure charge: The charge applicable is up to <3%> of the outstanding principal amount. The next month’s EMI (interest as per amortisation table) would be applicable in the event of pre-closure of the loan after the cooling off period. GST would be applicable.

ICICI Bank Personal Loan on Credit Card – Detailed Charges and Fees

Service Charges and Fees for Personal Loans on Credit Card

You can avail a Personal 
Loan on Credit Card
 of up to ₹20 lakh at a lower interest rate, starting from 13% per annum and flexible tenure of up to 60 months.

The interest shall be at such a rate which has been indicated by ICICI Bank to the Card Member at the time of making the offer for the Facility. The interest calculation will start from the time the request regarding the Facility has been confirmed by the Card Member.

Goods and Services Tax (GST) will be applicable on the interest component of the EMI every month.

Details about Contingent Charges

I

Rate of annualised penal charges in case of delayed payments*

Interest will be charged if the Total Amount Due is not paid by the payment due date. Interest will be charged on the Total Amount Due and on all new transactions (from the transaction date) till the time the previous outstanding amounts are paid in full. The rate of interest may be changed at the sole discretion of ICICI Bank. It ranges between 1.25% (15% p.a.) to 3.75% per month (45% p.a). GST charges will be applicable.

Late Payment charges on your Card will be a function of the Total Amount Due and will be as follows

II

Rate of annualised other penal charges*

Auto-debit return charges: The charges could be applicable in case of auto-debit failure i.e. 2% of the Total Amount Due (subject to a minimum of ₹500). GST will be applicable on the auto-debit failure fee.

Over-limit Fee: The fee could be applicable in case the credit limit on the Card is breached while availing Personal Loan on Credit Card (PLCC).

2.5% of the over-limit amount (subject to a minimum of ₹550) will be levied, except for ICICI Bank's Emeralde Credit Card. GST will be applicable on the over-limit fee.

Foreclosure charge: The charge applicable is up to <3%> of the outstanding principal amount. The next month’s EMI (interest as per amortisation table) would be applicable in the event of pre-closure of the loan after the cooling off period. GST would be applicable.

Does the MakeMyTrip Signature Credit Card provide any offers on MakeMyTrip?

The MakeMyTrip Signature Credit Card offers an exclusive MMTBLACK Platinum Membership and a MakeMyTrip Holiday Voucher up to ₹2,500.

Is the MakeMyTrip Signature Credit Card free?

The MakeMyTrip Signature Credit Card has a one-time Joining Fee of ₹2,500.

How to avail Complimentary International Airport lounge Access?

What is CVV on the Credit Card? How do I find it on my MakeMyTrip Signature Credit Card?

Flip your MakeMyTrip Signature Credit Card. The three-digit Security Code next to the signature panel is your CVV. You can also check it by logging in to your iMobile.

How to know the Due Date of ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

You can find your ICICI Bank MakeMyTrip Signature Credit Card’s due date in your monthly statement, on the iMobile, through Internet Banking or by contacting Customer Care on 1800 1080.

What is myCash?

If you hold the MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Platinum Credit Card , you will earn MakeMyTrip myCash on certain transactions. These rewards can be redeemed through the MakeMyTrip platform against bookings made on the MakeMyTrip platform

What are the criteria for availing Domestic Airport Lounge Access?

To enjoy Domestic Airport Lounge Access, you must spend ₹75,000 or more on your MakeMyTrip Signature Credit Card in a calendar quarter. This entitles you to avail the lounge access benefit in the following calendar quarter. 

Please note that the airport lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. For more details on the criteria,

What are the criteria for availing International airport lounge Access?

Enjoy 1 complimentary access to international airport lounges with Dreamfolks membership card provided with your MakeMyTrip Signature Credit Card.

As a Dreamfolks member, you can relax at more than 650+ comfortable and luxurious airport lounges across 100+ countries around the world, regardless of the airline or class you fly with, or whether or you are a member of an airline frequent flyer club or not. This feature is available for Primary card members only.

Please present your Dreamfolks membership card to the lounge staff at the entrance of the participating International Lounges, to avail the complimentary benefits.

What are the criteria for availing railway lounge access?

Enjoy 1 complimentary railway lounge access in a quarter to participating lounges in India

Please note that the railway lounge access benefit is available only for primary Cardholders. To view the complete list of lounges,  
Click here

What are the movie ticket benefits available?

Cardholders are eligible for a 25% off on movie ticket offer worth up to ₹150 on the purchase of a minimum of two tickets. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms and conditions, please 
click here
.

What is the Fuel Surcharge Waiver offered to Cardholders?

Cardholders can avail of a 1% Fuel Surcharge Waiver on all fuel transactions of ₹400 to ₹4,000 at HPCL fuel outlet when the Card is swiped on ICICI Merchant Services swipe machines in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card.

What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders?

Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent.

What security features are provided by the chip and PIN?

The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. click here

Instant EMI on ICICI Bank Retail Credit Cards – Terms and Conditions

Terms and conditions relating to Instant EMI on ICICI Bank retail Credit Cards

Updated on 30 August 2025

A processing fee of 2.99%, capped at a maximum of ₹299 + GST is applicable on all Instant EMI transactions w.e.f. 01 September 2025 at all merchant outlets or stores and online or e-commerce merchants.

Interest rate up to 20% and a processing fee of up to ₹999 can be charged for Instant EMI conversion of transactions related to two-wheelers.

Interest rate up to 11.40% and a processing fee of up to 2% of the loan amount can be charged for Instant EMI conversion of transactions related to ‘Apple for Life’ and ‘OnePlus Easy Upgrades’.

‘EMI’ or ‘Equated Monthly Instalment’ means the monthly instalment payable by the Card Member to ICICI Bank comprising of principal amount, interest and any or other charges, if applicable.

‘Instant EMI’ refers to the conversion to EMI upon the Card Member’s request. These are for transactions carried out using the retail 
Credit Card
 on the EDC (Electronic Data Capture) terminal installed at a merchant outlet and or for such online transactions, where the option for EMI payment is available.

Instant 
EMI on Credit Card
, without prejudice to the obligation of the Card Member to make immediate payment on the incurring of the charge, is a facility by which the Card Member may seek to avail the option of paying for certain purchases through Equated Monthly Instalments (EMIs) as informed to the Card Member by ICICI Bank’s Customer Care. The same is indicated in the Statement sent to the Card Member which shall be subject to the following terms:

If any portion of the billed and outstanding charges are not permitted to be paid in Instant EMI and if such portion is not paid by the Payment Due Date, the same will bear and carry an interest, Goods and Services Tax and late payment fee at the rate and in the manner stated in Clause VI;

The Instant EMI facility is available to the Card Member at ICICI Bank's sole discretion and this facility will be available for a certain period and at Merchant Establishments as decided by ICICI Bank. The rate of interest for Instant EMI will be specific to the Card Member and Merchant, as decided by ICICI Bank and may vary from time to time. The transaction amount, the tenure for repayment and other payment particulars will be specific to the Card Member and Merchant, as decided by ICICI Bank.

The Instant EMI facility is not applicable on ICICI Bank EMI Card, Corporate Credit Card, 
Business Card
 and American Express Card. ‘ICICI Bank’ and ‘I-man’ logo are trademarks and properties of ICICI Bank Limited. Misuse of any intellectual property or such other ancillary or related content with respect to this product / offer / programme is strictly prohibited.

Purchases made from categories relating to fuel, jewellery, watches, etc., may not be eligible for EMI conversion.

The Card Member shall be charged an interest rate on a monthly reducing basis, for availing the Instant EMI facility. The interest rate applicable will be communicated to the Card Member at the point of sale and will also be mentioned on the charge-slip.

Repayment

The card member shall repay the facility and interest thereon in EMIs. The interest shall be at such rate, which has been indicated by ICICI Bank to the Card Member at the time of making the offer for the facility and as communicated on the charge-slip. The interest calculation will start from the time the transaction has been booked for the facility. The EMI amount along with other details of the Facility (including rate of interest) shall also be communicated to the Card Member at his/her registered e-mail/mailing address.

The EMI amount due for a particular month shall subsequently reflect in the Credit Card Statement of Accounts (the ‘Statement’) of that particular month. The Card Member hereby authorises ICICI Bank to debit their Card Account monthly for the EMI due for that particular month, as has been intimated to the Card Member through the Statement. Principal and interest will be mentioned separately in the Statement. The Card Member shall pay the EMI and all other charges by way of cash, cheque, draft, online or through payment instructions to ICICI Bank and the cash limit or credit limit shall be reinstated to the extent of the EMI amount repaid by the Card Member.

The Card Member shall be required to pay the entire EMI amount for a particular month on the due date, as indicated in the Statement and the same shall not be permitted to be carried forward / included in the next Statement. If the payment is not made by the due date as specified, it shall be construed as a default by the Card Member who shall become liable to pay the amount together with late payment charges.

Goods and Services Tax will be applicable on processing fee, interest and foreclosure charges as per government mandate, w.e.f. 01 July 2017.

Prepayment of the Facility

The Card Member may close the facility (prepayment of the outstanding amount) at any time by contacting ICICI Bank's Customer Care to avail the foreclosure. Foreclosure charges of up to 3% on the outstanding principal amount plus next month’s interest shall be levied in the Card Account. The Card Member must contact ICICI Bank’s Customer Care for complete prepayment of the facility. ICICI Bank shall, without prejudice to all rights and remedies, have the right to call upon the Card Member to forthwith repay the Facility, all interest thereon and all other monies with respect to the facility, in case of a default in EMI payment for more than two consecutive months and the Card Member shall be liable to repay all such amounts on demand.

Cancellation of the Facility

Effective Date: 01 May 2025

To cancel the Credit Card EMI facility, the Card Member must call ICICI Bank Customer Care on 1800 1080 within 15 days from the date of the transaction. The eligibility conditions for cancellation are as follows:

A full refund has been received from the merchant as a single transaction, within 15 days of the original transaction

A partial refund is received as a single transaction within 15 days of the transaction date and the difference between original transaction amount and refund amount is less than ₹1,500.

Additional Points:

Foreclosure charges will be levied if the EMI option is opted for at the time of purchase and the customer later opts to cancel the EMI facility.

Upon discontinuation of the EMI facility, the deferred EMI interest payment amount, as confirmed at the time of availing the facility, will not be returned to the Card Member.

For the EMI availed via Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Credit Card transactions on third-party apps, the Card Member must call ICICI Bank Customer Care on 1800 1080 and provide the RRN (Retrieval Reference Number) of the original transaction to initiate cancellation in case of Merchant Refund.

Foreclosure charges will be applicable, even if the Card Member initiates EMI cancellation. 

 Particular Affirmative Covenants

The Card Member has understood ICICI Bank's method of calculating EMIs payable.

The Card Member has understood that by availing the facility, he or she shall not be, unless otherwise stated by ICICI Bank in writing, eligible for any reward points whatsoever, whether awarded under the ICICI Bank Reward Points Scheme or any other reward points scheme on the Card, that may be announced by ICICI Bank from time to time.

The Card Member shall not be eligible for any reward points whatsoever on cancellation of the Instant EMI facility.

The Card Member shall renew the Card when the Card expires during the tenure of the facility. If the Card Member does not renew the Card as stated above, ICICI Bank shall be entitled to call upon the Card Member to forthwith repay the facility without prejudice to all rights and remedies against the Card Member.

The Card Member shall notify ICICI Bank in writing, of any change in the Card Member's address within a week of such change.

The Card Member is deemed to have accepted these Terms & Conditions while requesting for the facility.

Repayment of the entire amount of the facility to ICICI Bank by the Card Member shall release the credit limit or cash limit for which the Card Member is eligible, by virtue of holding the Card.

The Card Member shall pay all taxes, duties, levies (including Goods and Services Tax) with respect to the facility.

Liabilities of the Card Member

ICICI Bank reserves the right to request the Card Member to make an advance payment of one or more EMIs against the grant of the facility. ICICI Bank shall have the right to adjust the amount of the advance EMIs towards the balance amount of the facility, at its sole discretion.

Events of Default 

If one or more of the events specified in this Clause (‘Events of Default’) occur or shall have occurred, ICICI Bank may foreclose the facility through a written Notice to the Card Member.

The card member's breach of any of the Terms and Conditions along with covenants contained herein or having made any misrepresentation to ICICI Bank

The Card Member has been declared as an insolvent

Any proceedings for misconduct have been initiated against the Card Member

The Card Member's failure to furnish any information or documents that may be required by ICICI Bank

The Card Member entering any arrangement with their creditors

The Card Member defaulting on any of the Terms and Conditions of any other Loan or Facility provided by ICICI Bank to the Card Member

The existence of any other circumstances, which, in the sole opinion of ICICI Bank, risks ICICI Bank's interest.

Upon the occurrence of any Event of Default as specified above, ICICI Bank shall be entitled to exercise rights and remedies available under these Terms & Conditions and the primary Terms & Conditions.

1. Fees and Charges

A. Fees payable on the Credit Card by the Card Member

Annual fee: The annual fee for each card member may vary and is communicated when applying for the Credit Card. These fees are billed to the card account and stated in the card statement. 
Renewal fees: Similar to annual fees, renewal fees may apply.

B. Cash Advance Fee

When using the Credit Card to access cash from ATMs in India or abroad, a transaction fee is levied on the amount withdrawn, billed in the following statement.

The transaction fee is subject to change at ICICI Bank's discretion.
All cash advances also carry a finance charge until full payment, which is subject to change.

C. Charges

Certain charges and fees apply to card members for specific services or defaults regarding their card account.
ICICI Bank retains the right to alter or introduce new charges or fees with customer notification.

D. Interest-Free Period

The interest-free credit period ranges from a certain number of days, depending on the specific Credit Card scheme and merchant claim submission.
Not applicable if the previous month's balance remains unpaid or if the card member availed cash from an ATM.

2. Limits

ICICI Bank determines the card member's credit and cash withdrawal limits, communicated during card delivery and in monthly statements.
The available credit limit may change based on internal criteria, with immediate customer notification.
Card members can request credit limit increases by providing financial documents.

3. Billing and Statement

Monthly finance charges apply to transactions and cash advances not paid in full.
Finance charges on cash advances apply from the transaction date until payment.
Cardholders paying less than the amount due will incur finance charges on outstanding balances and new transactions until the previous dues are paid.

The Bank sends reminders for outstanding dues; third parties may be involved for collections.
ICICI Bank has a right of lien and set off on the card member's monies if the card account balance is not repaid within the prescribed time.

Monthly statements reflect payments, transactions and outstanding balances.
Card members can pay the minimum amount due or the total amount due by the payment due date.
Payments may be made through various channels including Net Banking, ATMs, Phone Banking, NEFT Fund Transfer and more.

4. Right of Lien

The Bank can set off any card member's monies in any account/custody if the card balance is not repaid.

5. Termination/Revocation of the Card Membership

Card members can terminate the card membership by submitting a written request and cutting the cards.
The bank may restrict/terminate the card's use for unusual transaction patterns, non-payment or exceeding the credit limit.
The Bank reserves the right to suspend the facility on the Credit Card if default occurs.

6. Loss or Theft or Misuse of Card

Card members must immediately notify the 24–hour Call Centre if the card is lost, stolen or misused.
The Bank is not liable for transactions incurred before reporting the loss.
Card members are responsible for losses due to fraudulent or careless actions.

7. Reward Points

Reward points are earned for transactions as per the terms and conditions.
Reward points are valid for a specified duration.
Several terms and conditions apply to reward points, including reversals for certain transactions.

8. Disclosure

The Bank can disclose information related to Credit Cards to credit bureaus without notice.
Card members are responsible for updating themselves with regulatory guidelines.

9. Lounge Access

Charges may apply for lounge access exceeding complimentary limits.
Lounge access details vary by card variant.
Safety and non-transferability of Priority Pass should be ensured.
These terms and conditions are subject to change at the discretion of ICICI Bank. For specific charges and details, please refer to the Schedule of Charges available from ICICI Bank.

Balance Transfer Terms & Conditions

DEFINITIONS

"Facility" means transfer at the sole discretion of ICICI Bank, of such amount of the Card member's outstanding balances on the Credit Cards of other banks, to the Card provided or agreed to be provided by ICICI Bank, not exceeding the available Credit Limit.

"EMI BT" means the Facility in the event the Card member converts the mode of repayment of the Facility into Equated Monthly Instalments.

"Equated Monthly Instalment (EMI)" means the equated monthly instalment of the amounts payable by the Card member to ICICI Bank in respect of the Facility, comprising of the principal amount of the Facility and interest thereon.

"Flexi BT" means the Facility under which the Card member transfers his amount at a low interest rate (specified by ICICI Bank, at the time of availing of such Facility) for a period specified by ICICI Bank. The Card member can also choose to repay the amount post this specified period at the normal interest rate applicable for the overdue amount. The amount will be added to the total amount due of the Card Account.

"Card member" means the individual to whom a Credit Card has been issued by ICICI Bank and who has availed the Facility.

"Card Account" means the account opened in the name of the Card member and maintained by ICICI Bank for the purpose of usage of the Credit Card as per the terms and conditions contained in the Primary Terms and Conditions.

"Primary Terms and Conditions" mean the terms and conditions governing the Credit Card issued by ICICI Bank, as is available on 
Click here

"Credit Limit" means the limit up to which the Card member is authorised to spend on their Credit Card.

"Cash Limit" means the maximum amount of cash or equivalent of cash as defined or prescribed by ICICI Bank, that the Card member can withdraw on his Card Account. Cash Limit forms a subset of the Card Member's Credit Limit / Purchase Limit.

USAGE OF THE FACILITY

Under the Facility, ICICI Bank shall at its sole discretion, permit the Card member to transfer all or part of his or her outstanding balances on Credit Cards issued by other banks or entities, to his/her Card Account. Such transfer shall be carried out through the following 2 ways:

A demand draft sent to the mailing address of the Card Member, last registered with ICICI Bank, in favour of the other bank or entity issuing the Credit Card for crediting the card account of the Card member with such other bank / entity for the approved Facility amount.

NEFT in favour of the other bank/entity issuing the Credit Card for crediting the card account of the Card member with such other bank / entity for the approved Facility amount

ICICI Bank shall not be liable for any overdue payments or service charges that may be incurred by the Card Member in respect of his other Credit Card post the Facility being granted / agreed to be granted by ICICI Bank. The Card Member shall remain liable to continue to make payments to the other Credit Card issuing bank / entity until the transferred amount of the Facility is received by the other Credit Card issuing bank / entity. Additionally, the Card member shall also receive the confirmation in a future ICICI Bank Credit Card statement providing that his/her card account with the other Credit Card issuing bank / entity has been credited. The Facility shall be available to the Primary Card member as well as the Supplementary Card member, subject to the available Cash Limit and or Credit Limit and will be provided to the Card member requesting the Facility.

The Cash Limit and/or the Credit Limit on the Card will be blocked by the amount of the Facility granted to the Card member. The card member shall be required to pay a non-refundable processing fee on the Facility up to the percentage specified by ICICI Bank to the Card Member. Service tax shall be applicable on the processing fee and interest amount as per ICICI Bank's prevailing rates. Such amount shall be reflected in the ICICI Bank Credit Card statement for the particular month.

The Card member understands that by clicking on the ‘I Agree’ button, he/she is consenting to the Terms and Conditions herein, and the same shall be admissible as an electronic record under Section 65B of the Indian Evidence Act, 1872. Furthermore, upon clicking on ‘I Agree’ button, the Card member is giving consent to share and retrieve his/her data to and from credit rating agency/credit bureau for his/her credit evaluation, before approval of the funds being sanctioned by ICICI Bank for usage of this facility.

REPAYMENT

In case of the Facility being EMI BT, the Card Member shall repay the Facility and interest thereon in EMIs. The interest shall be at such rate which has been indicated by ICICI Bank to the Card Member at the time of making the offer for the Facility and also as communicated to the Card Member thereafter. The interest calculation will start from the time the request regarding EMI BT has been confirmed by the Card member through the service call made to the Card member. The amount of the EMIs together with other details of the Facility (including rate of interest) shall be also communicated to the Card member at his/her mailing address.

The amount of EMIs due for a particular month shall subsequently be reflected in the ICICI Bank Credit Card statement of that particular month. ICICI Bank shall be entitled / is authorised by the Card member to debit the Card Account of the Card member on a monthly basis for the amount of EMI due for that particular month, as has been intimated to the Card member through the Statement. Upon repayment by the Card member, the Cash Limit / Credit Limit shall be reinstated to the extent of the amount of EMI repaid by the Card member. The entire amount of EMI will be added to the Minimum Amount Due of the Card member.

In case of the Facility being Flexi BT, the amount of the Facility shall form part of the Total Amount Due and/or EMI Amount Due and shall be repayable as total amount due. For this Facility, only the transferred principal will be charged at an interest rate specified by ICICI Bank at the time of availing of such facility for the specified period. All other fees, charges and transactions will attract interest from the date of such charges/transactions. Post the expiry of this specified period, if the Facility amount is not settled by the Card Member, it will also attract the standard overdue interest rate as given in the “Most Important Terms & Conditions”.

FORECLOSURE OF THE FACILITY

In case of the Facility being EMI BT, if the Facility is foreclosed or terminated before the tenure of the repayment of the Facility, the amount of the Facility outstanding at the time of foreclosure/termination together with all interest thereon and all other monies in respect of the Facility shall become repayable by the Card member immediately.

The Card member may foreclose the Facility at any time by contacting ICICI Bank's 24 Hour Customer Care Centre to avail of the foreclosure. The Card member shall pay such foreclosure charges as may be indicated by ICICI Bank in the communication sent to the Card member at the time of granting the Facility.

ICICI Bank shall, without prejudice to all rights and remedies, have the right to call upon the Card member to repay the Facility, all interest thereon and all other monies in respect of the Facility upon occurrence of an event of default in payment of EMI for two consecutive months and the Card Member shall be liable to repay all such amounts upon such demand.

CANCELLATION OF THE FACILITY

The Card member may cancel the Facility within 15 days of granting the Facility by contacting ICICI Bank's 24 Hour Customer Care Centre. Such cancellation shall be subject to return of the demand draft at Credit Card Operations, ICICI Bank Ltd., ICICI Bank Tower, C – Wing, Autumn Estate, Near Chandivali Studio, Chandivali Farm Road, Opp. Mhada Colony, Chandivali, Andheri (East), Mumbai 400072 and non-encashment of the demand draft by the Card Member or the beneficiary.

In cases where the Facility is availed through NEFT transfer, the Card member shall not have the right to cancel the Facility.

PARTICULAR AFFIRMATIVE COVENANTS

The Card member has understood ICICI Bank's method of calculating EMIs payable;

The Card member has understood that by availing the Facility, he/she shall not be, unless otherwise stated by ICICI Bank in writing, eligible for any Reward Points whatsoever, whether awarded under the ICICI Bank Reward Points Scheme or any other Reward Points Scheme on the Card that may be announced by ICICI Bank from time to time; The Card Member shall renew the Card forthwith if the period of the Card expires during the tenure of the Facility. In the event of failure of the Card member to renew the Card as stated above, ICICI Bank shall be entitled to call upon the Card member to forthwith repay the Facility without prejudice to all rights and remedies against the Card member; the Card member is deemed to have accepted these terms and conditions upon the Card member having requested for the Facility. LIABILITIES OF THE CARD MEMBER

ICICI Bank reserves the right to require the Card member to make advance payment of one or more EMIs against grant of the Facility and ICICI Bank shall have the right to adjust the amount of the advance EMIs towards the balance amount of the Facility, at its sole discretion.

EVENTS OF DEFAULT

If one or more of the events specified in this Clause ("Events of Default") occur or shall have occurred, ICICI Bank may call upon the Card member to foreclose the Facility by a notice in writing to the Card member.

The Card member's commission of a breach of any of the terms and conditions and covenants herein contained or having made any misrepresentation to ICICI Bank

The Card member's having been declared as an insolvent

Any proceedings for misconduct having been initiated against the Card member

The Card member's failure to furnish any information or documents that may be required by ICICI Bank

The Card member's entering into any composition with his/her creditors

The Card member's defaulting on any of the terms and conditions of any other loan or facility provided by ICICI Bank to the Card member

The existence of any other circumstances which, in the sole opinion of ICICI Bank, jeopardise ICICI Bank's interest. Upon the occurrence of any event of default as specified above, ICICI Bank shall be entitled to exercise rights and remedies available to it under these terms and conditions as also the Primary Terms and Conditions.

Terms and Conditions for Personal Loan on Credit Card (PLCC)

Last Updated Date - Aug 06, 2023

I. Definitions:

In these terms and conditions, unless there is anything repugnant to the subject or context thereof, the expressions listed below, if applicable, shall have the following meanings:

‘
Card Member
’, for the purpose of these Terms and Conditions, means the individual to whom a 
Credit Card
 has been issued by ICICI Bank Limited and who has availed of the Facility.

‘
Credit Limit
’ means the limit up to which the Card Member is authorised to spend on his/her Credit Card.

‘
Cash Limit
’ means the maximum amount of cash or equivalent cash amount as defined or prescribed by ICICI Bank, that the Card Member can withdraw on his/her Card Account. Cash Limit forms a subset of the Card Member's Credit Limit or Purchase Limit.

‘
Card Account
’ means the account opened in the name of the Card Member and maintained by ICICI Bank for the purpose of usage of the Credit Card, as per the Primary Terms and Conditions.

‘
Customer
’ means an individual to whom a Credit Card has been issued by ICICI Bank.

‘
EMI
’ or ‘
Equated Monthly Instalment
’ means the equated monthly instalments of amounts payable by the Card Member to ICICI Bank with respect to the Facility and comprises of the principal amount of the Facility and interest thereon.

‘
Facility
’ or ‘
PLCC
’ means the ‘
Personal Loan on Credit Cards
’ provided/agreed to be provided by ICICI Bank, at its sole discretion, to the Card Member, either to the extent of amounts not exceeding the available Cash Limit and/or Credit Limit or for an amount over the available Cash Limit and/or Credit Limit, through an additional account linked to an existing Card Account. The ‘
Facility
’ or ‘
PLCC
’ may also be referred to as ‘
Cash-in
’ or ‘
Cash-in Select
’.

‘
MITC
’ means the Most Important Terms and Conditions governing the Credit Card issued by ICICI Bank, a copy of which is provided by ICICI Bank to the Card Member and is available at /managed-assets/docs/personal/cards/mitc_cc.pdf

‘
Primary Card Member
’ is the person in whose name the Card Account has been opened and to whom the card has been issued.

‘
Primary Terms and Conditions
’ means the terms and conditions governing the Credit Card issued by ICICI Bank, as is available at /managed-assets/docs/personal/cards/credit-cards/tnc_english.pdf .

‘
Terms and Conditions
’ shall mean the terms and conditions for PLCC.

II. Usage of the Facility:

The Facility shall be available only to a Customer,  who are eligible by ICICI Bank for availing of the Facility, however approval is subject to the sole discretion of ICICI Bank. The Customer can request for an amount up to the available Cash Limit and/or Credit Limit on the Card Account or for an amount over the available Cash Limit/Credit Limit and such amounts shall be disbursed immediately in the form of transfer to his/her ICICI Bank liability account or through National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT) or such other mode as may be communicated by ICICI Bank, from time to time. The final approval of the amount of the Facility to be granted is subject to the Customer's performance on the Card and the available Cash Limit and/or Credit Limit at the time ICICI Bank receives the Customer's request for the Facility. The Cash Limit and/or the Credit Limit on the Credit Card will be blocked by the amount for which the Facility is granted in cases where such amount forms part of the available Cash Limit and/or Credit Limit. The Card Member shall be required to pay a non-refundable processing fee on the Facility up to the percentage specified by ICICI Bank to the Card Member. The cash-limit on the Credit Card will be blocked by the amount for which the facility is granted.

Disbursement through NEFT to non-ICICI Bank Account holders will be subject to successful processing at the beneficiary bank’s end. The Facility will be disbursed in 4 working days, subject to mandatory policy and credit checks.

The Card Member hereby agrees to avail of the Facility on the precondition that he/she will not use the Facility, or any part thereof, towards capital market or for the purpose of repaying his/her ICICI Bank Card outstanding.

The Credit Limit of the Credit Card will be blocked by the amount which is equal to billed EMI/EMIs + applicable taxes and fees, including processing fees and the same needs to be maintained in the Credit Limit else Over the Limit (OTL) charges along with charges as per MITC will be applicable. In case of OTL, except the above amount, the assigned credit limit of the card will not be affected. In case of availing PLCC-Within the Limit (WTL) Facility, the Credit Limit will be blocked by the amount equal to the PLCC-WTL availed.

The Card Member understands that by clicking on the ‘I Agree’ button, he/she is entering a valid and binding contract with ICICI Bank and the same shall be enforceable and binding as per Section 10A of the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the same shall be admissible as an electronic record under Section 63 of the BHARATIYA SAKSHYA ADHINIYAM, 2023.

The Card Member hereby allows use of such information that had been provided at the time of applying for the Credit Card for the completion of documentation for the Facility as well as any other offers ICICI Bank may wish to extend to the Card Member.

The Card Member, when availing PLCC-WTL, hereby allows an increase in his/her credit limit by <10>% or by the shortfall amount, if the minimum limit required to avail of the PLCC-WTL is not maintained.

III. Repayment:

The Card Member shall repay the Facility and interest thereon in EMIs. The interest shall be at such rate which has been indicated by ICICI Bank to the Card Member at the time of making the offer for the Facility. The interest calculation will start from the time the request regarding the Facility has been confirmed by the Card Member. The amount of the EMIs together with other details of the Facility (including rate of interest) shall also be communicated to the card member at his/her registered e-mail/mailing address. In cases where the customer has availed of this loan facility, the amount of EMI due for a particular month shall be subsequently reflected in the card statement for that particular month. Processing fee and related taxes will be levied in addition to the EMI amount in the subsequent statement generated post Facility approval. By availing the Facility, the Card Member authorises ICICI Bank to debit the Savings Account of the Card Member monthly for the minimum amount due for that particular month, as has been intimated to the Card Member through the Statement. Principal and interest will be mentioned separately in the statement. The Cash Limit and/or Credit Limit shall be reinstated to the extent of the amount of EMI repaid by the Card Member.

Goods and Services Tax (GST) will be applicable on the interest component of the EMI every month.

The Card Member shall be required to pay the entire amount of the EMI for a particular month on the Payment Due Date as indicated in the Statement and the same shall not be permitted to be carried forward/included in the next Statement. In the event the payment is not made by the payment due date, it shall be construed as a default by the Card Member and the Card Member shall become liable to pay the amount together with late payment charges, as specified in the Primary Terms and Conditions.

IV. Prepayment of Facility:

If the Facility is prepaid/terminated before the tenure of the Facility, the amount of the Facility outstanding at the time of prepayment/termination together with all interest thereon and all other monies in respect of the Facility shall become repayable by the Card Member. In addition to this, the Card Member is liable to pay pre-closure charges along with interest of the upcoming unbilled EMI.

The Card Member may prepay the Facility at any time by contacting ICICI Bank's 24x7 Customer Care. The Card Member shall pay such prepayment charges as may be indicated by ICICI Bank in the communication sent to the Card Member at the time of granting the Facility.

ICICI Bank shall, without prejudice to all rights and remedies, have the right to call upon the Card Member to forthwith repay the Facility, all interest thereon and all other monies in respect of the Facility upon occurrence of Event of Default (hereinafter specified) in repayment of the amount of the Facility and the Card Member shall be liable to repay all such amounts upon such demand.

V. Cancellation of Facility:

The Card Member may cancel the Facility within 15 days of receiving the transfer to his/her ICICI Bank liability account by contacting ICICI Bank's Customer Care.

In case of non-ICICI Bank Account transfer through NEFT, cancellation is subject to payment of the transferred funds to the Card Account. In case of transfer to his/her ICICI Bank liability account, the cancellation request can be raised at ICICI Bank's Customer Care and such amount will be reversed from the account, where the transfer was effected.

In case of a Demand Draft, the Card Member may request for such cancellation at ICICI Bank's Customer Care or return the Demand Draft at the Regional Transport Office (RTO) address mentioned on the envelope.

Such cancellation shall be subject to non-encashment of the Demand Draft or the amount being available in the account to effect reversal, as the case may be.

VI. Particular Affirmative Covenants:

The Card Member has understood ICICI Bank's method of calculating EMIs payable;

The Card Member has understood and agrees that by availing of the Facility, the Card Member shall not be, unless otherwise stated by ICICI Bank in writing, eligible for any Reward Points whatsoever, whether awarded under the ICICI Bank Reward Points Scheme or any other Reward Points Scheme on the card that may be announced by ICICI Bank from time to time;

The Card Member shall renew the card forthwith in the event the period of the card expires during the tenure of the Facility. In the event of failure of the Card Member to renew the Card as stated above, ICICI Bank shall be entitled to call upon the Card Member to forthwith repay the Facility without prejudice to all rights and remedies against the Card Member;

The Card Member is deemed to have accepted these terms and conditions. The Card Member is aware that these Terms and Conditions are available at www.icicibank.com and has read and understood the same;

Repayment by the Card Member of the entire amount of the Facility to ICICI Bank shall release the Credit Limit and/or Cash Limit for which the Card Member is eligible by virtue of holding the card;

The Card Member shall make payment of all taxes, duties, levies (including GST) in connection with the Facility.

VII. Liabilities of the Card Member:

ICICI Bank reserves the right to require the Card Member to make advance payment of one or more EMIs against granting of the Facility and ICICI Bank shall have the right to adjust the amount of the advance EMIs towards the balance amount of the Facility, at its sole discretion.

VIII. Events of Default:

If one or more of the events specified in this clause (Events of Default) occur or shall occur, ICICI Bank may call upon the Card Member to foreclose the Facility by a notice in writing to the Card Member:

The Card Member's commission of a breach of any of the terms, conditions and covenants herein contained or having made any misrepresentation to ICICI Bank;

The Card Member being declared bankrupt;

Any proceedings for misconduct being initiated against the Card Member;

The Card Member's failure to furnish any information or documents that may be required by ICICI Bank;

The Card Member getting into any composition (legal agreement) with his/her creditors;

The Card Member defaulting on any of the terms and conditions of any other loan or facility provided by ICICI Bank to the Card Member;

The existence of any other circumstances which, in the sole opinion of ICICI Bank, jeopardises ICICI Bank's interest;

Upon the occurrence of any Event of Default as specified above, ICICI Bank shall be entitled to exercise rights and remedies available to it under the Terms and Conditions, as well as the Primary Terms and Conditions;

The Card Member defaulting on the Primary Terms and Conditions applicable for a Personal Loan on Credit Card.

IX. Miscellaneous:

Details of the processing fee, foreclosure fee, GST and interest rate applicable on the Facility shall be as per the Amortisation Schedule provided by ICICI Bank to the Card Member. Details of all other charges shall be as per the MITC.

Nothing contained in the Terms and Conditions shall be construed as an obligation of ICICI Bank to continue to offer the Facility after the date of termination of the Facility. ICICI Bank reserves the right at any time, without previous notice, to add, alter, modify, change or vary all or any of the Terms and Conditions.

The Facility shall be available to the Primary Card Member only, subject to the available Cash Limit and/or Credit Limit and will be provided to the Card Member requesting for the Facility, at the sole discretion of ICICI Bank.

The competent courts in Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction to deal with any dispute that may arise out of the Terms and Conditions or in respect of the Facility. The existence of a dispute, if any, shall not constitute a claim against ICICI Bank.

In addition to the general right to set off or other right conferred by law or under any other agreement, ICICI Bank may, without notice, combine or consolidate the standing balance on the Card Member's Card Account, or the account linked to the Card Account, with any other account(s) that the Card Member maintains with ICICI Bank and its group companies, and set off or transfer money standing to his/her credit in such other account(s) in or towards the satisfaction of the Card Member's liability to ICICI Bank under his/her Card Account or the Facility.

FAQs

What type of card is the Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card?

The Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card is an exclusive Credit Card issued by ICICI Bank in association with Times Internet Ltd. and Visa. Designed for Ultra-High Net Worth Individuals (UHNIs), this card offers premium benefits across various categories, including luxury stays, travel experiences, lifestyle and mobility. 

How long are Milestone Benefits available to eligible cardholders?

Milestone Benefits can be accessed through the Times Black app for a period of six months, starting from the date the eligible cardholder is notified about the respective milestone by ICICI Bank.

How to avail Complimentary International Airport lounge access?

Enjoy unlimited complimentary accesses to international airport lounges with Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card.

Priority Pass Membership

Complimentary Priority Pass Membership for both the primary cardholder and Plus cardholder with Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card

Access 1,400+ lounges in 145+ countries worldwide

Present your Priority Pass Membership Card at the participating international lounges.

For complete list of international airport lounges visit 
https://www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges

How are ICICI Bank reward points earned? Are there any limits or exclusions?

You can earn 2% ICICI Bank reward points on all eligible domestic transactions. However, there is a cap of 5,000 reward points per statement cycle for the following categories:

Utility payments

Insurance premium payments

Education payments

Government payments (such as property tax, advance tax, fees, court payments, postal payments, etc.)

Additionally, ICICI Bank reward points will not be earned on fuel transactions, rent payments or transactions converted into EMIs. The points earned on such transactions will be reversed.

What is the value of 1 ICICI Bank reward point, and how can it be redeemed?

The value of 1 ICICI Bank reward point can be up to ₹ 1. However, when redeeming ICICI Bank reward points against your statement, the redemption rate is 1 Reward Point (RP) = ₹0.40.

Does the Times Black Credit Card offer any luxury Gift Card benefits?

Yes, as a Times Black Credit Card holder, you receive a TATA CLiQ Luxury Gift Card worth ₹10,000, which can be used to shop for premium luxury items and experiences.

What are the Times Black Credit Card benefits related to international experiences?

With the Times Black Credit Card, you can enjoy international experiences and benefits worth ₹10,000 on Klook, allowing you to explore exciting activities and attractions worldwide.

What luxury stay benefits does the Times Black Credit Card provide?

The Times Black Credit Card offers a one-night luxury stay at  Ayatana or Lohono worth ₹20,000, providing an unforgettable getaway experience in a luxurious setting.

What are the charges applicable for the Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card?

Joining Fee: ₹ 20,000 + GST

Annual Fee: ₹ 20,000 + GST

How can I get the annual fee waiver?

You can get your annual fee waived from the 2nd year onwards on minimum spends of ₹25,00,000 made in the previous year.

When will I get my joining benefits for the Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card?

You will receive an e-mail regarding the same within 45 business days after the payment of the joining fee.

How do I complete my video KYC verification?

You are required to provide your PAN Card and Aadhaar Card details followed by a video-based verification with an ICICI Bank employee. You will be required to accept a call request from the ICICI Bank employee and complete your video KYC by answering a few questions asked by them and showing the original PAN Card. Video KYC is available 24x7 on all days.

How will I get the PIN for my Credit Card?

You can generate the PIN in any of the following ways:

Using the iMobile app: Go to Services > Card PIN Services > Generate Credit Card PIN

Using Net Banking: Log into Net Banking > Generate Card PIN > Credit Card PIN > Select Card and enter CVV > Submit > Enter OTP > Enter PIN > Generate Now

Using the Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system: Call Customer Care on 1800 1080 and follow the instructions.
